chapters.title: Chapter 106 - To have eyes but fail to recognize Mt Tai
paragraphs: Jiang Chen’s vision landed upon these three men, and he instantly discovered that they were only Qi Hai warriors. They were probably only novice disciples, which was the lowest disciple rank. Those outer circle Mortal Core disciples wouldn’t be guarding the entrance here.

However, as the disciples of the Black Sect, even just being a novice disciple would be enough to make anyone proud of themselves. There were talented people amongst the novice disciples, and many of the current outer circle disciples and inner circle disciples were actually novice disciples at one point.
“Who are you? Why are you trespassing within the Black Sect? Are you courting death?”
A fat guy said in an arrogant tone, he was portraying a superior image.
Jiang Chen was amused by their response. The disciples from a big sect are indeed different. The way they showed their arrogance was more imposing than others.
Just as Jiang Chen was about to tell them his name, he saw a disciple who had his gaze locked upon Yan Chen Yu, he kept on checking her body out, and his eyes were glowing brightly.
“Hey pretty girl, what’s your purpose for coming to the Black Sect? Big Bro here can help you!”
The disciple kept smiling at Yan Chen Yu, but he had no idea that his actions just now had offended someone’s taboo.
“You better watch where you’re looking.”
Jiang Chen glared at the disciple and spoke bluntly, then he continued walking up the mountain. If that disciple wasn’t from the Black Sect, he would have already died because of his actions.
“What the fuck? Who is this guy, why is he so arrogant? And how dare he act so wildly in our Black Sect?”
“Brat, stop there!”

The three disciples rolled their eyes, then they chased up and blocked Jiang Chen’s path. The fat guy even showed a fierce expression. This guy came out of nowhere and dared to act wildly in the Black Sect; he was now marked for death.
“Get out of my way.”
Jiang Chen furrowed his brows. He wanted to be more polite, but their responses had disappointed him.
“Damn, this guy is just too arrogant!”
That fat man scolded.
Slap~

Just as the fat man finished his words, a slap hit his face with speed resembling lightning. Followed by the crystal clear sound of someone being slapped, the more than 200 pound fat man fell onto the ground and cried out in pain.
“How dare you attack someone from the Black Sect? You’re courting death!”

Another man saw this young man, who had come out of nowhere, dare attack a disciple from the Black Sect. However, before he could finish his words, he was also slapped and sent flying into the ground. He was in the same situation as the fat man.

The last man was startled. He opened his mouth widely and stared at Jiang Chen with a look of disbelief. Jiang Chen’s aggressiveness had shocked him. There had never been anyone who had dared to attack a Black Sect disciple at this place. This was ridiculous.
“You... you... you, just wait here! You wait here for me!”
The disciple finally responded. He turned around and started running towards the mountain top.
“Kaka, that fellow is going to get some help!”
Big Yellow was laughing out loud.
“Never thought this would happen when we arrived here, this is disappointing.”
Yan Chen Yu showed a pouting expression.
“We can use this opportunity to build up my reputation. We’ll just wait here, let’s see if he can get help from Guan Yi Yun.”
Jiang Chen crossed his arms around his chest. A light smile emerged on his face. He didn’t rush up towards the mountain top, instead, he started waiting for someone to come here and invite him up.

Not long after this, 7-8 disciples wearing white clothes came down from the mountain top with fierce expressions. The leading man was a tall guy with a beard-covered face. Next to him was the disciple who went up to get help.
“They are all novice disciples at the Qi Hai realm, not strong enough for us.”
Big Yellow squatted down on a rock next to him while wiggling his tail leisurely.
“Senior disciple Liu, that’s him, that’s the guy who attacked us!”
The disciple pointed his finger at Jiang Chen. The senior novice disciple, Liu, had a fierce expression as he looked at the two men lying on the ground, then he stared at Jiang Chen angrily.

Senior disciple Liu was pretty famous amongst all the novice disciples. His cultivation realm had also reached the peak of the Qi Hai realm. The other novice disciples who followed along were also somewhat famous amongst the novice disciples.
“Brat, do you know where this place is?”
Senior disciple Liu stood in front of Jiang Chen and spoke in a harsh tone.
“Get lost, you’re not qualified to talk with me.”
Jiang Chen spoke in an indifferent manner.
“The fuck?”

Senior disciple Liu instantly became angry. With his status, no one amongst the novice disciples would dare disrespect him. But this brat who came out from nowhere actually asked him to get lost. Fuck, this was the Black Sect’s territory.
“I think you’re courting...”
Slap!

The same thing as before happened. Senior disciple Liu didn’t have the chance to finish his words before he was slapped and sent flying down onto the ground. The rest of the disciples showed expressions of disbelief. Senior disciple Liu was one of the strongest disciples amongst the novice disciples, but he was slapped by this guy as well. This young man was just too strong.
Not allowing them more time to express their shock, Jiang Chen took a step forward, then; slap, slap, slap, slap...
Crystal clear slapping sounds that sounded like the explosion of fireworks. Those 7-8 men who came here were now spread out on the ground. Sorrowful noises came from all disciples on the ground.

The novice disciple who went looking for help was still standing there, but this time he was completely startled. He couldn’t help but look at the messy situation in front of him and think that this young man was just too mean. He never said too much, he just slapped them once they arrived.
“Go ahead, go get more help.”
Jiang Chen smiled.
“Fine, fine! Just you wait!”

The disciple was trembling as he once again ran up the mountain with great speed. Not long after that, another three men descended the mountain. Aside from the disciple who went looking for help, there were another two young men.
These two men were even more arrogant, and their cultivation realm was even stronger. Both of them had reached the Early Mortal Core realm, and were outer circle disciples of the Black Sect.

In the Black Sect, the difference between novice disciples and outer circle disciples was huge. It was just like the difference between the outer circle disciples and inner circle disciples, their statuses just couldn’t be compared.
“Senior disciple Huang, look, this is the guy who beat up our men!”
The novice disciple pointed at Jiang Chen once again.

When the two outer circle disciples saw the number of people laying on the ground, their anger started boiling. Senior disciple Huang laid his vision on Jiang Chen and examined him, he wanted to see who the person with such big guts was.
“Brat, I don’t care who you are, when you dared to come to our Black Sect and started beating our men, you were just courting death! I want you to kneel down immediately and apologize to them!”

Senior disciple Huang had an imposing aura. He wanted Jiang Chen to kneel down. It was pretty obvious that they were just some small potatoes amongst the outer circle disciples who didn’t participate in the Qi Province competition. If not, they wouldn’t be so arrogant upon seeing Jiang Chen.
“What’s your name?”
Jiang Chen asked.
“Fuck, are you deaf? Senior disciple Huang is asking you to kneel down!”
Another Mortal Core disciple scolded. He raised his palm and prepared to slap Jiang Chen.
Slap!

Another crystal clear slapping sound. It wasn’t Jiang Chen who was slapped, it was that arrogant Mortal Core disciple. The man was slapped by Jiang Chen and fell down onto the ground. He struggled for a bit, but he was unable to stand up again.

What happened had shocked everyone. Senior disciple Huang opened his eyes widely, and the novice disciple was completely frightened. Slapping a novice disciple and an outer circle disciple were two totally different concepts. Just who was this young man? He was just too strong!
Slap!

Another slap! Jiang Chen’s palm hit senior disciple Huang’s cheeks. The arrogant senior disciple Huang didn’t have the time to respond, the slap made him spin three times. However, because Jiang Chen had controlled his force, this senior disciple Huang didn’t fall down.
“You... You... You just wait here! You just wait!”
Senior disciple Huang turned around and started running towards the mountain top, replacing the role of the novice disciple.

The novice disciple stood blankly in the same spot. Fear covered his entire face, he was hoping that Jiang Chen could slap him as well and make him unconscious. However, Jiang Chen didn’t. To him, this was torture, he could only stand there without moving a single inch.

Not long after that, another two men descended the mountain. One of them was senior disciple Huang, and the other one was someone who had a much higher cultivation realm. He was emitting the qi of a Late Mortal Core warrior.

These two men moved with great speed. Soon, they had descended half the mountain. The Late Mortal Core disciple first looked at those disciples who were laying on the ground and crying in sorrow, then he looked at Jiang Chen. When he saw Jiang Chen’s face, then Yan Chen Yu, and then Big Yellow who was standing beside him, his expression immediately changed.
“Senior disciple Wang, this is the guy! He dares come to the Black Sect and cause trouble, and he also beat up our men! Please cripple him, beat him till his mom can’t recognize him!”

The disciple named Huang pointed at Jiang Chen and spoke in a fierce manner. With a winning expression, he was ready to witness the look of horror on Jiang Chen’s face. Senior disciple Wang was one of the strongest outer circle disciples, he could surely beat this guy until even his mother couldn’t recognize him.
“I will cripple your arrogance! I, your father, will beat you till your mother can’t recognize you!”
Senior disciple Wang immediately became furious. Without saying anything else, he slapped senior disciple Huang’s face.
What? What was this all about?
Huang’s mind went blank after being slapped, what happened? Didn’t senior disciple Wang come here to help him? Why did he slap me instead?
“Senior disciple Wang, why did you slap me?”
Disciple Huang felt wronged.
“Why can’t I slap you?! I’ll make your dog eyes blind!”

He was Jiang Chen, and the beautiful girl was Yan Chen Yu.
Plop!

Disciple Huang immediately cried out. After the Qi Province competition, there was no one in the Black Sect who didn’t know the name Jiang Chen.

They were probably only novice disciples, which was the lowest disciple rank.

“Who are you?
Why are you trespassing within the Black Sect?
Are you courting death?”
A fat guy said in an arrogant tone, he was portraying a superior image.
Jiang Chen was amused by their response.
The disciples from a big sect are indeed different.

“Hey pretty girl, what’s your purpose for coming to the Black Sect?

The disciple kept smiling at Yan Chen Yu, but he had no idea that his actions just now had offended someone’s taboo.
“You better watch where you’re looking.”
Jiang Chen glared at the disciple and spoke bluntly, then he continued walking up the mountain.
If that disciple wasn’t from the Black Sect, he would have already died because of his actions.
“What the fuck?
Who is this guy, why is he so arrogant?
And how dare he act so wildly in our Black Sect?”
“Brat, stop there!”
The three disciples rolled their eyes, then they chased up and blocked Jiang Chen’s path.
The fat guy even showed a fierce expression.
This guy came out of nowhere and dared to act wildly in the Black Sect; he was now marked for death.
“Get out of my way.”
Jiang Chen furrowed his brows.
He wanted to be more polite, but their responses had disappointed him.
“Damn, this guy is just too arrogant!”
That fat man scolded.
Slap~
Just as the fat man finished his words, a slap hit his face with speed resembling lightning.
Followed by the crystal clear sound of someone being slapped, the more than 200 pound fat man fell onto the ground and cried out in pain.
“How dare you attack someone from the Black Sect?
You’re courting death!”
Another man saw this young man, who had come out of nowhere, dare attack a disciple from the Black Sect.
However, before he could finish his words, he was also slapped and sent flying into the ground.
He was in the same situation as the fat man.
The last man was startled.
He opened his mouth widely and stared at Jiang Chen with a look of disbelief.
Jiang Chen’s aggressiveness had shocked him.
There had never been anyone who had dared to attack a Black Sect disciple at this place.
This was ridiculous.
“You... you... you, just wait here!
You wait here for me!”
The disciple finally responded.
He turned around and started running towards the mountain top.
“Kaka, that fellow is going to get some help!”
Big Yellow was laughing out loud.
“Never thought this would happen when we arrived here, this is disappointing.”
Yan Chen Yu showed a pouting expression.
“We can use this opportunity to build up my reputation.
We’ll just wait here, let’s see if he can get help from Guan Yi Yun.”
Jiang Chen crossed his arms around his chest.
A light smile emerged on his face.
He didn’t rush up towards the mountain top, instead, he started waiting for someone to come here and invite him up.
Not long after this, 7-8 disciples wearing white clothes came down from the mountain top with fierce expressions.
The leading man was a tall guy with a beard-covered face.
Next to him was the disciple who went up to get help.
“They are all novice disciples at the Qi Hai realm, not strong enough for us.”
Big Yellow squatted down on a rock next to him while wiggling his tail leisurely.
“Senior disciple Liu, that’s him, that’s the guy who attacked us!”
The disciple pointed his finger at Jiang Chen.
The senior novice disciple, Liu, had a fierce expression as he looked at the two men lying on the ground, then he stared at Jiang Chen angrily.
Senior disciple Liu was pretty famous amongst all the novice disciples.
His cultivation realm had also reached the peak of the Qi Hai realm.
The other novice disciples who followed along were also somewhat famous amongst the novice disciples.
“Brat, do you know where this place is?”
Senior disciple Liu stood in front of Jiang Chen and spoke in a harsh tone.
“Get lost, you’re not qualified to talk with me.”
Jiang Chen spoke in an indifferent manner.
“The fuck?”
Senior disciple Liu instantly became angry.
With his status, no one amongst the novice disciples would dare disrespect him.
But this brat who came out from nowhere actually asked him to get lost.
Fuck, this was the Black Sect’s territory.
“I think you’re courting...”
Slap!
The same thing as before happened.
Senior disciple Liu didn’t have the chance to finish his words before he was slapped and sent flying down onto the ground.
The rest of the disciples showed expressions of disbelief.

This young man was just too strong.

chapters.title: Chapter 107 - This is Fame
paragraphs: When hearing the name Jiang Chen, those who were making sorrowful noises on the ground immediately had a change in expression. Their faces turned grey, and they wished to slap themselves a few times.
This was what was called being blind as a bat, to have eyes but fail to recognize Mt Tai. You won’t die if you don’t look for trouble, but this could precisely be described as looking for trouble.
Feeling wrong after taking a beating? Serves you right!

Disciple Huang straight away started crying like a baby, what had he just done? He had been arrogant in front of senior disciple Jiang Chen, and he had even said he wanted to beat senior disciple Jiang Chen so much that even his mother wouldn’t recognize him. He was courting death.

Everyone gazed at the novice disciple who had just fainted. If looks could kill someone, then this disciple would have been killed a thousand times. If it wasn’t for this novice disciple asking for their help, there would have been no way for them to offend Jiang Chen.

This was Jiang Chen. Within just one day, his story had spread across the entire Black Sect. He had gotten first place in the Qi Province competition, he had killed Ling Ao and Li Wu Shuang, and he had a fight with Nan Bei Chao in one year. Although they had yet to see Jiang Chen’s face, he had already been the idol of many of the Black Sect disciples.
‘Damn it, I had the audacity to offend the idol I had yet to meet... There’s nothing wrong with me being beaten until I looked like a pig’s head!’

Not only did they not feel wronged, these men even felt blessed. They were luckily disciples of the Black Sect, and thankfully, Jiang Chen showed mercy. They had heard that Jiang Chen was a cruel man. He dared to kill Ling Ao and Li Wu Shuang in front of Nan Bei Chao and Liang Xiao. Today they had provoked this Jiang Chen, and if he killed them with a slap, then there would be no place for them to complain. The sect wouldn’t punish a genius because of some outer circle disciples.
“All of you bastards, hurry up and apologize to senior disciple Jiang! You should all be thankful that senior disciple Jiang is showing mercy!”
Wang Yun glanced around and scolded loudly.

Hearing this, those disciples didn’t dare show any hesitation. All of them struggled as they stood up from the ground. They couldn’t be blamed for this clumsy response, Jiang Chen had slapped them pretty hard, making it difficult for them to move.

After being slapped and still needing to climb up and apologize, supposing they would’ve felt wronged, but none of them felt wronged at all, just like what Wang Yun said, they should be thankful to Jiang Chen’s mercy, if it was according to senior disciple Jiang Chen’s approach, they would be dead corpses by now.
“That’s enough.”
Jiang Chen casually waved his hand as he continued walking up the Black Mountain. Yan Chen Yu and Big Yellow followed behind him, proudly ascending the mountain.

Wang Yun showed a regretful expression when these disciple didn’t live up to Jiang Chen’s expectations, then he once again scolded disciple Huang before he started running to catch up with Jiang Chen.

Disciple Huang sat down on the ground again, he was just like a lost soul. His face had an expression of one feeling wronged. He felt like crying when he thought about his future position in the Black Sect. He let out another loud cry again.

Damn, he had offended Jiang Chen, how was he going to mix in with the rest of the disciples of the Black Sect in the future? Although he was also an outer circle disciple, could he really be compared with Jiang Chen? Although this was Jiang Chen’s first day here, his position amongst all outer circle disciples was not any weaker than Han Yan’s.
“Fucking idiots! Who was the one in charge of guarding the mountain today?!”

Disciple Huang roared at all the disciples in front of him. It almost seemed like fire was going to shoot out from his eyes. His name was Huang Zheng, and he had been doing pretty well in the Black Sect. However, after what happened today, it could be said that his future was completely ruined.
“Senior disciple Huang, those three were supposed to guard the mountain today!”

One of the disciples pointed out the three novice disciple who were the ones in charge of protecting the mountain today. One of them immediately fainted, and when the other two saw that they were pointed out, their faces immediately turned grey, then they kneeled down on the ground because of fear.
“Senior disciple Huang, we’re sorry, we didn’t know that he was Jiang Chen!”
One of the disciples kept crying. When he recalled that he was checking out Yan Chen Yu in front of Jiang Chen, he started wishing for himself to die.

“Damn it, do you have eyes where your butt is? Can’t even recognize senior disciple Jiang, are you really guarding this place properly? I, your father, had his future ruined because of you three bastards.”
Huang Zheng scolded with harsh words. He walked up and kicked these two disciples onto the ground.

Both of these disciples were crying out in sorrow. In their hearts, they couldn’t help but wish to scold back. Did you, Huang Zheng, recognize Jiang Chen just now? If you could recognize him, would your future be ruined? If you want to blame something, then you can blame your own dog’s eyes! This had nothing to do with us! Just look at that Wang Yun, perhaps he will get praised by senior disciple Jiang later, and will be protected by senior disciple Jiang in the future. Who would dare mess with him in the Black Sect then?
“Because of you three bastards, we offended senior disciple Jiang! Let’s beat them!”
“That’s right! Let’s beat them until even their mothers can’t recognize them!”
The angry disciples had just found a method to release their anger; those three disciples in charge of guarding the mountain had instantly become their targets.
Bang bang bang...
Ah ahh ahhh...
This was terrible. Nevertheless, this was human nature.
The guard trio had met ultimate misfortune today. They had never encountered anything like this before while they were standing guard. It was just their bad luck to encounter Jiang Chen today.
The unluckiest one was probably the novice disciple who had fainted. He was awakened because of the beating from the others, then he fainted once again because of the beating.
“That’s enough, stop beating them. There’s no use even if we beat them to death.”
Huang Zheng said. If they continued beating them, then these three would definitely die.
“Brothers, do you all still want to get along well in the Black Sect?”
Huang Zheng asked.
“Of course, it has always been my dream to be a part of the Black Sect!”

Someone amongst the disciples said. The Black Sect was one of the Qi Province’s four big sects, and joining it did not only represent one’s status, but being able to cultivate here was also much more beneficial than anywhere outside. There was an underground vein underneath the Black Mountain, this place couldn’t be compared with anywhere else. It didn’t matter if it was the natural Yuan energy in the air, or the cultivation resources, all the disciples on the spot had gone through hard effort in order to become disciples. Of course, every one of them wanted to continue staying in the Black Sect and have a good future.
“After offending senior disciple Jiang, you’re still thinking about how to get along well with him.”
Huang Zheng said again, then he looked at the three novice disciples rolling around on the ground making noises. He was trying his best to resist kicking them once again.
“Then what should we do, senior disciple Huang? Please give us advice!”

Someone said. The situation now was pretty obvious, Jiang Chen had taken first place in the Qi Province competition, he had also killed Ling Ao from the Burning Sky Pavilion and Li Wu Shuang from the Heavenly Sword Sect, and he also had an agreement to fight Nan Bei Chao in one year. Such an outstanding genius who was just like Nan Bei Chao and couldn’t be found even in the last thousand years in the Qi Province, now that he had joined the Black Sect, he would definitely get lots of attention from the management. Jiang Chen would just need to mention this event, and none of them would be able to continue staying here.

Even worse, Jiang Chen might not need to say anything. If today’s events were known by others, they would all become public enemies and become the other disciple’s targets. At that point of time, there would surely be someone who wanted to lick Jiang Chen’s boots and find trouble with them. If this truly happened, then they would have a hard time in the sect.

“I’ll go find senior disciple Wang Yun later and ask him to help us arrange a meeting with senior disciple Jiang Chen. All of us will go and apologize to senior disciple Jiang Chen! At that time, all of you will need to pay some price, take out some Mortal Restoration Pills or treasures that you think are valuable. With senior disciple Jiang’s status, I’m sure he won’t really bother about what happened!”
Huang Zheng continued, “Now let me ask you all, if any of you are unwilling to go or are unwilling to take out money, stand out now!”
Who dares to stand out? Who is unwilling? If some money was enough to solve this disastrous situation, they’ll get exactly what they’ve been hoping for.

Besides, most of the disciples on the spot were from big families in the Qi Province. Those who could come to the Black Sect and cultivate usually had families that were doing quite well, they didn’t really mind paying some price.
“All of us are willing to do this! Senior disciple Huang, we’ll just let you handle this.”
Someone said.
“Fine, carry these three bastards as well. Later, ask them if they agree or not.”

Huang Zheng angrily gazed at the trio who were lying on the ground. Nevertheless, he was still thinking about helping them. This proves that Huang Zheng could still be considered a nice guy. If he brought everyone except for the trio to apologize to Jiang Chen, then the trio wouldn’t be able to get along well in the sect in the future.
Being led by Wang Yun, Jiang Chen and the other two crossed the outer perimeter of the Black Mountain and arrived at the place where all outer circle disciples were staying.

There were a lot of mountains within the Black Mountain range. From the border where the novice disciples were, to the outer circle disciples’ region, then to the inner circle disciples’ zone; they all had their own respective territories.
Besides, the deeper one went, the richer the natural Yuan energies were. This would no doubt serve to increase the healthy competition among the disciples.

“Senior disciple Jiang, senior disciple Guan Yi Yun has specifically arranged a special place for senior disciple Jiang to stay and cultivate. He has also ordered that no matter whoever receives senior disciple Jiang, they can not show any neglect. Being able to personally receive senior disciple Jiang, this is truly I, Wang Yun’s honor!”
Wang Yun said.
“Where is Han Yan?”
Jiang Chen asked.

“Senior disciple Han immediately entered closed door cultivation upon returning. However, before he began his closed door cultivation, he had had informed all of us, and now everyone in the Black Sect knows that senior disciple Jiang and senior disciple Han are good brothers! I heard that senior disciple Guan Yi Yun also entered closed door cultivation upon returning. Besides, senior disciple Guan has a high position in the sect, and he normally won’t come to the outer circle disciples’ zone. He is someone we all look up to, and this time he came here personally to make arrangements, and this was all because of senior disciple Jiang!”

Wang Yun said. What he said was pretty obvious, from now on, every single outer circle disciple would take Jiang Chen as their leader. A strong man would be followed blindly no matter where he went, this was one fact that could be applied everywhere.

Jiang Chen nodded his head. Han Yan and Guan Yi Yun entering secluded cultivation at the same time was expected by him. The Ancient Devil in Han Yan’s body was going to awaken, and after this secluded cultivation session, he would be able to break through to the Heavenly Core realm.

As for Guan Yi Yun, he was defeated by Nan Bei Chao in the Qi Province competition with just a single strike. His confidence had surely suffered greatly. As a prideful man who would never admit defeat, he wouldn’t allow this to happen again. Therefore, Guan Yi Yun should be attempting to break through to the Divine Core realm during his secluded cultivation.
“Eh, who is that guy? He doesn’t look like someone from our Black Sect, and Wang Yun is even following behind, it looks like he is being very respectful towards that guy.”
“That’s right, I have never seen him before. A young man who can make senior disciple Wang Yun nod and bow, I guess he must be someone important.”
“I know! That’s Jiang Chen, I’m sure he is Jiang Chen!”
Along the way, they met a lot of outer circle disciples. All of them were clueless about Wang Yun’s behaviour, but soon, someone managed to guess Jiang Chen’s identity.

Although this was Jiang Chen’s first day here, his position amongst all outer circle disciples was not any weaker than Han Yan’s.
“Fucking idiots!
Who was the one in charge of guarding the mountain today?!”
Disciple Huang roared at all the disciples in front of him.
It almost seemed like fire was going to shoot out from his eyes.
His name was Huang Zheng, and he had been doing pretty well in the Black Sect.
However, after what happened today, it could be said that his future was completely ruined.
“Senior disciple Huang, those three were supposed to guard the mountain today!”
One of the disciples pointed out the three novice disciple who were the ones in charge of protecting the mountain today.
One of them immediately fainted, and when the other two saw that they were pointed out, their faces immediately turned grey, then they kneeled down on the ground because of fear.
“Senior disciple Huang, we’re sorry, we didn’t know that he was Jiang Chen!”
One of the disciples kept crying.
When he recalled that he was checking out Yan Chen Yu in front of Jiang Chen, he started wishing for himself to die.
“Damn it, do you have eyes where your butt is?
Can’t even recognize senior disciple Jiang, are you really guarding this place properly?
I, your father, had his future ruined because of you three bastards.”
Huang Zheng scolded with harsh words.
He walked up and kicked these two disciples onto the ground.
Both of these disciples were crying out in sorrow.
In their hearts, they couldn’t help but wish to scold back.
Did you, Huang Zheng, recognize Jiang Chen just now?
If you could recognize him, would your future be ruined?
If you want to blame something, then you can blame your own dog’s eyes!
This had nothing to do with us!
Just look at that Wang Yun, perhaps he will get praised by senior disciple Jiang later, and will be protected by senior disciple Jiang in the future.
Who would dare mess with him in the Black Sect then?
“Because of you three bastards, we offended senior disciple Jiang!
Let’s beat them!”
“That’s right!
Let’s beat them until even their mothers can’t recognize them!”
The angry disciples had just found a method to release their anger; those three disciples in charge of guarding the mountain had instantly become their targets.
Bang bang bang...
Ah ahh ahhh...
This was terrible.
Nevertheless, this was human nature.
The guard trio had met ultimate misfortune today.
They had never encountered anything like this before while they were standing guard.
It was just their bad luck to encounter Jiang Chen today.
The unluckiest one was probably the novice disciple who had fainted.
He was awakened because of the beating from the others, then he fainted once again because of the beating.
“That’s enough, stop beating them.
There’s no use even if we beat them to death.”
Huang Zheng said.
If they continued beating them, then these three would definitely die.
“Brothers, do you all still want to get along well in the Black Sect?”
Huang Zheng asked.
“Of course, it has always been my dream to be a part of the Black Sect!”
Someone amongst the disciples said.
The Black Sect was one of the Qi Province’s four big sects, and joining it did not only represent one’s status, but being able to cultivate here was also much more beneficial than anywhere outside.
There was an underground vein underneath the Black Mountain, this place couldn’t be compared with anywhere else.
It didn’t matter if it was the natural Yuan energy in the air, or the cultivation resources, all the disciples on the spot had gone through hard effort in order to become disciples.
Of course, every one of them wanted to continue staying in the Black Sect and have a good future.
“After offending senior disciple Jiang, you’re still thinking about how to get along well with him.”
Huang Zheng said again, then he looked at the three novice disciples rolling around on the ground making noises.
He was trying his best to resist kicking them once again.
“Then what should we do, senior disciple Huang?
Please give us advice!”
Someone said.

The situation now was pretty obvious, Jiang Chen had taken first place in the Qi Province competition, he had also killed Ling Ao from the Burning Sky Pavilion and Li Wu Shuang from the Heavenly Sword Sect, and he also had an agreement to fight Nan Bei Chao in one year.

Such an outstanding genius who was just like Nan Bei Chao and couldn’t be found even in the last thousand years in the Qi Province, now that he had joined the Black Sect, he would definitely get lots of attention from the management.
Jiang Chen would just need to mention this event, and none of them would be able to continue staying here.
Even worse, Jiang Chen might not need to say anything.
If today’s events were known by others, they would all become public enemies and become the other disciple’s targets.
At that point of time, there would surely be someone who wanted to lick Jiang Chen’s boots and find trouble with them.
If this truly happened, then they would have a hard time in the sect.
“I’ll go find senior disciple Wang Yun later and ask him to help us arrange a meeting with senior disciple Jiang Chen.
All of us will go and apologize to senior disciple Jiang Chen!
At that time, all of you will need to pay some price, take out some Mortal Restoration Pills or treasures that you think are valuable.
With senior disciple Jiang’s status, I’m sure he won’t really bother about what happened!”
Huang Zheng continued, “Now let me ask you all, if any of you are unwilling to go or are unwilling to take out money, stand out now!”
Who dares to stand out?
Who is unwilling?
If some money was enough to solve this disastrous situation, they’ll get exactly what they’ve been hoping for.
Besides, most of the disciples on the spot were from big families in the Qi Province.
Those who could come to the Black Sect and cultivate usually had families that were doing quite well, they didn’t really mind paying some price.
“All of us are willing to do this!
Senior disciple Huang, we’ll just let you handle this.”
Someone said.
“Fine, carry these three bastards as well.
Later, ask them if they agree or not.”
Huang Zheng angrily gazed at the trio who were lying on the ground.
Nevertheless, he was still thinking about helping them.
This proves that Huang Zheng could still be considered a nice guy.
If he brought everyone except for the trio to apologize to Jiang Chen, then the trio wouldn’t be able to get along well in the sect in the future.
Being led by Wang Yun, Jiang Chen and the other two crossed the outer perimeter of the Black Mountain and arrived at the place where all outer circle disciples were staying.
There were a lot of mountains within the Black Mountain range.
From the border where the novice disciples were, to the outer circle disciples’ region, then to the inner circle disciples’ zone; they all had their own respective territories.
Besides, the deeper one went, the richer the natural Yuan energies were.
This would no doubt serve to increase the healthy competition among the disciples.
“Senior disciple Jiang, senior disciple Guan Yi Yun has specifically arranged a special place for senior disciple Jiang to stay and cultivate.
He has also ordered that no matter whoever receives senior disciple Jiang, they can not show any neglect.
Being able to personally receive senior disciple Jiang, this is truly I, Wang Yun’s honor!”
Wang Yun said.
“Where is Han Yan?”
Jiang Chen asked.
“Senior disciple Han immediately entered closed door cultivation upon returning.
However, before he began his closed door cultivation, he had had informed all of us, and now everyone in the Black Sect knows that senior disciple Jiang and senior disciple Han are good brothers!
I heard that senior disciple Guan Yi Yun also entered closed door cultivation upon returning.
Besides, senior disciple Guan has a high position in the sect, and he normally won’t come to the outer circle disciples’ zone.
He is someone we all look up to, and this time he came here personally to make arrangements, and this was all because of senior disciple Jiang!”
Wang Yun said.
What he said was pretty obvious, from now on, every single outer circle disciple would take Jiang Chen as their leader.
A strong man would be followed blindly no matter where he went, this was one fact that could be applied everywhere.
Jiang Chen nodded his head.
Han Yan and Guan Yi Yun entering secluded cultivation at the same time was expected by him.
The Ancient Devil in Han Yan’s body was going to awaken, and after this secluded cultivation session, he would be able to break through to the Heavenly Core realm.
As for Guan Yi Yun, he was defeated by Nan Bei Chao in the Qi Province competition with just a single strike.
His confidence had surely suffered greatly.
As a prideful man who would never admit defeat, he wouldn’t allow this to happen again.
Therefore, Guan Yi Yun should be attempting to break through to the Divine Core realm during his secluded cultivation.
“Eh, who is that guy?
He doesn’t look like someone from our Black Sect, and Wang Yun is even following behind, it looks like he is being very respectful towards that guy.”
“That’s right, I have never seen him before.
A young man who can make senior disciple Wang Yun nod and bow, I guess he must be someone important.”
“I know!
That’s Jiang Chen, I’m sure he is Jiang Chen!”
Along the way, they met a lot of outer circle disciples.
All of them were clueless about Wang Yun’s behaviour, but soon, someone managed to guess Jiang Chen’s identity.

chapters.title: Chapter 108 - Guidance
paragraphs: A young man whom no one had met before was able to make Wang Yun, a Late Mortal Core warrior, bow his head. Perhaps only the rising star Jiang Chen would be able to do this. It was a pretty good guess.
Right at this moment, two outer circle disciple walked up from ahead. When they saw Jiang Chen, they immediately greeted him.
“Senior disciple Jiang Chen, you have settled your matters! That was fast!”
“Welcome to the Black Sect, senior disciple Jiang Chen! I hope that senior disciple Jiang Chen can guide us in the future!”

The two of them bowed their heads. With this, Jiang Chen’s identity had been confirmed. Those who hadn’t participated in the Qi Province competition all had their eyes wide open as they looked at Jiang Chen from head to toe.
“Heavens! He is Jiang Chen, he looks so young, perhaps only 15-16 years old!”
“I heard he killed Ling Ao and Li Wu Shuang while he was only an Early Mortal Core warrior! This man looks so delicate and handsome, it’s hard to think that he is such a fierce man!”

“Lower your voice, senior disciple Jiang Chen will be the outer circle disciples’ leader in the future. He has a fight with Nan Bei Chao one year from now, and he will surely get all the attention from the top management!”
“Wow! Senior disciple Jiang Chen is so handsome, it would be nice if I could be his girlfriend!”

“Get lost! You haven’t even seen your own face, open your eyes and look at that purple clothed girl beside Jiang Chen, she should be senior disciple Yan Chen Yu. If senior disciple Yan is the swan, then you can’t even be compared with a wild goose! Only this kind of girl can match senior disciple Jiang!”

The surrounding disciples’ discussions became heated. Although people were communicating privately with quiet voices, Jiang Chen had good hearing, so he heard every single word spoken. He couldn’t help but laugh and shake his head. He had never expected that even before coming to the Black Sect, he would already become so famous.

Obviously, his fame was spread out by those outer circle disciples who had participated in the Qi Province competition. The Black Sect was only so big, and a big event such as the Qi Province competition, it wouldn’t take more than an hour before even the lowest ranked disciple knew the result.

“Alright, alright, carry on with your own matters. Senior disciple Jiang has gone through a long a journey, I will need to bring him to his residence. In the future, if you have any questions regarding cultivation, senior disciple Jiang will show you some guidance.”
Wang Yun waved at the disciples, then he continued leading Jiang Chen towards the inner part.

Along the way, they met quite a number of disciples who had participated in the Qi Province competition. All of them happily greeted Jiang Chen when they saw him. The disciples of the Black Sect weren’t idiots, pleasing Jiang Chen may not give them any advantages, but it surely wouldn’t bring them any disadvantages either.
Not to mention his relationship with the Little Devil King Han Yan and Guan Yi Yun, just Jiang Chen’s way of doing things alone made him deserving of all the respect.
“Kid, I never expected you to be so famous here. Even I, your father’s glory has been overshadowed by yours, you’re too presumptuous.”
Big Yellow said with a hint of dissatisfaction.
“Don’t speak if you’ve got nothing to say.”
Jiang Chen gazed at Big Yellow. If this dog could behave a little better in the Black Sect, then Jiang Chen would be glad.
“Puppy dog, this is the Black Sect, you better not mess around.”
Yan Chen Yu patted Big Yellow’s head and reminded him.
After following Wang Yun for a bit, they arrived at the outer circle disciples’ living quarters.
The living quarters for the outer circle disciples were located between the mountains. They were lined up in rows of fine courtyards and ancient buildings.

“Senior disciple Jiang, these are the living quarters for our outer circle disciples. They are normally in the form of courtyards, and the buildings are connected to the underground energy vein. Normally, six people will stay in one living quarter within a courtyard. Late Mortal Core disciples can own an entire courtyard for themselves, and those who break through to the Heavenly Core realm will enter the inner circle.”
Wang Yun said.
“Who is staying in the same living quarter as me?”
Jiang Chen asked with a smile.

“Senior disciple Jiang is making fun of me. Although you haven’t reached the Late Mortal Core realm yet, but with your abilities, you can defeat every single outer circle disciple here. Therefore, senior disciple Guan Yi Yun had specifically ordered us to prepare the best living quarter for senior disciple Jiang.”

Wang Yun led Jiang Chen past the area where all the living quarters were located. Behind the living quarters, a very fine courtyard was built. It was located at the top of the mountain, isolated from the living quarters’ area. It was surrounded by mountains and rivers, and there was even a waterfall nearby. The scene was very soothing, the natural Yuan energy was rich, and it was isolated from all the noise coming from the living quarters’ area. This was simply the best place for cultivation.
“Wow, this place is so beautiful!”
Yan Chen Yu was standing on the mountain top where she could view the entire Black Mountain. The feeling of having the view of all the mountains underneath her feet made her feel happy and relaxed.

There were a total of three well built rooms within the courtyard. Aside from Jiang Chen and Yan Chen Yu, even Big Yellow would be able to have a room of his own. This kind of treatment was unique amongst the outer circle disciples.
Pushing the door open, the decorations in the room were simple. Aside from a bed, there was only a golden praying mat right in the middle of the room. [1]
“Senior disciple Jiang, this praying mat can communicate directly with the underground energy vein. Cultivating on top of it can yield twice the result with half the effort!”
Wang Yun explained. This futon was specifically prepared for Jiang Chen by Guan Yi Yun. Amongst all the outer circle disciples, aside from Han Yan, only Jiang Chen had this special privilege.
“En, not bad, senior disciple Guan is very kind.”
Jiang Chen nodded his head. He felt very thankful to Guan Yi Yun in his mind. The residence he had arranged for him was very unique.
“Is senior disciple Jiang satisfied with this place?”
Wang Yun asked with a smile.
“En, not bad. Wang Yun, what cultivation skill are you cultivating?”
Jiang Chen looked at Wang Yun.
Wang Yun was startled. He didn’t know why Jiang Chen would suddenly ask him about his cultivation skill.
“Senior disciple Jiang, I am cultivating the ‘Water Breaking Script’ from the Black Sect, it is a High Ranked Mortal cultivation skill.”
Wang Yun replied.
“You’re lying, you’re not cultivating the ‘Water Breaking Script’.”
Jiang Chen casually pulled a chair and sat down on it without even looking at Wang Yun.

But Wang Yun’s expression had changed dramatically. He stood still, and he didn’t show a slight hint of his energy, and Jiang Chen was actually able to tell that he wasn’t cultivating the ‘Water Breaking Script’.

“Let me ask you, during the last three months, when the time reaches midnight, does your ‘Origin Pass’ acupuncture point start hurting? Even worse, during the last few days, has the pain become unbearable?”
Jiang Chen asked.
Now, Wang Yun’s expression had completely changed. He opened his eyes widely and stared at Jiang Chen. With a trembling voice he asked, “You, how do you know that?”

“Hmph! Still trying to lie to me when you have cultivated wrongly. With your current condition, it wouldn’t take more than two months before you die because of psychosis. Now tell me, what skill are you cultivating?”
Jiang Chen let out a cold snort. If it wasn’t for Wang Yun behaving well today, he wouldn’t bother showing him any guidance at all.
Plop!

Hearing that he would die within two months because of psychosis, Wang Yun kneeled down in front of Jiang Chen, and without daring to hide anything else, he said, “Senior disciple Jiang is truly a genius, you were able to tell my symptoms with just a look! You’re right, the ‘Water Breaking Skill’ is just a cover up method. I am cultivating a Mid Ranked Earth skill called the ‘Cloudy Rock Skill’. I obtained this skill by accident during an expedition. An Earth ranked skill is much more valuable than a Mortal ranked skill, and I was unable to resist its temptation, so I began cultivating it. This skill is really weird, and I have no idea what went wrong. Three months ago, I began feeling pain in my ‘Origin Pass’ acupuncture point, and to this day, the pain has reached an unbearable state. Please, senior disciple Jiang, I beg of you to save my life!”
If Wang Yun previously only felt fear towards Jiang Chen, then he had now begun worshipping Jiang Chen like a god.
“Circulate your ‘Cloudy Rock Skill’.”
Jiang Chen said indifferently.
“Yes!”

Wang Yun didn’t dare show any neglect, he immediately begun circulating the ‘Cloudy Rock Skill’. A cold breeze emerged from his body which contained a slight evil feeling. Jiang Chen looked at him carefully and found out that when Wang Yun began circulating the ‘Cloudy Rock Skill’, there was an evil light within his eyes. That was a symptom of psychosis.
“Stop it.”

Jiang Chen asked Wang Yun to stop circulating the skill and said, “The ‘Cloudy Rock Skill’ by itself is a skill more partial towards yin and coldness. Although it can’t be considered a modest skill, but it’s not an evil skill either. Nevertheless, you have entered the wrong path, turning it into an evil skill. When you first obtained the ‘Cloudy Rock Skill’, you were absorbing the natural Yin Qi at night, and you even absorbed some evil Yin Qi. Cultivating the ‘Cloudy Rock Skill’ with this method can indeed give you a cultivation boost for a short period of time, but because of this, you have also destroyed yourself.
“Mighty senior disciple Jiang, please save me senior disciple Jiang!”

Wang Yun kept kowtowing to Jiang Chen. The only thing he felt for Jiang Chen right now was that he was a man he highly admired. He had only circulated the ‘Cloudy Rock Skill’ once, and Jiang Chen was really able to tell how he had been cultivating it. Wang Yun felt like he was a transparent man in front of Jiang Chen, he couldn’t hide any secrets in front of him.

In Wang Yun’s mind, the young man who sat in the chair in front of him was not a young man any more, but a wise senior who was able to do anything. With just a few words he had made him know the seriousness of the skill that he had been cultivating.
“Stand up and walk towards me.”
Jiang Chen said.
Wang Yun stood up, then he moved closer to Jiang Chen and respectfully stood in front of him, it was as if he was a child who had just done something wrong.

“I told you just now, the ‘Cloudy Rock Skill’ by itself is a skill that’s more partial towards yin and coldness, but it isn’t an evil skill. You previously cultivated the ‘Water Breaking Skill’, and with this as the foundation, you started cultivating the ‘Cloudy Rock Skill’, and this is the problem. Even worse, you chose a cultivation method you shouldn’t have chosen at all. From now on, you need to completely give up on the ‘Water Breaking Skill’ and start cultivating the ‘Cloudy Rock Skill’ with the normal method. Do not purposely absorb Yin Qi.”

After speaking those words, Jiang Chen pointed his finger out with lightning like speed, precisely hitting Wang Yun’s ‘Origin Pass’. Wang Yun felt hot air flowing into his body. Underneath the impact of this hot air, the pain in his ‘Origin Pass’ immediately disappeared.

When the hot air diminished, Wang Yun immediately felt clear-minded and energetic. The abnormal feeling in his ‘Origin Pass’ acupuncture point was completely gone, allowing him to return to his original form.

“Cultivate the ‘Cloudy Rock Skill’ according to what I’ve told you. Tonight, you won’t feel any pain in your ‘Origin Pass’. With your talent, it’ll take you at most half a year before you’ll be able to break through to the Heavenly Core realm and become an inner circle disciple.”
Jiang Chen said.
Plop~

Wang Yun kneeled down on the floor once again and said, “Thank you, senior disciple Jiang for this great kindness! Wang Yun doesn’t have much I can repay you with, but from now on, Wang Yun’s life will belong to senior disciple Jiang! Senior disciple Jiang just needs to tell me what to do, and no matter what it is, I, Wang Yun will definitely accomplish it without even furrowing my brows!”

He had only circulated the ‘Cloudy Rock Skill’ once, and Jiang Chen was really able to tell how he had been cultivating it.
Wang Yun felt like he was a transparent man in front of Jiang Chen, he couldn’t hide any secrets in front of him.
In Wang Yun’s mind, the young man who sat in the chair in front of him was not a young man any more, but a wise senior who was able to do anything.
With just a few words he had made him know the seriousness of the skill that he had been cultivating.
“Stand up and walk towards me.”
Jiang Chen said.
Wang Yun stood up, then he moved closer to Jiang Chen and respectfully stood in front of him, it was as if he was a child who had just done something wrong.
“I told you just now, the ‘Cloudy Rock Skill’ by itself is a skill that’s more partial towards yin and coldness, but it isn’t an evil skill.
You previously cultivated the ‘Water Breaking Skill’, and with this as the foundation, you started cultivating the ‘Cloudy Rock Skill’, and this is the problem.
Even worse, you chose a cultivation method you shouldn’t have chosen at all.
From now on, you need to completely give up on the ‘Water Breaking Skill’ and start cultivating the ‘Cloudy Rock Skill’ with the normal method.
Do not purposely absorb Yin Qi.”
After speaking those words, Jiang Chen pointed his finger out with lightning like speed, precisely hitting Wang Yun’s ‘Origin Pass’.
Wang Yun felt hot air flowing into his body.
Underneath the impact of this hot air, the pain in his ‘Origin Pass’ immediately disappeared.
When the hot air diminished, Wang Yun immediately felt clear-minded and energetic.
The abnormal feeling in his ‘Origin Pass’ acupuncture point was completely gone, allowing him to return to his original form.
“Cultivate the ‘Cloudy Rock Skill’ according to what I’ve told you.
Tonight, you won’t feel any pain in your ‘Origin Pass’.
With your talent, it’ll take you at most half a year before you’ll be able to break through to the Heavenly Core realm and become an inner circle disciple.”
Jiang Chen said.
Plop~
Wang Yun kneeled down on the floor once again and said, “Thank you, senior disciple Jiang for this great kindness!
Wang Yun doesn’t have much I can repay you with, but from now on, Wang Yun’s life will belong to senior disciple Jiang!
Senior disciple Jiang just needs to tell me what to do, and no matter what it is, I, Wang Yun will definitely accomplish it without even furrowing my brows!”

chapters.title: Chapter 109 - The Kindhearted Senior Disciple Jiang
paragraphs: Wang Yun really felt like he had struck gold. At this point in time, his respect and admiration towards Jiang Chen was endless like a river’s stream.
Lucky, he was incredibly lucky. If he hadn’t met Jiang Chen, then he would surely have continued cultivating the ‘Cloudy Rock Skill’ until psychosis took over and he died.

Looks like a kind-heart could earn good rewards. He was behaving pretty well in front of senior disciple Jiang today, and because of that, he was lucky enough to receive guidance from senior disciple Jiang. Not only did he save his life, his future would be limitless as well.
The only thing that puzzled Wang Yun was, Jiang Chen, at such a young age, why did he have the abilities to point out his problems with just a single look? This really puzzled him.
But in the end, Wang Yun just gave credit to his genius talent. In this world, there were many items and people that simply could not be measure by normal standards.
“Stand up. This place isn’t bad, I am very satisfied with it. You deserved my guidance.”
Jiang Chen said. He was portraying an aura of someone from the top. This kind of noble and gracious manner could easily make anyone submit to him.
“Damn, what kind of monster is this guy?”
Big Yellow muttered. The more he followed Jiang Chen, the more mysterious he found Jiang Chen to be.
“Thank you, senior disciple Jiang!”
Wang Yun stood up from the ground, his face carried an expression of gratitude.
“En, you can leave now. Remember, if there’s anything in the sect in the future, come here and inform me.”
Jiang Chen said.
“Alright. I will not disturb senior disciple Jiang and senior disciple Yan’s rest.”

Wang Yun cupped his fists, then turned around and left. This guy was jumping all the way down as he descended the mountain. After obtaining the ‘Cloudy Rock Skill’, this was Wang Yun’s happiest moment.
Big Yellow, while wiggling his tail, slowly started walking out from the courtyard.
“Stop there, Big Yellow, where are you going?”
Jiang Chen squinted his eyes.
“Strolling around. Staying here would be too boring.”
Big Yellow said with a grin on his face.
“No way, just stay here, you’re not allowed to go anywhere.”
Jiang Chen berated. If he let this dog out, perhaps it wouldn’t take long before the entire Black Sect turned chaotic.
“Fuck! I, your father, was going to check if there were any treasures in this Black Sect!”
Big Yellow was not happy.
“If that’s the case, I won’t let you out. You better stay next to me and behave yourself. From now on, wherever I go, you will follow.”

Jiang Chen said. This dog’s ability to sense treasure was the best, and the Black Sect, as one of the four big sects, was sure to have a lot of treasures. If he allows this dog out and cause losses for the Black Sect, then he wouldn’t be able to continue staying here.
“Damn you, how dare you limit my freedom? Damn it! I suddenly feel sleepy, let me sleep first.”
Big Yellow felt depressed. He angrily walked into a room. However, Jiang Chen could clearly see that when Big Yellow entered the room, his body had started glowing in a golden light.
“Don’t tell me this dog is going to break through again? Just by sleeping, he is able to level up... What a weirdo.”

Jiang Chen could still remember, the last time Big Yellow broke through, he was still sleeping. And just now, Jiang Chen could clearly feel the restless Yuan energy within his body; this was a symptom that he was about to break through.

Jiang Chen sighed. The heir of a Divine Demon Beast like Big Yellow always possessed some advantages that no one else could have. You never really knew when Big Yellow was about to break through. And after he broke through, then a new powerful innate ability would also awaken.
“Xiao Yu, do you feel tired after following me?”

Jiang Chen held Yan Chen Yu’s hand and asked gently. Every since they left Red City and up until now, Yan Chen Yu had always followed him around. She had gone through continuous battles and killing, and because of the intense atmosphere, Jiang Chen had rarely taken the time to take care of Yan Chen Yu.

“I’m not tired. As long as I can be by Big Bro Jiang Chen’s side, Xiao Yu doesn’t fear anything. Besides, Big Bro Jiang Chen has introduced me to another kind of life that I previously would have never dared imagine! This is really exciting!”

Yan Chen Yu said with a playful smile. This kind of life was something she would never have dreamed about. If it wasn’t for her following Jiang Chen, even if her Nine Yin Meridians had successfully awakened, she would still be a little princess within Red City.

“Xiao Yu, Big Bro Jiang Chen is going to walk an unusual path, and we will experience more of this kind of life in the future. You possess the Nine Yin Meridians, and you’re destined to walk an extraordinary path, so cultivate with your best effort. Once I finish my journey, I will marry you.”

Jiang Chen said with a smile on his face. The path he wanted to walk was one only he himself knew. This was a path destined to be filled with slaughter and the blood of all his enemies. The first thing he wanted to do after being reborn was reach his previous peak level, and then enter the legendary Realm of Immortals.

In his past life, he had used every single drop of his blood to break open the door leading to the Realm of Immortals, but he never had a chance to enter it, and this was his biggest regret. However, he now had the chance to do so. Jiang Chen would never give up this opportunity.

Of course, it was still too early to talk about the Realm of Immortals right now. The rebirth was just a new beginning. Not to mention the Realm of Immortals, even the time when he could step onto the land of the Divine Continent was still far from here.
“En.”

Yan Chen Yu was feeling shy. Ever since Jiang Chen had helped her awaken her Nine Yin Meridians, Yan Chen Yu had given herself to Jiang Chen. Right now, when she heard Jiang Chen say he was going to marry her, it was hard for her not to feel joy.
“Xiao Yu, how much of the ten thousand year old Freezing Crystal have you absorbed?”
Jiang Chen asked.

“I have absorbed about one third of it, and I am preparing to enter secluded cultivation and absorb the rest of it with all my effort. I want to break through to the Late Mortal Core realm as soon as possible!”
Yan Chen Yu said.
“Alright. The Black Sect’s condition is pretty suitable for cultivation. If you have nothing else to do, then you should just stay here and cultivate in the future.”

Jiang Chen said with a hint of concern. At the same time, he was astonished by her Divine Body’s cultivation speed. Ever since Yan Chen Yu’s Nine Yin Meridians had awoken, her cultivation realm had advanced swiftly and vigorously, and now she was going to use the ten thousand year old Freezing Crystal to break through to the Late Mortal Core realm. This kind of speed, ordinary people could only feel envy and shame.

Big Yellow had already gone to sleep, and Yan Chen Yu had entered another room and begun her secluded cultivation. Jiang Chen was sitting alone next to a stone table within the courtyard. With a calm and relaxed mind, he was enjoying the cold breeze sweeping through the mountains and rivers. His soul energy and Divine Sense was hovering around within the courtyard, indulging himself and feeling the existence of nature.

As a cultivator, depending solely on cultivation was not enough. In the path of cultivation, insight was the most important element. The Mortal Core realm was only one of the foundation realms, and one was still far away from understanding the importance of insight at this stage. Once the cultivation realm passed the Combat Soul realm, and reached the Combat King realm, insight became extremely important. A Combat King warrior could control the Dimensional Laws and stand high above the masses, the cultivation realms beneath simply couldn’t be compared with this realm.
Evening!

Wang Yun came once again. Together with him was Huang Zheng and the other disciples Jiang Chen had encountered earlier, including the three guarding disciples who had been beaten so much their heads started resembling pig heads.
“Wang Yun, what is this about?”
Jiang Chen glared at the group and asked indifferently.
“All of you bastards, hurry up and apologize to senior disciple Jiang!”
Wang Yun hooted at these disciples.
“Senior disciple Jiang, we were blinded, we didn’t know it was you when we offended your dignity! We hope senior disciple Jiang can forgive us!”
Huang Zheng bowed deeply towards Jiang Chen.
“That’s right senior disciple Jiang, we were all blinded, and we couldn’t recognize Mt. Tai! We really hope senior disciple Jiang can forgive us, and not to take it to heart.”
“It was all our fault, senior disciple Jiang, please punish us as you see fit!”
Everyone spoke and stated their stand. The guard trio who had their faces bashed in kneeled down on the ground and started crying their hearts out. It hurts, it hurts so fucking much.

Looking at what had happened, Jiang Chen couldn’t help but laugh. He hadn’t taken this matter to heart, but these disciples had become so restless that they had even come here to apologize to him. However, after giving it some thought, Jiang Chen finally understood why they behaved like this. His reputation was there, and he had a predetermined fight with Nan Bei Chao in one year. He was considered the Black Sect’s representative. These men had offended him, so they would surely suffer torture from Jiang Chen’s future.
“Senior disciple Jiang, this is a gift from of all of them! I’ve counted, there’s a total of 3000 Mortal Restoration Pills in here!”
Wang Yun grabbed a storage bag and handed it over to Jiang Chen.

3000 Mortal Restoration Pills, this was nothing much for Jiang Chen. However, for these disciples, it was actually a huge amount, especially for those novice disciples. They weren’t particularly wealthy before this, and these 3000 Mortal Restoration Pills could be considered all their fortune. From this, one could easily tell that they were sincerely apologizing to Jiang Chen.
“I never took today’s events to heart, so you guys don’t need to take it to heart either. As for these Mortal Restoration Pills, I don’t think you’re all that wealthy, so just take them back.”
Jiang Chen said with a smile.
“Senior disciple Jiang, please accept these Mortal Restoration Pills. If you don’t, they won’t be able to feel peace in their minds.”
Wang Yun said.
“That’s right, senior disciple Jiang! This is all our fortune, and if you think it is too little, I, Huang Zheng will try my best to get more for you!”
Huang Zheng said again.
Jiang Chen smiled. He knew these men had misunderstood him, therefore he grabbed the storage bag and asked, “Fine, I’ll accept these Mortal Restoration Pills. What’s your name?”
Jiang Chen looked at Huang Zheng.
“My name is Huang Zheng!”
Huang Zheng hurriedly replied.
“Come over here.”
Jiang Chen waved his hand.
Huang Zhen didn’t dare show any neglect as he hurriedly walked over to Jiang Chen.

“Huang Zheng, you should all know my approach by now. That’s right, I fought three battles during the Qi Province competition, and I killed three men, including Ling Ao and Li Wu Shuang. I, Jiang Chen am cruel, and I never show any mercy to my enemies. However, I would never do so to my own friend. I can’t blame any of you for what happened today, after all, none of you knew me before this. Take these Mortal Restoration Pills and distribute them among all your brothers.” [1]

Jiang Chen pushed the storage bag to Huang Zheng. He had seen these men’s sincerity. Besides, he had a good impression of the Black Sect, these Mortal Restoration Pills weren’t a big amount in his eyes, but to these disciples, it was very important.
“Senior disciple Jiang, this... this...”
Suddenly, Huang Zheng was at a loss for words. He never expected Jiang Chen to forgive them so easily, and even return their Mortal Restoration Pills.
“Senior disciple Jiang is a kind person, all of you should be grateful for his great kindness! You all better help senior disciple Jiang in the future with sincere hearts!”

Wang Yun said. All of these disciples were so touched that they started crying. They thought to themselves that they had been wrong about senior disciple Jiang; he was actually a simple and straightforward man to his own friends. What’s more important was that senior disciple Jiang had actually treated them as his friends.
Footnotes:
[1] Approach (手段) way of doing something, Jiang Chen’s way of handling situations.

chapters.title: Chapter 110 - Enemy at the Door
paragraphs: Chapter was sponsored by: Godfrey!
Chapter 110 - Enemy at the Door

The first thing Jiang Chen wanted to do once he arrived at the Black Sect was to gain the support of the disciples. In this life, Jiang Chen wanted to be respected and hailed by all mortals again, however, he did not want to be alone anymore. Since he had come to the Black Sect, he just wanted to lead the Black Sect and achieve greater strength. Staying in the Qi Province was far from enough.

What Jiang Chen did today had completely won over the hearts of these disciples. Wang Yun had completely submitted to him. Besides, for disciples like Wang Yun who mixed along pretty well within the Black Sect, his submission could basically represent the submission of all outer circle disciples.

As for Huang Zheng and the other disciples, aside from feeling grateful, their minds were filled with respect towards Jiang Chen. It was actually very difficult to change someone’s opinion of someone else, especially from fear to respect.
“That’s enough, you can all leave now. There’s no need to mention today’s events anymore.”
Jiang Chen waved his hand.
The group once again bowed to Jiang Chen before they turned around and left.
At the bottom of the mountain!
“I really never expected that senior disciple Jiang Chen who was known for his cruel and fierce approach would really forgive us, and even return the Mortal Restoration Pills to us!”

“You know nothing but shit, senior disciple Jiang is a special man, he doesn’t care about this small amount of Mortal Restoration Pills! Besides, senior disciple Jiang felt pain for us, he knew how important these Mortal Restoration Pills are to us!”

“Judging from what happened today, the way senior disciple Jiang treats his enemies and his own men are completely different! From now on, I’ll do whatever senior disciple Jiang asks me to do! As long as he orders, I will never refuse!”
Everyone let out a sigh. Jiang Chen had completely changed their opinion towards him.
“In the future, just help senior disciple Jiang do whatever he asks. I’m sure it’ll bring a lot of advantages!”
Wang Yun said. The benefits he had gotten today couldn’t be equal to any amount of wealth. It was a fact that no matter how wealthy you were, you couldn’t buy back your life.
The next day, early in the morning. A huge bang came from outside the Black Mountain, and after that, a thunderous roar sounded out above the Black Sect.
“Jiang Chen! Get out here!”
“Get out here!”
“Come out!”
“Come!”
The loud roars echoed out, causing the peaceful Black Sect to immediately start boiling.
“Damn it! Who is the one so arrogant that he dares to challenge senior disciple Jiang Chen in front of the Black Sect?! He is courting death!”
“Come, let’s go and have a look, let’s see who is the one who’s brave enough to do so!”

Many people had come to the outer area of the Black Sect. They all saw a young man wearing a yellow robe floating high in the sky. His black hair was waving in the wind, and strong killing intent, that he didn’t bother hiding, leaked out. There was a short sword embossed on the young man’s chest. He was from the Heavenly Sword Sect.
“He is from the Heavenly Sword Sect! Fuck, a man from the Heavenly Sword Sect came here and challenged us at our front door, isn’t he courting death?”
“What the fuck, does he think there will be no one from the Black Sect who can fight him? Just send two senior disciples from the inner circle, he will die a horrifying death!”

“I know him, his name is Li Wu Ling, brother of Li Wu Shuang! This man only has an average talent, and can’t compare with his brother. He is an outer circle disciple of the Heavenly Sword Sect, but he has surprisingly broken through to the Heavenly Core realm! I think he came here to get revenge for his brother!”

Someone recognized who the person was and immediately caused restlessness amongst the crowds. Although Li Wu Ling was also a genius outer circle disciple, his talent was far lower than his brother’s. However, when he came here today, his cultivation realm had already reached the Heavenly Core realm, and this really puzzled people.
“Jiang Chen, get out of here!”

Li Wu Ling was being pompous and arrogant. With high killing intent, his intentions were clear; kill Jiang Chen and avenge his brother. This man had dared to come here alone, and with just his guts alone, he was someone worthy of respect.
“Damn it! This son of a bitch is so arrogant! Does he think that the Black Sect has no one to fight him?”
Huang Zheng who had also come to the outer area of the Black Sect spoke angrily.
“Senior disciple Huang, do we need to inform senior disciple Jiang?”
A disciple asked. All of these disciple were treating Jiang Chen as their leader now, and since Li Wu Ling had come to their place, they needed to immediately inform Jiang Chen.
“What’s the point? With such loud shouts, do we still need to inform him? Senior disciple Jiang isn’t deaf.”
Huang Zheng gazed at the disciple.

Within the Black Sect, Jiang Chen who was resting with his eyes closed suddenly opened up his eyes and furrowed his brows. At the same time, three men were flying towards the entrance, they were inner circle disciples.
“Who dares to find trouble at our Black Sect?”

Together with a loud shout, three men had arrived at the entrance. The leading man was a handsome man with a dignified appearance, and the energy that was unintentionally leaking from his body served to make people respect him. Although the other two men had weaker energy, they were both Early Heavenly Core warriors as well.
“Look, its senior disciple Duan Li from the inner circle! He has reached the Mid Heavenly Core realm! It’s very rare to see him!”

“This Li Wu Ling has the guts to find trouble at the entrance of our Black Sect! If we don’t teach him a lesson, we, the Black Sect will become everyone’s laughing stock! Since senior disciple Duan Li is here, he will kill that Li Wu Ling with just a single strike!”
“That’s right, this Li Wu Ling coming here is just him courting death!”
The appearance of Duan Li immediately caused the crowds to become restless. In the eyes of all outer circle and novice disciples, any disciple from the inner circle was a superior existence.
“Get that Jiang Chen out here, I want to challenge him!”
Wind ruffled through Li Wu Ling’s hair, he was being presumptuous.
“Hmph! Junior disciple Jiang Chen isn’t here!”

Duan Li snorted. Jiang Chen’s name had been heard by everyone in the Black Sect, including Duan Li. Of course, with his performance in the Qi Province competition, it was hard to ask anyone to ignore him. Besides, Guan Yi Yun also had his eyes upon Jiang Chen.
“Senior disciple Duan, Jiang Chen actually arrived at the Black Sect yesterday.”
Wang Yun who had just arrived immediately told Duan Li about Jiang Chen’s arrival.
“Oh?”

Duan Li expressed his surprise, then with a snort, he said, “If I remember correctly, you are the brother of Li Wu Shuang, right? You have normal talent, I didn’t expect you to reach the Heavenly Core realm so quickly; you really surprised me. However, as a Heavenly Core warrior, do you not feel ashamed to challenge Jiang Chen who is only a Mortal Core warrior?”

Duan Li stared at Li Wu Ling, he had actually met him before, but he didn’t remember that much about him. With Duan Li’s cultivation at the Mid Heavenly Core realm and his status, he never really cared about Li Wu Shuang, much less his brother, Li Wu Ling.
“Save your breath, my purpose for coming here today is to get revenge for my brother! If Jiang Chen is a man, ask him to come out and fight me!”
Li Wu Ling behaved like a madman as he loudly roared outside the Black Sect’s entrance. Everyone within the Black Sect could hear him clearly.
“Damn it! Who does he think he is? How could he be so arrogant when he’s here to kill?”

“He is simply a shameless guy! With his Heavenly Core cultivation realm, not only does he challenge senior disciple Jiang Chen, he even came to the Black Sect with such an aggressive attitude, is he an idiot?”
Many disciples started cursing. In their opinion, Li Wu Ling just needed to say that he was here to kill someone for revenge. There was no need to mention anything about a challenge.

“Li Wu Ling, you’re just a little guy who has recently broken through to the Heavenly Core realm, and yet, you’re being so arrogant! Do you think that we, the Black Sect, have no disciples who can fight you? Since you challenge us, I, your father will fight you!”
A tall, bad tempered disciple from the inner circle who was standing next to Duan Li shouted back to Li Wu Ling. It seemed like he was ready to jump forwards to fight Li Wu Ling.
“I won’t fight with you, my target today is Jiang Chen!”
Li Wu Ling glared at the disciple and showed no will to fight him. He had made up his mind before coming to the Black Sect, Jiang Chen was his only target.
“Jiang Chen, if you are a man, get the hell out here!”
Li Wu Ling roared continuously.
“Damn you!”

The disciple from the inner circle of the Black Sect had become mad. Li Wu Ling’s behavior had shown that he was looking down on him, and he also continued making noise at the Black Sect’s entrance. If he didn’t teach him a lesson, the Black Sect would become a laughing stock.
Right as the disciple was going to strike, the sound of someone flying came from the Black Mountain. In the next second, Jiang Chen, with the blood wings on his back had arrived.
“It’s senior disciple Jiang, wow! He can really fly, and the pair of blood wings look amazing!”
“This is so cool! He can fly although he is only at the Mortal Core realm, I’m so envious!”

“So he is senior disciple Jiang who had gotten first place in the Qi Province competition! He looks so handsome! However, since he came here at this point of time... Don’t tell me he is going to accept Li Wu Ling’s challenge?”

When Jiang Chen appeared in front of everyone, he immediately became the center of attraction. Even Duan Li and the other two inner circle disciple were looking at him. Jiang Chen had become a famous person after the Qi Province competition, but this was the first time many of these people had seen his face.
“A man with amazing characteristics, no wonder senior disciple Guan Yi Yun thinks so highly of him!”
Duan Li nodded his head.
“Are you Jiang Chen?”
Li Wu Ling stared at Jiang Chen with a sharp vision, while thick amounts of killing intent was pouring out of his body.
“I am. Who are you?”
Jiang Chen asked.
“My name is Li Wu Ling! Li Wu Shuang was my brother, and you killed him! Now, I want to challenge you and get revenge for my brother!”
Li Wu Ling roared again.
Jiang Chen now understood. No wonder this man was looking only for him, even going as far as risking his life by coming to the Black Sect, it was all because he wanted to get revenge for his brother.
“Jiang Chen, I challenge you to a deathmatch! Accept my challenge if you are a man!”
Li Wu Ling said in a stern manner.
“Junior disciple Jiang, don’t bother with this person, let us handle everything.”
Duan Li said.
“That’s alright, I accept his challenge.”
Jiang Chen gave Duan Li a smile and accepted Li Wu Ling’s challenge.
“What? Senior disciple Jiang accepted Li Wu Ling’s challenge? He is too impulsive!”
“You’re right, he is too impulsive! Although he killed Li Wu Shuang and Ling Ao, Li Wu Ling is a Heavenly Core warrior! The gap between the Mortal Core realm and the Heavenly Core realm is huge!”
“He can’t accept the challenge, it is too unfair!”
Many disciples of the Black Sect started complaining. No one expected Jiang Chen would really accept Li Wu Ling’s challenge.
“Quiet down, senior disciple Jiang must have his own reasons, we need to have confidence in him!”

Wang Yun calmed the crowds down. Since Jiang Chen had helped him solve the danger in his ‘Origin Pass’, Jiang Chen had become a strong and mysterious man in his mind. Besides, Jiang Chen had always portrayed a confident attitude, a man like him would never do anything that he wasn’t confident about. When he accepted Li Wu Ling’s challenge, it simply meant that he had the methods of dealing with Li Wu Ling.
