Chapter 111 - Another Fight of Fame
“Good, you do have some courage!”

When Li Wu Ling heard Jiang Chen agree to his challenge so easily, he too felt surprised. He came here today without caring for his own life. After all, this was the Black Sect’s headquarters. Jiang Chen could easily just ignore him if he wished.
Jiang Chen threw an examining look on Li Wu Ling. After sensing his energy frequency, he couldn’t help but laugh and shake his head.
"What are you laughing at?"
Li Wu Ling's pupils shrunk.
"I laughed because you are an idiot."
Jiang Chen showed a scornful face.
"What did you say?"
Li Wu Ling immediately became angry.

“I can totally understand your decision to avenge your brother, but you shouldn’t take such an extreme path. Your energy frequency is really unstable, but I suppose that is because you just broke through to the Heavenly Core realm. Also, there’s an evil qi coming from you, I think you’re cultivating a demonic skill! With your below average talent, you’re completely different from your brother. Cultivation a demonic cultivation skill can help your cultivation level increase with great speed, so you can without doubt reach the Heavenly Core realm in such a short amount of time. However, too bad, you don’t know the proper way of cultivating demonic skills, and you forced yourself to cultivate it. Now, you have destroyed your future. But of course, since you decided to challenge me, you had already given up your future.

Jiang Chen said in a slow pace. Each and every word coming from his mouth were like sharp thorns stabbing right into Li Wu Ling’s heart. Li Wu Ling’s eyes widened, and an unbelievable expression appeared on his face.

How did this young man in front of him find out that he was able to break through to the Heavenly Core realm because of him cultivating a demonic skill? Standing in front of him made him feel as if he was naked, as if no secret could be hidden from his eyes. This was impossible!

Besides, what Jiang Chen said was completely right. Li Wu Ling had obtained a demonic skill not long before this, and he had entered secluded meditation to study it. This was why he hadn’t participated in the Qi Province competition. When he heard his brother had been killed, he was so angry that he had forced himself to break through to the Heavenly Core realm with the help of the demonic skill and some pills, then he immediately rushed to the Black Sect to look for Jiang Chen. However, he would never have expected that Jiang Chen could see through everything.
"So what? My cultivation realm is more than enough to kill you!"

His killing intent towards Jiang Chen was getting larger. Li Wu Ling felt that Jiang Chen was a frightening man, he was just a 15-16 year old young Mortal Core warrior, but he wasn’t even nervous when standing face to face with him. On his face, there was only a calm and confident expression.

“Is that so? Perhaps you still don’t understand your current situation? Fine, let me explain it to you so you won’t die in the dark. On the surface, you are a Heavenly Core warrior, you can control natural energies and fly in the air. Nevertheless, you can’t deny it, your cultivation base is unstable, your cultivation realm is impetuous, and you haven’t mastered the demonic skill. With your current situation, I can just find any Early Heavenly Core warrior, and he would be able to easily defeat you. To make my point clearer, you’re just a little bit stronger than your dead brother, so, if you want to get revenge, I would suggest you go back and spend a few more years in secluded cultivation.”

Jiang Chen said with an indifferent tone. With his experience and judgment, he could easily see through Li Wu Ling. With Li Wu Ling’s current situation, he couldn’t even compare to those ordinary Heavenly Core warriors like Yin Zhong Cheng. Not to mention the inner circle disciples of all four big sects.
With Jiang Chen’s current combat strength and abilities, Li Wu Ling simply did not stand a chance at winning the fight.
“Save your breath, prove your words with the fight! Let me see how you, with your Mortal Core strength, was able to kill my brother!”
Li Wu Ling’s killing intent was soaring high in the skies. Nevertheless, his mind had been twisted by Jiang Chen’s words, and his energy had become more unstable.
Swoopsh...

Wild wind emerged from Li Wu Ling’s body. He circulated his demonic skill, and his eyes turned blood red. His lips turned black because of the demonic qi, then, he forcefully struck out his fist towards Jiang Chen.
The attack carried an intense evil demonic energy. The energy transformed into a demonic dragon as it swirled and rolled like a flying tsunami towards Jiang Chen.

Everyone from the Black Sect felt their nerves tensing up, they didn’t have the experience and judgment that Jiang Chen had. Even Duan Li couldn’t tell what Li Wu Ling’s real situation was like, he could only tell that Li Wu Ling had just broken through to the Heavenly Core realm, and his foundation was unstable.

However, in their minds, a Heavenly Core warrior could never be defeated by a Mortal Core warrior. Although Jiang Chen was a mighty warrior, it was hard to tell if he really could withstand a Heavenly Core warrior’s attack.
“Hmph! I am not in the mood to play with you. Since you miss your dear brother so much, I’ll allow you to reunite with him.”
A cruel look emerged in Jiang Chen’s eyes. In his mind, when Li Wu Ling had come here and challenged him at the Black Sect’s entrance, Li Wu Ling was already dead.

Jiang Chen would never allow someone who wanted to kill him stay alive. Besides, this place belonged to the Black Sect, and the result of this battle would also affect the Black Sect’s dignity. He had to maintain the Black Sect’s dignity.
“Six Solar Fingers.”
Jiang Chen shouted with a deep voice, immediately struck out his Six Solar Fingers, and with his fingertips glowing, he pointed toward Li Wu Ling forcefully.
Bang...
A ground-shaking loud explosion swept across and even shook the skies. Then, everyone could see three huge golden fingers suddenly appearing, piercing towards Li Wu Ling’s demonic dragon.
Bang...
Both attacks collided and caused another massive explosion. Without any resistance, Li Wu Ling’s demonic dragon shattered in an instant because of the powerful impact from the Six Solar Fingers.
The Six Solar Finger’s force didn’t lower at all. With an incredible speed and a golden colored tail behind it, it carried a destructive force and continued flying towards Li Wu Ling.
“What?”

Struck with consternation, Li Wu Ling had never expected his opponent to be so strong. The demonic skill that he was cultivating couldn’t even resist a single attack from Jiang Chen, this was unbelievable!
Ahhh...
Li Wu Ling raised his head and howled. He gathered all the energy in his body and focused it into a black demonic shield to defend himself from Jiang Chen’s Six Solar Fingers.
Bang...
Another intense and powerful impact. A dark smoke emerged from the center of the impact.
Plop plop plop...
Li Wu Ling kept stepping back in midair, only to regain control after flying nearly one hundred meters backwards. His breath was rapid and he spat out some blood. His face had turned pale.
There was only one expression on Li Wu Ling’s face; shock. He could never have imagined this result, he simply couldn’t understand how a Mortal Core warrior could be so strong.
“My god, so this is senior disciple Jiang Chen’s true power? He is so strong, this is freaking abnormal, is he really just a Mortal Core warrior?”
“Senior disciple Jiang has become stronger now than he was at the Qi Province competition, he is now a Mid Mortal Core warrior! No wonder he can defeat Li Wu Ling!”

“Although he has just broken through to the Mid Mortal Core realm, defeating a Heavenly Core warrior is just too shocking. I can’t believe that there exists someone so freaking abnormal in this world like senior disciple Jiang Chen! With his Mid Mortal Core strength, he can defeat Heavenly Core warrior Li Wu Ling with just a single strike! If I hadn’t witnessed this myself, I wouldn’t have believed it even if you killed me!”
“Did you guys see that finger skill senior disciple Jiang Chen used just now? It is definitely an Earth combat skill! It’s so powerful!”

“Finally, I am able to understand why senior disciple Jiang Chen can kill Li Wu Shuang and Ling Ao! Li Wu Ling came here in a threatening manner and challenged senior disciple Jiang; he was simply just courting death and looking to strike his own face!”

All the disciples of the Black Sect were incredibly excited, especially Wang Yun and Huang Zhen. The worry in their minds were now completely gone, and instead, they were so excited it felt as if they had been given some stimulants. They were jumping and cheering like it was themselves who had defeated Li Wu Ling, and not Jiang Chen.
“What a guy! When we are at the same cultivation realm as him, there will be no way for us to compare with him! No wonder he dared challenge Nan Bei Chao to a fight one year from now!”

Duan Li was shocked as well. He had prepared to strike if Li Wu Ling was close to defeating Jiang Chen. After all, if he let a disciple of the Heavenly Sword Sect kill the number one genius from the Qi Province competition in the Black Sect’s territory, that would be a huge blow in the Black Sect’s face.
What he didn’t expect was that Jiang Chen was so strong. With just a single attack, he had seriously wounded Li Wu Ling.
“I don’t believe it! I can’t believe it! Why is a Mortal Core warrior so strong?! I want to kill you! Jiang Chen, I must kill you and get revenge for my brother!”
With both his eyes turning red, Li Wu Ling roared and entered a frenzy. In his hand, a combat weapon covered in demonic energy appeared.
Looking at this, Jiang Chen shook his head. Li Wu Ling’s mind was struck by extreme anger. He was now at the border of entering psychosis.
“You won’t have the chance anymore.”
Jiang Chen said with an indifferent tone. The blood wings on his back flapped, and like a Blood Winged Hawk, he flew forwards with lightning speed and appeared above Li Wu Ling.
Jiang Chen transformed into a hawk and let out a loud hawk cry towards Li Wu Ling.
The hawk cry shocked the world. This was the innate combat skill, the Sonic Hawk Cry. After Jiang Chen had broken through, the power of this innate combat skill had increased as well
In the blink of an eye, layers of sound waves turned into ripples and interweaved into one giant web which covered Li Wu Ling.
Like snakes, the sound waves penetrated into Li Wu Ling’s brain.
Blergh!
Li Wu Ling kept spitting out blood as he howled out in extreme pain. Jiang Chen’s sound waves had destroyed his Divine Sense.
“Die!”

Jiang Chen’s blood wings transformed into a sharp scythe which cut towards Li Wu Ling with speed resembling lightning. Li Wu Ling’s head was chopped off in an instant and was sent flying high. Followed by a pillar of blood that was formed from Li Wu Ling’s blood, the horrified howl went silent.

Jiang Chen’s movement was too fast. Although Li Wu Ling had taken out his combat weapon, before he even had the time to use it, he had been badly injured by the Sonic Hawk Cry’s sound waves and killed on the spot.

At this point of time, the outer perimeter of the Black Sect went completely silent. Everyone raised their heads and looked at the young man with a pair of blood wings on his back. Their eyes carried one thing, shock.
This was terrifying, was this still considered a human?

No one expected Li Wu Ling to die in such a fast and complete manner. This guy came here early in the morning to try and get revenge for his brother, and only a few minutes later, he had been killed by Jiang Chen.

No one could remain calm. Chapter 111 - Another Fight of Fame
“Good, you do have some courage!”
When Li Wu Ling heard Jiang Chen agree to his challenge so easily, he too felt surprised.
He came here today without caring for his own life.
After all, this was the Black Sect’s headquarters.
Jiang Chen could easily just ignore him if he wished.
Jiang Chen threw an examining look on Li Wu Ling.
After sensing his energy frequency, he couldn’t help but laugh and shake his head.
"What are you laughing at?"
Li Wu Ling's pupils shrunk.
"I laughed because you are an idiot."
Jiang Chen showed a scornful face.
"What did you say?"
Li Wu Ling immediately became angry.
“I can totally understand your decision to avenge your brother, but you shouldn’t take such an extreme path.
Your energy frequency is really unstable, but I suppose that is because you just broke through to the Heavenly Core realm.
Also, there’s an evil qi coming from you, I think you’re cultivating a demonic skill!
With your below average talent, you’re completely different from your brother.
Cultivation a demonic cultivation skill can help your cultivation level increase with great speed, so you can without doubt reach the Heavenly Core realm in such a short amount of time.
However, too bad, you don’t know the proper way of cultivating demonic skills, and you forced yourself to cultivate it.
Now, you have destroyed your future.
But of course, since you decided to challenge me, you had already given up your future.
Jiang Chen said in a slow pace.
Each and every word coming from his mouth were like sharp thorns stabbing right into Li Wu Ling’s heart.
Li Wu Ling’s eyes widened, and an unbelievable expression appeared on his face.
How did this young man in front of him find out that he was able to break through to the Heavenly Core realm because of him cultivating a demonic skill?
Standing in front of him made him feel as if he was naked, as if no secret could be hidden from his eyes.
This was impossible!
Besides, what Jiang Chen said was completely right.
Li Wu Ling had obtained a demonic skill not long before this, and he had entered secluded meditation to study it.
This was why he hadn’t participated in the Qi Province competition.

When he heard his brother had been killed, he was so angry that he had forced himself to break through to the Heavenly Core realm with the help of the demonic skill and some pills, then he immediately rushed to the Black Sect to look for Jiang Chen.
However, he would never have expected that Jiang Chen could see through everything.
"So what?
My cultivation realm is more than enough to kill you!"
His killing intent towards Jiang Chen was getting larger.
Li Wu Ling felt that Jiang Chen was a frightening man, he was just a 15-16 year old young Mortal Core warrior, but he wasn’t even nervous when standing face to face with him.
On his face, there was only a calm and confident expression.
“Is that so?
Perhaps you still don’t understand your current situation?
Fine, let me explain it to you so you won’t die in the dark.
On the surface, you are a Heavenly Core warrior, you can control natural energies and fly in the air.
Nevertheless, you can’t deny it, your cultivation base is unstable, your cultivation realm is impetuous, and you haven’t mastered the demonic skill.
With your current situation, I can just find any Early Heavenly Core warrior, and he would be able to easily defeat you.
To make my point clearer, you’re just a little bit stronger than your dead brother, so, if you want to get revenge, I would suggest you go back and spend a few more years in secluded cultivation.”
Jiang Chen said with an indifferent tone.
With his experience and judgment, he could easily see through Li Wu Ling.
With Li Wu Ling’s current situation, he couldn’t even compare to those ordinary Heavenly Core warriors like Yin Zhong Cheng.
Not to mention the inner circle disciples of all four big sects.
With Jiang Chen’s current combat strength and abilities, Li Wu Ling simply did not stand a chance at winning the fight.
“Save your breath, prove your words with the fight!
Let me see how you, with your Mortal Core strength, was able to kill my brother!”
Li Wu Ling’s killing intent was soaring high in the skies.
Nevertheless, his mind had been twisted by Jiang Chen’s words, and his energy had become more unstable.
Swoopsh...
Wild wind emerged from Li Wu Ling’s body.
He circulated his demonic skill, and his eyes turned blood red.
His lips turned black because of the demonic qi, then, he forcefully struck out his fist towards Jiang Chen.
The attack carried an intense evil demonic energy.
The energy transformed into a demonic dragon as it swirled and rolled like a flying tsunami towards Jiang Chen.
Everyone from the Black Sect felt their nerves tensing up, they didn’t have the experience and judgment that Jiang Chen had.
Even Duan Li couldn’t tell what Li Wu Ling’s real situation was like, he could only tell that Li Wu Ling had just broken through to the Heavenly Core realm, and his foundation was unstable.
However, in their minds, a Heavenly Core warrior could never be defeated by a Mortal Core warrior.
Although Jiang Chen was a mighty warrior, it was hard to tell if he really could withstand a Heavenly Core warrior’s attack.
“Hmph!
I am not in the mood to play with you.
Since you miss your dear brother so much, I’ll allow you to reunite with him.”
A cruel look emerged in Jiang Chen’s eyes.
In his mind, when Li Wu Ling had come here and challenged him at the Black Sect’s entrance, Li Wu Ling was already dead.
Jiang Chen would never allow someone who wanted to kill him stay alive.
Besides, this place belonged to the Black Sect, and the result of this battle would also affect the Black Sect’s dignity.
He had to maintain the Black Sect’s dignity.
“Six Solar Fingers.”
Jiang Chen shouted with a deep voice, immediately struck out his Six Solar Fingers, and with his fingertips glowing, he pointed toward Li Wu Ling forcefully.
Bang...
A ground-shaking loud explosion swept across and even shook the skies.
Then, everyone could see three huge golden fingers suddenly appearing, piercing towards Li Wu Ling’s demonic dragon.
Bang...
Both attacks collided and caused another massive explosion.
Without any resistance, Li Wu Ling’s demonic dragon shattered in an instant because of the powerful impact from the Six Solar Fingers.
The Six Solar Finger’s force didn’t lower at all.
With an incredible speed and a golden colored tail behind it, it carried a destructive force and continued flying towards Li Wu Ling.
“What?”
Struck with consternation, Li Wu Ling had never expected his opponent to be so strong.
The demonic skill that he was cultivating couldn’t even resist a single attack from Jiang Chen, this was unbelievable!
Ahhh...
Li Wu Ling raised his head and howled.
He gathered all the energy in his body and focused it into a black demonic shield to defend himself from Jiang Chen’s Six Solar Fingers.
Bang...
Another intense and powerful impact.
A dark smoke emerged from the center of the impact.
Plop plop plop...
Li Wu Ling kept stepping back in midair, only to regain control after flying nearly one hundred meters backwards.
His breath was rapid and he spat out some blood.
His face had turned pale.
There was only one expression on Li Wu Ling’s face; shock.
He could never have imagined this result, he simply couldn’t understand how a Mortal Core warrior could be so strong.
“My god, so this is senior disciple Jiang Chen’s true power?
He is so strong, this is freaking abnormal, is he really just a Mortal Core warrior?”
“Senior disciple Jiang has become stronger now than he was at the Qi Province competition, he is now a Mid Mortal Core warrior!
No wonder he can defeat Li Wu Ling!”
“Although he has just broken through to the Mid Mortal Core realm, defeating a Heavenly Core warrior is just too shocking.
I can’t believe that there exists someone so freaking abnormal in this world like senior disciple Jiang Chen!
With his Mid Mortal Core strength, he can defeat Heavenly Core warrior Li Wu Ling with just a single strike!
If I hadn’t witnessed this myself, I wouldn’t have believed it even if you killed me!”
“Did you guys see that finger skill senior disciple Jiang Chen used just now?
It is definitely an Earth combat skill!
It’s so powerful!”
“Finally, I am able to understand why senior disciple Jiang Chen can kill Li Wu Shuang and Ling Ao!
Li Wu Ling came here in a threatening manner and challenged senior disciple Jiang; he was simply just courting death and looking to strike his own face!”
All the disciples of the Black Sect were incredibly excited, especially Wang Yun and Huang Zhen.
The worry in their minds were now completely gone, and instead, they were so excited it felt as if they had been given some stimulants.
They were jumping and cheering like it was themselves who had defeated Li Wu Ling, and not Jiang Chen.
“What a guy!
When we are at the same cultivation realm as him, there will be no way for us to compare with him!
No wonder he dared challenge Nan Bei Chao to a fight one year from now!”
Duan Li was shocked as well.
He had prepared to strike if Li Wu Ling was close to defeating Jiang Chen.

After all, if he let a disciple of the Heavenly Sword Sect kill the number one genius from the Qi Province competition in the Black Sect’s territory, that would be a huge blow in the Black Sect’s face.
What he didn’t expect was that Jiang Chen was so strong.
With just a single attack, he had seriously wounded Li Wu Ling.
“I don’t believe it!
I can’t believe it!
Why is a Mortal Core warrior so strong?!
I want to kill you!
Jiang Chen, I must kill you and get revenge for my brother!”
With both his eyes turning red, Li Wu Ling roared and entered a frenzy.
In his hand, a combat weapon covered in demonic energy appeared.
Looking at this, Jiang Chen shook his head.
Li Wu Ling’s mind was struck by extreme anger.
He was now at the border of entering psychosis.
“You won’t have the chance anymore.”
Jiang Chen said with an indifferent tone.
The blood wings on his back flapped, and like a Blood Winged Hawk, he flew forwards with lightning speed and appeared above Li Wu Ling.
Jiang Chen transformed into a hawk and let out a loud hawk cry towards Li Wu Ling.
The hawk cry shocked the world.
This was the innate combat skill, the Sonic Hawk Cry.
After Jiang Chen had broken through, the power of this innate combat skill had increased as well
In the blink of an eye, layers of sound waves turned into ripples and interweaved into one giant web which covered Li Wu Ling.
Like snakes, the sound waves penetrated into Li Wu Ling’s brain.
Blergh!
Li Wu Ling kept spitting out blood as he howled out in extreme pain.
Jiang Chen’s sound waves had destroyed his Divine Sense.
“Die!”
Jiang Chen’s blood wings transformed into a sharp scythe which cut towards Li Wu Ling with speed resembling lightning.
Li Wu Ling’s head was chopped off in an instant and was sent flying high.
Followed by a pillar of blood that was formed from Li Wu Ling’s blood, the horrified howl went silent.
Jiang Chen’s movement was too fast.
Although Li Wu Ling had taken out his combat weapon, before he even had the time to use it, he had been badly injured by the Sonic Hawk Cry’s sound waves and killed on the spot.
At this point of time, the outer perimeter of the Black Sect went completely silent.
Everyone raised their heads and looked at the young man with a pair of blood wings on his back.
Their eyes carried one thing, shock.
This was terrifying, was this still considered a human?
No one expected Li Wu Ling to die in such a fast and complete manner.
This guy came here early in the morning to try and get revenge for his brother, and only a few minutes later, he had been killed by Jiang Chen.
No one could remain calm.

Those outer circle disciples who had witnessed how Jiang Chen had killed Ling Ao and Li Wu Shuang could still accept what happened, but for those disciples who had witnessed Jiang Chen fighting for the first time, they were completely startled.
Not only did Jiang Chen have powerful abilities, he struck without mercy, and he didn’t even blink his eyes when killing.
These people didn’t dare directly look into his eyes.

Chapter 112 - Meeting the Sect Chief

Li Wu Ling’s dead body and head fell down from the sky together with a large amount of blood. The scene looked pathetic underneath the bright shine of the morning sunlight. Li Wu Ling, who had just broken through to the Heavenly Core realm by forcefully cultivating a demonic skill, and Jiang Chen who had condensed 40 Dragon Marks; the two of them were simply not on the same level. Jiang Chen didn’t even use his Axe of Thunder.
“Awesome!”
Amongst the crowds, Huang Zheng shouted out loudly.
“Almighty senior disciple Jiang!”

Wang Yun also shouted out loudly. Not only the two of them, at this point of time, all the disciples who witnessed how Jiang Chen killed Li Wu Ling couldn’t hold their excitement. An outer circle disciple from the Black Sect had killed an inner circle disciple from the Heavenly Sword Sect, this was glorious for the Black Sect.

After Guan Yi Yun, who was the pride of the Black Sect, was defeated by Nan Bei Chao with just a single attack, it had left a shadow in the minds of all the Black Sect disciples. Ever since then, whenever someone mentioned the Burning Sky Pavilion, they had felt lower than them.

However, with Jiang Chen’s performance today, they had seen the future hope for the Black Sect. It had removed the shadows in their minds. This was a super genius, even Nan Bei Chao would have not been able to kill a Heavenly Core warrior while only at the Mid Mortal Core realm.

Therefore, although Jiang Chen was only an outer circle disciple, he had lifted the spirits of all the Black Sect disciples, and he had become one of the Black Sect’s representatives. In many of these disciples’ minds, the Black Sect had finally found someone who could fight Nan Bei Chao.
“This man has a limitless future, I can never be like him.”
Duan Li murmured to himself. Right now, only an idiot would be unable to see Jiang Chen’s huge potential.
“Fellow disciples, please help me spread these words! From now on, whichever Heavenly Sword Sect disciple dares provoke me, I will kill him!”

While floating in the air, Jiang Chen said with a voice that could be clearly heard by every single disciple of the Black Sect. After that, he flapped his blood wings and flew back into the Black Sect, disappearing in front of everyone.

Kill anyone who dares provoke him, this was so domineering, so arrogant! There was not a single person in the entire Qi Province who dares to say something this heroic. Setting an entire sect as his enemy, this was an absolute bold statement. And he, Jiang Chen, was the first one who dared to say this.
“So domineering! He is truly amazing! From now on, senior disciple Jiang will be my idol!”
“Senior disciple Han Yan was my only idol, but from now on, I have one more idol! In the future, both of them will be my goal!”
“Guys, let’s spread senior disciple Jiang’s words! We’ll let those guys from the Heavenly Sword Sect know that we, the Black Sect, are not to be provoked!”

Under the lead of Wang Yun and Huang Zhen, the atmosphere amongst all the Black Sect disciples became heated. Jiang Chen’s arrogant and domineering manner didn’t make any of them feel disgusted, instead, it had made him become an idol for many of the disciples.

“Senior disciple Duan, this junior disciple Jiang Chen is really an incredibly strong man, he killed Li Wu Ling just like that. However, in my opinion, Li Wu Ling had just broken through to the Heavenly Core realm, and his foundation was unstable, so he couldn’t be compared with real Heavenly Core warriors. If we were to fight with Jiang Chen, who do you think would win?”
One of the Early Heavenly Core disciples came to Duan Li and asked.
Duan Li gazed at the disciple and said, “I can’t say for sure who would win if you fought Jiang Chen, but let me tell you this; do not provoke him, this man is not simple.”
Duan Li reminded him out of kindness, then he flew back to the Black Sect. The other two Early Heavenly Core disciples looked at each other, then they too flew back to the Black Sect.
“Huang Zheng, ask someone to burn Li Wu Ling’s body. The rest of you, dismiss yourself and go back to what you were doing.”
Wang Yun told Huang Zhen, then he waved his hand at those who were gathered here. The incident had finally come to an end.

The Qi Province competition had given Jiang Chen his fame, and today’s battle had given Jiang Chen the opportunity to show his might in the Black Sect. Personally witnessing events always left more impact than hearing it from someone else. After killing Li Wu Ling today, Jiang Chen had established his unshakable position in the Black Sect.

After killing Li Wu Ling, Jiang Chen went straight back to his residence. He stood on the mountaintop, gentle breeze waving through his white clothes. He wore a calm expression, he was already used to killing. Jiang Chen knew the path he was going to walk, and in the future, there would be more people he would have to kill.
Half an hour later, a man suddenly landed beside Jiang Chen. It was Guan Yi Yun.

“Junior disciple Jiang, from your energy frequency I can tell that you have broken through to the Mid Mortal Core realm! Also, I just heard that you killed Li Wu Ling, a Heavenly Core warrior! You’re amazing, you became an idol for so many disciples so quickly!”
The news of Jiang Chen fighting Li Wu Ling had spread across the entire Black Sect, even those disciples from the inner circle who hadn’t been at the scene had gotten the news.
“Senior disciple Guan, weren’t you in secluded meditation in order to break through to the Divine Core realm? Why did you stop cultivating so quickly?”

Jiang Chen was startled. He threw an examining look at Guan Yi Yun, but he found out that Guan Yi Yun was still at the peak of the Heavenly Core realm. Obviously, his secluded meditation hadn’t been successful.

“It is not that easy to break through to the Divine Core realm. I had given it a thorough thought, and secluded cultivation alone won’t help me. In order to break through, I’ll need to find an opportunity. I’ll leave the Black Sect tomorrow to search for the opportunity to breakthrough.”
Guan Yi Yun said with a smile.
“What is senior disciple Guan’s plan?”
Jiang Chen asked with a hint of curiosity.
A dignified expression suddenly appeared on Guan Yi Yun’s face, he said, “I am going to the Inferno Hell!”[1]
“Inferno Hell? What place is that?”
Jiang Chen asked with a puzzled expression.

This couldn’t be blamed on Jiang Chen, after all, he wasn’t familiar with the Qi Province, it was perfectly normal that he had never heard about the Inferno Hell. If it was someone else who heard this name, just the name itself would be enough to turn their faces pale.

“So junior disciple Jiang has never heard about Inferno Hell. Then, let me tell you about it. In fact, I’ve known about it for quite some time, but I have never entered it before. In the entire Qi Province, not more than a handful of people have the guts to enter it.”

With a stern expression, Guan Yi Yun expressed his fear of the Purgatory, “The Inferno Hell is located in a special place within the Eastern Continent, there’s a node in every single one of the 28 Eastern Continent Provinces connected to it, and in all the big sects of all provinces, there is an ancient portal that can transport people into the Inferno Hell. However, rarely do any disciples purposely go train themselves in the Inferno Hell. The Inferno Hell is almost the same as death itself, rumors say that it has a harsh environment with foul and evil demons running across the lands. It is a true land of vanquishing, and with my cultivation base, entering the Inferno Hell is almost equal to certain death. Not only me, it would also mean death for those Divine Core warriors!”

This was the Inferno Hell, a special place that existed in the Eastern Continent. It was a training ground for hundreds of sects and clans in all the 28 provinces in the Eastern Continent. However, just like its name, the Inferno Hell was truly a hell for those who entered it for training.

No ordinary disciple would ever step into the Inferno Hell without a valid reason. Those who entered were all the fiercest men. In some of the big sects, once a disciple had made a huge mistake, they would sometimes be sent into the Inferno Hell. This was basically the cruelest punishment.
However, those who had walked out from the Infernal Hell were all those who had gone through severe tests of life and death. Their future achievements would be limitless.
“I never expected such a special place to be in the Eastern Continent...”
Jiang Chen muttered to himself. The Inferno Hell was a place where no ordinary man could go, but Guan Yi Yun had the guts to enter it. With this brave heart alone, he had won Jiang Chen’s respect.
“Senior disciple Guan, since the Inferno Hell is such a dangerous place, you better think twice before rushing into it.”
Jiang Chen reminded.

“Haha, junior disciple Jiang, you should know this, opportunity and danger always comes together. Of course, the Inferno Hell is a dangerous place, but there’s also plenty of opportunities. I, Guan Yi Yun, do not want to be an ordinary man without any great achievements, this trip to Inferno Hell, it doesn’t matter if I die inside or come out alive, I won’t regret it at all!”
Guan Yi Yun said with a laugh.

Jiang Chen nodded his head silently. During the Qi Province competition, he had found out that Guan Yi Yun was an unyielding and passionate man. The decision of entering the Inferno Hell is not something someone ordinary can make.

“You’re right, a man should have a great dream! Living an ordinary life is just boring! We don’t ask for longevity, we just want to live a glorious life! Even if our lives were like shooting stars which only shine brightly for a short amount of time, we would still leave our own glorious days in this world!”

Jiang Chen completely supported Guan Yi Yun’s decision. Besides, he was also interested in the Inferno Hell. However, his cultivation level was weak as it was now. If there was a chance in the future, he would definitely enter the Inferno Hell and have a look at it.
“Haha, what great spirit! Junior disciple Jiang, your talent and potential is not any weaker than that of Nan Bei Chao’s! I have confidence in your fight one year from now!”
Guan Yi Yun patted Jiang Chen’s shoulder, then he said again, “Oh right, I’m actually here for something!”
“What is it, senior disciple Guan?”
Jiang Chen was startled.
“The Sect Chief wants to see you, I am here to bring you to him.”
Guan Yi Yun said.
“Sect Chief?”
Jiang Chen was startled once again. He was only a little disciple from the outer circle, the Sect Chief shouldn’t have noticed him.

“Junior disciple Jiang, this is good news, and it is a huge honor as well! You must know this, the Sect Chief is the top man of our sect, he usually wouldn’t meet an outer circle disciple personally, but you are different! You’ve become the champion of the Qi Province competition, and you have a fight with Nan Bei Chao one year from now, you’ve gained the acceptance of the Sect Chief! Today you even killed Li Wu Ling who is a Heavenly Core warrior with just your Mid Mortal Core cultivation base! With all of these outstanding achievements, the Black Sect will definitely support your cultivation with all sorts of resources!”
Guan Yi Yun explained to Jiang Chen.
Jiang Chen nodded his head, what Guan Yi Yun had said made sense. Looks like his performance today had completely attracted the Sect Chief’s attention. Therefore, he decided to meet him personally.
A true peerless genius would be a sect’s greatest asset, he was the future hope of a sect.
“Alright, I’ll follow you to greet the Sect Chief.”
Since he had become a disciple of the Black Sect, he would need to get along well. Meeting the Sect Chief who sat up high in the leading position wasn’t something bad.
“Let’s go. After bringing you there, I’ll need to prepare for my trip to the Inferno Hell. This might be the last time we meet.”
A smile jumped onto Guan Yi Yun’s face.
“Don’t worry, we will meet again for sure.”
Jiang Chen replied.
Footnotes:
[1] - ‘Inferno Hell’ (炼狱) can also be translated as ‘Purgatory’. I just thought that Inferno Hell sounded better.

However, rarely do any disciples purposely go train themselves in the Inferno Hell.
The Inferno Hell is almost the same as death itself, rumors say that it has a harsh environment with foul and evil demons running across the lands.
It is a true land of vanquishing, and with my cultivation base, entering the Inferno Hell is almost equal to certain death.
Not only me, it would also mean death for those Divine Core warriors!”
This was the Inferno Hell, a special place that existed in the Eastern Continent.
It was a training ground for hundreds of sects and clans in all the 28 provinces in the Eastern Continent.
However, just like its name, the Inferno Hell was truly a hell for those who entered it for training.
No ordinary disciple would ever step into the Inferno Hell without a valid reason.
Those who entered were all the fiercest men.
In some of the big sects, once a disciple had made a huge mistake, they would sometimes be sent into the Inferno Hell.
This was basically the cruelest punishment.
However, those who had walked out from the Infernal Hell were all those who had gone through severe tests of life and death.
Their future achievements would be limitless.
“I never expected such a special place to be in the Eastern Continent...”
Jiang Chen muttered to himself.
The Inferno Hell was a place where no ordinary man could go, but Guan Yi Yun had the guts to enter it.
With this brave heart alone, he had won Jiang Chen’s respect.
“Senior disciple Guan, since the Inferno Hell is such a dangerous place, you better think twice before rushing into it.”
Jiang Chen reminded.
“Haha, junior disciple Jiang, you should know this, opportunity and danger always comes together.
Of course, the Inferno Hell is a dangerous place, but there’s also plenty of opportunities.
I, Guan Yi Yun, do not want to be an ordinary man without any great achievements, this trip to Inferno Hell, it doesn’t matter if I die inside or come out alive, I won’t regret it at all!”
Guan Yi Yun said with a laugh.
Jiang Chen nodded his head silently.
During the Qi Province competition, he had found out that Guan Yi Yun was an unyielding and passionate man.
The decision of entering the Inferno Hell is not something someone ordinary can make.
“You’re right, a man should have a great dream!
Living an ordinary life is just boring!
We don’t ask for longevity, we just want to live a glorious life!
Even if our lives were like shooting stars which only shine brightly for a short amount of time, we would still leave our own glorious days in this world!”
Jiang Chen completely supported Guan Yi Yun’s decision.
Besides, he was also interested in the Inferno Hell.
However, his cultivation level was weak as it was now.
If there was a chance in the future, he would definitely enter the Inferno Hell and have a look at it.
“Haha, what great spirit!
Junior disciple Jiang, your talent and potential is not any weaker than that of Nan Bei Chao’s!
I have confidence in your fight one year from now!”
Guan Yi Yun patted Jiang Chen’s shoulder, then he said again, “Oh right, I’m actually here for something!”
“What is it, senior disciple Guan?”
Jiang Chen was startled.
“The Sect Chief wants to see you, I am here to bring you to him.”
Guan Yi Yun said.
“Sect Chief?”
Jiang Chen was startled once again.
He was only a little disciple from the outer circle, the Sect Chief shouldn’t have noticed him.
“Junior disciple Jiang, this is good news, and it is a huge honor as well!
You must know this, the Sect Chief is the top man of our sect, he usually wouldn’t meet an outer circle disciple personally, but you are different!
You’ve become the champion of the Qi Province competition, and you have a fight with Nan Bei Chao one year from now, you’ve gained the acceptance of the Sect Chief!
Today you even killed Li Wu Ling who is a Heavenly Core warrior with just your Mid Mortal Core cultivation base!
With all of these outstanding achievements, the Black Sect will definitely support your cultivation with all sorts of resources!”
Guan Yi Yun explained to Jiang Chen.
Jiang Chen nodded his head, what Guan Yi Yun had said made sense.
Looks like his performance today had completely attracted the Sect Chief’s attention.
Therefore, he decided to meet him personally.
A true peerless genius would be a sect’s greatest asset, he was the future hope of a sect.
“Alright, I’ll follow you to greet the Sect Chief.”
Since he had become a disciple of the Black Sect, he would need to get along well.
Meeting the Sect Chief who sat up high in the leading position wasn’t something bad.
“Let’s go.
After bringing you there, I’ll need to prepare for my trip to the Inferno Hell.
This might be the last time we meet.”
A smile jumped onto Guan Yi Yun’s face.
“Don’t worry, we will meet again for sure.”
Jiang Chen replied.

[1] - ‘Inferno Hell’ (炼狱) can also be translated as ‘Purgatory’.
I just thought that Inferno Hell sounded better.

chapters.title: Chapter 113 - Daoist Black
paragraphs: Under Guan Yi Yun’s lead, both of them went through the Black Mountain and arrived at its deepest area. An ancient palace was built at this place, and from the way it looked, it had at least a few hundred years of history.

Along the way, Guan Yi Yun told Jiang Chen about the Sect Chief. The Black Sect had set its foot in the Qi Province more than a few hundred years ago, and there had been a few Sect Chiefs. According to Guan Yi Yun, almost no one knew the Sect Chief’s real name, all the previous Sect Chiefs had been using the same name, Daoist Black.

Daoist Black was the strongest man within the Black Sect. His cultivation realm was at the peak of the Divine Core realm, only one step away from the Combat Soul realm. However, there was a huge gap between the Divine Core realm and the Combat Soul realm. Most people couldn’t overcome this gap no matter how much they cultivated. The Black Sect had existed for so long, but there had yet to be a single Combat Soul warrior in its history.
The palace was the Black Sect’s most important place. Normally, only the Divine Core sect elders would come here. Even Guan Yi Yun himself couldn’t come to this place without permission.

Actually, in the Black Sect, there were a group of core disciples. However, there were strict requirements for one to become a core disciple. Not only does one need to be a Divine Core warrior, one must also reach the Divine Core realm before a certain age. Therefore, the Black Sect only had a handful of core disciples. Most of them were training outside the sect, and they would rarely be near the sect headquarters. This was why the Qi Province competition was only for outer circle and inner circle disciples.
The palace was built at the mountain’s waist. Although it was just a single story building, it was still a solemn and grand building.

A black plaque was hanging on top of the palace. Two huge golden words were written on it, ‘Palace Black’. The calligraphy was written so wonderfully that it made anyone who stared at it have a feeling of wanting to worship it.

Of course, the feeling of wanting to worship could only affect those ordinary warriors. There was nothing in the Saint Origin continent that could make Jiang Chen worship it, including the small Qi Province. All this time, Jiang Chen had been the one being worshipped by others.
“Palace Black is the Black Sect’s iconic symbol, it is the noblest place. Junior disciple Jiang, later when you see the Sect Chief, don’t forget to show your respect!”
Guan Yi Yun reminded.
“En.”
Jiang Chen nodded his head.
“Come in.”
While Jiang Chen and Guan Yi Yun were talking, a deep and resonant voice suddenly sounded out from within the palace. After that, the palace door opened by itself.

Guan Yi Yun tidied up his clothes, and with a dignified expression, he walked into Palace Black. As a genius of the Black Sect, Palace Black held a very important meaning in his heart. It was his honor to be able to walk through this door.
Compared to Guan Yi Yun’s anxiety, Jiang Chen on the other side was calm and relaxed. After all, Jiang Chen’s experiences were not something Guan Yi Yun could compare with.

Jiang Chen and Guan Yi Yun both walked into the palace’s main hall. In front of them, there was a big chair, and a man wearing a white robe sitting on it. He looked to be in his forties. Of course, his real age was definitely more than that.
Although the man was sitting on a chair, Jiang Chen could still tell that he was a tall man. His angular face had a majestic expression. This was one of the Qi Province’s big shots, Daoist Black.
He looked different from Jiang Chen’s expectations. He thought that Daoist Black would be an old man with white hair, but in fact, he was a handsome middle aged man.
“Disciple Guan Yi Yun greets Sect Chief.”
“Disciple Jiang Chen greets Sect Chief.”
Guan Yi Yun bowed deeply towards Daoist Black, but Jiang Chen only nodded his head.
“En.”

Daoist Black smiled. He threw an examining look at Guan Yi Yun first, then he stared at Jiang Chen and examined him in detail. However, Daoist Black’s expression immediately changed. This 15-16 year old youngster in front of him gave him a feeling that he couldn’t be seen through at all. With his peak Divine Core cultivation base, he could easily see through any junior disciple, but when he looked at Jiang Chen, he felt like he was looking at a bottomless hole.
With a smile on his face, Jiang Chen didn’t dodge Daoist Black’s vision. There wasn’t even a slight hint of nervousness on his face. On the other side, Guan Yi Yun was incredibly nervous.

Daoist Black nodded his head, then he looked at Guan Yi Yun again and said, “Yi Yun, you’re a precious talent of the Black Sect, are you really sure you want to enter the Inferno Hell? I don’t need to tell you how dangerous the Inferno Hell is. Even if I go there myself, I would encounter danger as well.”
“Yes, I’ve decided.”

Guan Yi Yun said with a firm expression. The decision of entering Inferno Hell was made with huge determination, and he wouldn’t change his mind easily. He wanted to train himself using the dangers of Inferno Hell. Only with this could he become stronger.

“Fine, I admire your bravery. There have been many genius disciples from the Black Sect who have gone to Inferno Hell, but none of them have ever come back alive. I won’t stop you from going there, I only wish that you can be the first disciple of the Black Sect to come out from Inferno Hell.”
Daoist Black said while looking at Guan Yi Yun with a pleasant expression.
“Yi Yun won’t disappoint Sect Chief!”
Guan Yi Yun said as he cupped his fists. This was truly going to be a hellish training.
“Yi Yun, leave us alone, I have something to talk to Jiang Chen about.”
Daoist Black said.
“Yes.”
Guan Yi Yun again cupped his fists, then he left Palace Black.

Daoist Black looked at Jiang Chen. He nodded his head and said, “Not bad, with just your Mid Mortal Core strength you were able to kill Li Wu Ling, an Early Heavenly Core warrior. Although his foundation was unstable, ordinary men wouldn’t have been able to kill him. If my memory serves me well, you were still an Early Mortal Core warrior during the Qi Province competition.”
“That’s right.”
Jiang Chen didn’t deny that.
“Jiang Chen, you don’t seem to be afraid of me?”
Daoist Black asked with great interest.
Hearing the question, Jiang Chen smiled, “Why would I need to be afraid of Sect Chief? I am a disciple of the Black Sect, so obviously Sect Chief wouldn’t harm me, why would I need to be afraid?”
Jiang Chen’s reaction was calm and relaxed. There were no signs of nervousness at all.

‘This guy has a calm attitude and presence of mind, he doesn’t show any signs of unease. Besides, he has a dignified appearance and an innate aura of supremacy, I can foresee that he will have a limitless future. A genius such as this is the future hope of the Black Sect. His talent and potential is not any weaker than Nan Bei Chao’s.’

Daoist Black was shocked. He thought of Jiang Chen rather highly, he had never seen a Mortal Core youngster with such an attitude, Jiang Chen’s reaction did not fit his age at all. He was just like a phantom who had lived for more than a thousand years, calm and relaxed.

He was the Black Sect’s Sect Chief, and every single person of the Black Sect, from the novice disciples to the sect elders would behave respectfully when they met him. Even a Divine Core sect elder would feel hints of nervousness when in front of him. However, Jiang Chen only had an indifferent attitude.

“Good. Jiang Chen, I really appreciate your talent, and that’s why I asked you to come here. I heard you have a fight with Nan Bei Chao one year from now... Do you have any confidence in this fight? Nan Bei Chao is a peerless genius, and he is unrivalled within the Heavenly Core realm, and he might break through to the Divine Core realm at any time. Although you have marvelous talent and potential, your cultivation base is still too weak. You only have one year, and you are still at the Mid Mortal Core realm, how are you going to deal with this?”

Daoist Black asked. He had a great interest in this one-year fight agreement between Jiang Chen and Nan Bei Chao. Also, because Jiang Chen had become a disciple of the Black Sect, his battle with Nan Bei Chao would directly affect the reputation of the Black Sect.

As for whether or not Jiang Chen was genuinely joining the Black Sect, Daoist Black wasn’t worried about it. There were a total of four big sects in the Qi Province, and aside from the Valley of Happiness, Jiang Chen had offended the Burning Sky Pavilion and Heavenly Sword Sect. The Black Sect was the only place he could go.
“I have my ways; one year is more than enough.”
Jiang Chen shrugged with a confident look.

“Good! You just need to cultivate with all your effort. The Black Sect will never run out of resources, but, you’ll need to compete for most of the resources. No matter how big of a genius you are, you will only be able to grow under constant competition.”
Daoist Black said.
“Disciple understands.”
Jiang Chen nodded.

“Alright, Jiang Chen, you can go back now. I’ll give you a special privilege, from now on, Palace Black’s doors will always be open for you. If you encounter any questions regarding cultivation, you can come here anytime and look for me.”

Daoist Black said. This was the first time in the history of the Black Sect that a promise like this was made. Palace Black had never opened its door for a disciple from the outer circle like this. Being able to receive guidance from the Sect Chief himself was a dream for many disciples.
If any of the Black Sect disciples knew about this, they would be extremely envious.
However, too bad, Jiang Chen could only laugh at Daoist Black’s words. Does the previously greatest Saint need a little Divine Core warrior’s guidance? Was this a joke?

Without being rude, Jiang Chen could simply give Daoist Black some advice, and he would benefit hugely from it. It could even make him break through to the Combat Soul realm in a short period of time. This was something incredibly simple for Jiang Chen to do.

Of course, Jiang Chen wouldn’t give Daoist Black any guidance. His reincarnation was his biggest secret, he was not stupid enough to find himself some trouble. Besides, guidance from a Mortal Core disciple to a Divine Core Sect Chief; would Daoist Black really listen to him?

Jiang Chen cupped his fist and bowed towards Daoist Black, then he turned around and left Palace Black. Staring at Jiang Chen’s back, Daoist Black squinted his eyes, and with an indifferent voice he said, “I hope you won’t disappoint me.”
Outside Palace Black, Guan Yi Yun was still waiting for Jiang Chen. When he saw Jiang Chen walking out, he hurriedly walked up to him.
“Junior disciple Jiang, did Sect Chief give you something good?”
Guan Yi Yun asked. With his status within the Black Sect, amongst all disciples from the outer circle, only Jiang Chen could make him talk in such a polite manner.
“Do I look like I’ve gotten something good?”
Jiang Chen showed his hands, then he diverted the topic, “Senior disciple Guan, have you really decided to enter Inferno Hell tomorrow?”
“That’s right, I have made up my mind. I must act or perish; I will gamble my future within Inferno Hell!”
Guan Yi Yun said with a serious expression.
“Be careful.”
Jiang Chen reminded him. He had a pretty good impression of Guan Yi Yun, so he didn’t want to see anything bad happen to him.
“Alright, I’ll need to prepare myself. Junior disciple Jiang, you have wings, so you can just fly back on your own.”
After saying that, Guan Yi Yun flew up into the skies and soon disappeared from Jiang Chen’s vision.

chapters.title: Chapter 114 - A Resentful Genius
paragraphs: Guan Yi Yun suffered a heavy mental impact from Nan Bei Chao during the Qi Province competition. As a highly acclaimed genius, this had left a dark cloud in his mind. Therefore, for his trip to Inferno Hell, Guan Yi Yun had to dance with death; he had to succeed or die.

Jiang Chen knew that. Although Guan Yi Yun was a rare genius, compared to the abnormal Nan Bei Chao who had received blessings from lady luck herself, there was just a huge gap. Perhaps the gap between them wasn’t that wide at the moment, but soon, it would just become bigger and bigger.

In this world, there were people who were destined to live glorious lives, but there were also those who were destined to live without any achievements. It was like kings and beggars. This was destiny.

Jiang Chen didn’t use his blood wings, he descended the mountain by feet. The Black Sect had a splendid scenery, and by walking, Jiang Chen would be able to appreciate the scenery while spending his time leisurely. It was rare for Jiang Chen to be in such a relaxed mood.
At the foot of the mountain there was a peaceful path. It was a windy path that ran across the Black Mountain ranges, and it resembled a hibernating snake.
Jiang Chen walked along the path relaxed and unhurriedly while feeling the rich natural Yuan energy. The Dragon Transformation Skill started circulating.
After nearly an hour of walking, a faded aroma of herbs suddenly came from afar and surprised Jiang Chen.

Jiang Chen’s eyes lit up, and he gazed into the direction where the aroma came from. He could see a medium sized mountain standing not too far away, and the aroma was coming right from the peak of that mountain. Looking at it from where he was standing, he saw a beautiful scenery at the mountain peak, a very lively place compared to the other peaks. On top of the peak, an old pine tree that was as thick as three adult men was deeply rooted; it was at least 200-300 years old.
The mountain peak was filled with liveliness, and it attracted anyone who saw it. Jiang Chen couldn’t help but start walking towards the mountain peak.

When he arrived at the foot of the mountain, the aroma became stronger. Jiang Chen continued walking up towards the peak, then, once he had ascended halfway up the mountain, he began seeing a variety of herbs that had been planted all around. He even saw a 300-year old Blood Ginseng. An herb like this would be priceless within Red City, but here, it was just a plant that had been planted on the roadside.

“Looks like this is the place where all the herbs of the Black Sect are planted, no wonder it has such a strong aroma of herbs. Daoist Black has given me permission to enter Palace Black whenever I want, so there shouldn’t be any places within the Black Sect where I can’t go.”

Jiang Chen thought to himself as he continued ascending towards the mountain peak. Doesn’t matter if it was his past or current life, everyone looked at him as if he was a domineering king with superior combat strength, but they had also forgotten that he was also a Saint level alchemist. Jiang Chen rarely concocted pills, and in his past life, he would only do so for himself.

His combat strength had overshadowed the fact that he was also an alchemist. Jiang Chen’s concocting skills were unique, in Saint Origin, there was only a handful of people who could compare with him.

Soon, Jiang Chen silently arrived at the mountain peak, and what he saw was a completely different scenery. It was a luxuriously green and beautiful place; many rare flowers and grasses were growing everywhere. He could see that not in front of him, there was a plantation of herbs with a circumference of more than a mile; all sorts of ordinary and rare herbs were planted within.
A finely built building sat right in the middle of the peak. The scenery looked like a different world.
At this moment, there was an old man who had squatted down in the herb plantation. The old man was in his fifties, he was fat and beardless, he had an oily face, and he looked fresh.

However, the old man was frowning. He stared at two herbs that had been planted at a corner of the herb plantation. The herbs were only as big as the size of a palm, and they looked withered and lifeless.
“How can this be? Why won’t they grow?”

The old man let out a sigh, “Damn it, every single day I give you water, I transfer Yuan energy to you, and I’ve given you the best place to grow...However, not only are not growing, you even wither with each passing day, who can tell me why?”
The old man felt helpless and was getting angrier. He wanted to pull these two herbs out from the dirt, but he just couldn’t do it.
“Hmph! I don’t believe there’s an herb that I, Guo Shan can’t grow!”

The old man let out a cold snort. His name was Guo Shan, and he was a Divine Core warrior, as well as the best alchemist in the Black Sect; this entire mountain belonged to him. In the Black Sect, he was an important person. Many young alchemists were his students, and even Daoist Black would need to show respect towards him.
“Planting the Flaming Angel and the Glory Lotus together, it would take a miracle for them to grow. In my opinion, both of them will die within a month.”
A voice suddenly came from behind.
“Who’s there?”

Guo Shan stood up and turned around, then he saw a young man wearing white clothes standing behind him. Guo Shan previously had all his attention focused on these two herb plants, that was why he hadn’t been able to notice someone behind him. Besides, this mountain peak was not a place where any disciple could come.

Guo Shan threw an examining look at Jiang Chen and discovered that he was only at the Mortal Core realm. Guo Shan furrowed his brows and asked, “You’re just a disciple from the outer circle; do you have any idea what this place is?”

Guo Shan was mad; he was in a bad mood due to these two plants. The Flaming Angel and the Glory Lotus were both premium herbs, and he had gone through a lot of effort to get their seeds. But now, he was on a road heading towards failure, and the plants were going to die soon, that was why he was so mad.
“I came here because of the herbs’ aroma. Disciple Jiang Chen greets Elder.”
Jiang Chen cupped his fist and greeted Guo Shan.
“Jiang Chen? So you are that Jiang Chen who got first place in the Qi Province competition, the newcomer?”
Guo Shan’s eyes widened. Although he had never participated in the sect’s management, he had still heard the big news regarding Jiang Chen.
“Yes, I am.”
Jiang Chen nodded his head.

After confirming Jiang Chen’s identity, Guo Shan’s attitude towards Jiang Chen became better. If it was just another disciple from the outer circle, Guo Shan would have just slapped him for intruding his mountain without permission.
But Jiang Chen received different treatment. A genius would receive respect no matter where he went.
“Young man, so you can recognize the Flaming Angel and the Glory Lotus, not bad.”

Guo Shan praised. In fact, the reason why he didn’t slap Jiang Chen when he saw him was mostly because Jiang Chen had been able to recognize the two herbs. The Flaming Angel and the Glory Lotus were only in their seedling stage, and an ordinary alchemist wouldn’t have been able to recognize them at all.
“I know a little bit about them.”
Jiang Chen smiled, then he slowly walked towards the herb plantation. When he looked at the Flaming Angel and the Glory Lotus, he shook his head.

Guo Shan was amazed by Jiang Chen, this young man was only at the Mortal Core realm, but he didn’t show any signs of being nervous when facing a Divine Core Elder. Just from his calm attitude alone, he would be able to win the hearts of the people.
“Jiang Chen, why did you say that the Flaming Angel and the Glory Lotus can’t be planted together? I want to know why, both of them are pure Yang herbs, why can’t they be together?”
Guo Shan asked with great interest, he wanted to see how Jiang Chen was going to explain.

“Very simple, the Flaming Angel has a Hot Yang characteristic, so not matter which stage, seedling or mature, it is a pure Yang herb. On the other side, the Glory Lotus has a mild characteristic. When you planted them side by side, the Flaming Angel’s pure Yang characteristic started repressing the Glory Lotus’s growth.”
Jiang Chen explained.

Hearing this, Guo Shan’s eyes lit up. He felt more respect towards Jiang Chen now. Being able to analyze the characteristics of the Flaming Angel and the Glory Lotus so thoroughly, this proved that Jiang Chen did have a certain level of knowledge towards herbs and medications.
“Even if what you said is correct, the Flaming Angel would repress the growth of the Glory Lotus, but then, the Flaming Angel should still grow, so why is not only not growing, but dying as well?”

Guo Shan asked again, he really wanted to know the reason. If it wasn’t because of this, with his status and position, there would be no way he would ever ask for advice from an outer circle disciple.

“The reason is even simpler. The Glory Lotus contains the characteristics of both the Glory Lotus King and the Snowy Lotus, and when the Glory Lotus reaches its mature stage, the characteristics of the Glory Lotus King will completely suppress the characteristics of the Snowy Lotus, and then it will become a pure Yang herb. However, while it’s still in its seedling stage, both the Glory Lotus King and the Snowy Lotus’s characteristics exist, and that’s why this Glory Lotus is not only a pure Yang herb, it also has the cold characteristics of the Snowy Lotus. This is why it has repressed the Flaming Angel’s growth. When you planted them together, you were basically killing them both.”

Jiang Chen said casually, but Guo Shan became startled when he heard what Jiang Chen said, with his mouth wide open. He stared at this young man in awe, as if he had just seen a ghost. Although he didn’t want to admit this, but the young man in front of him was more knowledgeable than him about herbs and medication.

‘What kind of monster is this young man; how come he knows so much about herbs? I only know that when the Glory Lotus becomes mature, its characteristics will be pure Yang, but I never knew about its origin... and he even knew about the Glory Lotus King”

Guo Shan was shocked, but he didn’t have any doubts about what Jiang Chen had just said. With that being said, this highly acclaimed alchemist of the Black Sect had just learned something from a young man, a very important lesson.
“Jiang Chen, where did you learn this?”
Guo Shan asked.
“Elder, don’t you know that there exists geniuses in this world? I’m a genius.”
Jiang Chen shrugged.
“Fine, you’re a really amazing genius, and you have impressed me. Tell me, can I save my Flaming Angel and Glory Lotus?”
Guo Shan eagerly asked.

“Of course, just plant them separately in different places within the herb plantation. The Flaming Angel and the Glory Lotus are top tier herbs with great vitality, and you don’t need to help their growth; they will grow by themselves.
Jiang Chen said.
“Jiang Chen, let me ask you another question, how can I mix the Barley Grass and the Yellow Stone Fruit so that they don’t explode during concoction?”
Guo Shan ventured, trying to figure out whether or not Jiang Chen really know everything.

“Elder is trying to concoct the Yellow Soul Pill. The Barley Grass and the Yellow Stone Fruit have opposite characteristics, it’s very difficult to mix them together. However, with the help of a first-rate Sand Crystal, they can easily be mixed together without exploding, and it will also help increase the overall quality of the Yellow Soul Pill.”
When Jiang Chen finished his words, he could see Guo Shan standing there, staring at him blankly, completely startled.

chapters.title: Chapter 115 - Myriad Demon Mountain
paragraphs: Overwhelming, too shocking.

Jiang Chen’s reply was like a strike of lightning onto Guo Shan’s head. He had been trying to concoct the Yellow Soul Pill recently, but he couldn’t get the Barley Grass and the Yellow Stone Fruit to mix together, which resulted in a few of his furnaces exploding. This had almost become the biggest obstacle in his mind. When Jiang Chen heard his question, not only did he come up with a solution, he could also tell the name of the pill he was trying to concoct.
Most importantly, when Jiang Chen replied to Guo Shan’s question, it didn’t even take him a split second to think, he had answered like the theories and solutions were deeply rooted in his mind.
“Heavens! Using a first-rate Sand Crystal to blend the Barley Grass and the Yellow Stone Fruit together, why couldn’t I think of this earlier?”
It was now clear for Guo Shan, and he had a sudden feeling of enlightenment. He felt like a student who had been troubled by a question, and then suddenly his teacher told him the solution.
“How can I concoct a 100% effectiveness Heavenly Torrent Pill?”
Guo Shan asked again.

“The Heavenly Torrent isn’t a top-quality pill, but it can help cultivators concentrate their Divine Sense. Although it isn’t a top-quality pill, it is extremely difficult to concoct. The Divine Sense is the root of a human. It can’t suffer any damage, and therefore, only Heavenly Torrent Pills with 100% effectiveness can be used. If it’s less than 100%, then it’s basically useless.”

Jiang Chen continued with a smile, “In order to concoct the Heavenly Torrent Pill, the Immemorial Fruit is the main ingredient. A 80 year old fruit is the best. If it’s any older than this, the portion will be too big, and it will be difficult to control. Any younger than this, and it simply won’t meet the requirements for a Heavenly Torrent Pill. Therefore, in order to concoct a 100% effectiveness Heavenly Torrent Pill, besides concoction skills, the most important element is how old the Immemorial Fruit is.”

Guo Shan’s eyes widened more, the way he looked at Jiang Chen had completely changed. These questions he asked had troubled him for a long time, but this young man in front of him is simply a man who knows everything. With just a few words, he had solved his problems for him.
“Can the petals of the Hades Flower be used to concoct the Flaming Pill?”
Guo Shan asked again.

“Sure it can, the Hades Flower is a poisonous flower, and its strong poison needs to be mixed with the pistil of the Scarlet Crane Flower, which is also a poisonous herb. Not only will this not affect the quality of the Flaming Pill, it will also increase its strength.”
Jiang Chen said.
‘Fuck, I didn’t know the Hades Flower and the pistil of the Scarlet Crane Flower could be used in such a manner!’
Guo Shan was amazed once again. Right now, he had completely forgotten that Jiang Chen was a disciple from the outer circle. The way he looked at Jiang Chen was filled with admiration.
“Jiang Chen, how does one solve the problem of soul energy becoming restless?”
Guo Shan asked again.

“The reason why a person’s soul energy becomes restless is because they are impulsive in trying to get quick results when cultivating soul skills. Just following the principle of gradual improvement will do.”
Jiang Chen answered.
“Let me ask you this...”

Guo Shan continued asking dozens of questions. All of his questions were things that had troubled him for many years without him being able to get any answers to them. These questions were the main reason why his growth in alchemy had become so slow.
However, today, Jiang Chen had answered all of his questions. Guo Shan could feel the shadows cast over his mind completely disappear, and his pill concocting skill increasing at the same time.
“Hahaha, good, perfect! Brother Jiang, you really are a peerless genius! You have helped me solve all the problems that have troubled me for so many years! Accept mine, Guo Shan’s gratitude!”
Guo Shan was laughing loudly, then he bowed deeply towards Jiang Chen.

Jiang Chen smiled and accepted the bow. It was Guo Shan’s honor to be able to receive guidance from Jiang Chen. Besides, Jiang Chen knew that Guo Shan had devoted all his energy into alchemy, his persistency was not something that ordinary people could understand. The answers given to him, none of them could be purchased with money. Guo Shan’s bow signified his gratitude.
“Don’t mention it, Elder Guo. I just happened to pass by.”
Jiang Chen smiled.

“Don’t address me as Elder, just big brother will do. Although my cultivation level is at a higher level than yours, when it comes to alchemy, you are my senior. I’m older than you, so in the future, just addressing me as big brother will do.”
Guo Shan patted Jiang Chen’s shoulder forcefully.
“Big brother Guo.”

Jiang Chen did it like Guo Shan had told him. He could tell that Guo Shan was a man with a true nature, and he would never limit himself to an old pattern. Jiang Chen liked this kind of personality. Besides, being able to become brother of the Black Sect’s best alchemist wouldn’t bring Jiang Chen any harm either.
In the Black Sect, only Jiang Chen could become brother to Guo Shan.

“Brother Jiang, luckily you happened to pass by, if not, I don’t know when my questions would be answered. However, what’s puzzling me is how you can be so knowledgeable. Alchemy isn’t like anything else, we need to explore along the way in order to accumulate our knowledge. Judging by what you know, I think you’d at least need to spend more than a hundred years to reach this level of knowledge. But, you’re only 15-16 years old, this is impossible.”

Guo Shan was really amazed; he couldn’t imagine how a 15-16 year old young man could be so knowledgeable in alchemy. If he hadn’t experienced all of this by himself, he wouldn’t believe that someone like this truly existed.
“Didn’t I tell you? I’m a genius.”
Jiang Chen shrugged again.

“Damn it, a genius really can’t be judged by normal standards. Brother Jiang, I suppose you are an alchemist too. With your knowledge, if you focus all you effort onto alchemy, I’m sure you will become the greatest alchemist of the generation, with your name heard by many people from all over the world.
Guo Shan said.
“Big brother Guo, alchemy is just my hobby, I am not really too much into it. Compared to the excitement from fighting in battles, I prefer the latter.”
Jiang Chen raised his head and stared into the skies afar. Guo Shan would never understand his vision.
“Sigh... Too bad. However, with your abilities and knowledge, I’m sure you’ll become a great cultivation master, as well as an expert in pill concoction.”
Breathing out a sigh, Guo Shan said again, “I heard that you have a fight with Nan Bei Chao one year from now?”
“Yes, I do.”
Jiang Chen nodded his head.
“That Nan Bei Chao is a rare genius in the Qi Province who has received blessings from lady luck herself. His future achievements will be limitless... One year, it’s too little for you.”

Guo Shan said. The news about the one-year fight date between Jiang Chen and Nan Bei Chao had spread across the entire Qi Province, so of course Guo Shan had heard the news. Putting aside the question whether or not Jiang Chen would be able to fight Nan Bei Chao in one year, with just his bravery alone, he was far superior to anyone else.
“I have my ways, don’t worry, big brother Guo.”
Jiang Chen smiled.

On the same day, Jiang Chen and Guo Shan had a great chat. Guo Shan even treated Jiang Chen with some wine that took 18 herbs to brew. Rumors said that so far, only Daoist Black had tasted it, and now Jiang Chen was the second one.
When the evening came, Jiang Chen bid his farewell.
“Brother Jiang, if you ever need anything in the Black Sect, just come to me, Guo Shan!”
Guo Shan said as he slammed his chest.
“Definitely, I’ll come here frequently just because of this wine alone.”
Jiang Chen said with a mischievous laughter.
Hearing this, Guo Shan’s expression changed, “I think it’s better if you don’t come here anymore...”

When Jiang Chen mentioned his wine, Guo Shan immediately felt some pain in his heart. He took out his best wine to treat Jiang Chen, just wanting to show him his wine brewing skills. However, he never expected that this bastard would drink the wine like plain water. What a reckless waste.

Jiang Chen spread his blood wings and flew off from Guo Shan’s mountain, heading back towards his residence. Becoming friends with Guo Shan was a good thing for Jiang Chen. In the future, when he needs any pills, he won’t need to worry about the herb supply any more. Since he has a strong body, as well as intense blood and qi, his main focus was cultivation level, and not alchemy. The Dragon Transformation skill doesn’t require too many pills.

At Jiang Chen’s residence, there were 4 or 5 men waiting outside. The man in front was Wang Yun, and there were a few other outer circle Mortal Core disciple as well. When they saw Jiang Chen coming, their eyes lit up.
“Senior disciple Jiang is back!”
Someone said. When they saw the blood wings on Jiang Chen’s back, they couldn’t help but show envious expressions.
Jiang Chen retracted his blood wings and landed right next to those men.
“Wang Yun, you guys are looking for me?”
Jiang Chen asked.
“We wish to invite senior disciple Jiang to venture together with us, we’re going to the Myriad Demon Mountain!”
Wang Yun said.
“Myriad Demon Mountain?”
Jiang Chen furrowed his brows, he had never heard of this place.

“I suppose senior disciple Jiang doesn’t know this place yet. The Myriad Demon Mountain is a mountain range, it’s a training ground for all of the Black Sect’s disciples. Within the mountain range, all sorts of demon beasts can be found, and there’s a lot of natural resources and treasures as well. We’re going to have venture into the Myriad Demon Mountain, and if senior disciple Jiang could go with us; it would be our blessing!”
One of the disciples said.
“That’s right, with our strength, we can only venture into the first sector; but if senior disciple Jiang could go with us, perhaps we would be able to venture to the border of the second sector!”
Another disciple said.
“I see.”
Jiang Chen finally understood, their purpose was to look for his protection. With Jiang Chen’s strength, they would be safe if they ventured into the mountain together.
“Wang Yun, tell me more details about the Myriad Demon Mountain.”

Jiang Chen said. He showed great interest towards this Myriad Demon Mountain. There was only one year left before his fight with Nan Bei Chao, and time was running short with every single day. Therefore, he was thinking about how he could constantly increase his cultivation level. Depending on the Black Sect alone is far from enough, he was cultivating with the Dragon Transformation Skill, and he was able to absorb innate abilities of demon beasts; so hunting demon beasts is the most straightforward way to level up.
