“The Myriad Demon Mountain is a primitive mountain range. The distance between here and the Myriad Demon Mountain is about a thousand miles. The Myriad Demon Mountain is divided into three sectors, and in the first sector there are mostly only Qi Hai and Mortal Core demon beasts, and sometimes, there are even some Heavenly Core demon beasts, but they rarely appear in the first sector. As for the second sector, most demon beasts are Heavenly Core demon beasts, and it’s a dangerous place for us. All this time, only those Heavenly Core disciples from the inner circle has dared train in there. Although senior disciple Jiang is just at the Mortal Core realm, but since you’ve killed Li Wu Ling who was a Heavenly Core warrior, I’m sure you can go to the border of the second sector safely. As for sector three, I’ve heard that there are some mighty Divine Core demon beasts dominating that area. It’s a terrifying place, and people rarely venture there.”
Wang Yun said.

sentences.text: Overwhelming, too shocking.
Jiang Chen’s reply was like a strike of lightning onto Guo Shan’s head.
He had been trying to concoct the Yellow Soul Pill recently, but he couldn’t get the Barley Grass and the Yellow Stone Fruit to mix together, which resulted in a few of his furnaces exploding.
This had almost become the biggest obstacle in his mind.
When Jiang Chen heard his question, not only did he come up with a solution, he could also tell the name of the pill he was trying to concoct.
Most importantly, when Jiang Chen replied to Guo Shan’s question, it didn’t even take him a split second to think, he had answered like the theories and solutions were deeply rooted in his mind.
“Heavens!
Using a first-rate Sand Crystal to blend the Barley Grass and the Yellow Stone Fruit together, why couldn’t I think of this earlier?”
It was now clear for Guo Shan, and he had a sudden feeling of enlightenment.
He felt like a student who had been troubled by a question, and then suddenly his teacher told him the solution.
“How can I concoct a 100% effectiveness Heavenly Torrent Pill?”
Guo Shan asked again.
“The Heavenly Torrent isn’t a top-quality pill, but it can help cultivators concentrate their Divine Sense.
Although it isn’t a top-quality pill, it is extremely difficult to concoct.
The Divine Sense is the root of a human.
It can’t suffer any damage, and therefore, only Heavenly Torrent Pills with 100% effectiveness can be used.
If it’s less than 100%, then it’s basically useless.”
Jiang Chen continued with a smile, “In order to concoct the Heavenly Torrent Pill, the Immemorial Fruit is the main ingredient.
A 80 year old fruit is the best.
If it’s any older than this, the portion will be too big, and it will be difficult to control.
Any younger than this, and it simply won’t meet the requirements for a Heavenly Torrent Pill.
Therefore, in order to concoct a 100% effectiveness Heavenly Torrent Pill, besides concoction skills, the most important element is how old the Immemorial Fruit is.”
Guo Shan’s eyes widened more, the way he looked at Jiang Chen had completely changed.
These questions he asked had troubled him for a long time, but this young man in front of him is simply a man who knows everything.
With just a few words, he had solved his problems for him.
“Can the petals of the Hades Flower be used to concoct the Flaming Pill?”
Guo Shan asked again.
“Sure it can, the Hades Flower is a poisonous flower, and its strong poison needs to be mixed with the pistil of the Scarlet Crane Flower, which is also a poisonous herb.
Not only will this not affect the quality of the Flaming Pill, it will also increase its strength.”
Jiang Chen said.
‘Fuck, I didn’t know the Hades Flower and the pistil of the Scarlet Crane Flower could be used in such a manner!’
Guo Shan was amazed once again.
Right now, he had completely forgotten that Jiang Chen was a disciple from the outer circle.
The way he looked at Jiang Chen was filled with admiration.
“Jiang Chen, how does one solve the problem of soul energy becoming restless?”
Guo Shan asked again.
“The reason why a person’s soul energy becomes restless is because they are impulsive in trying to get quick results when cultivating soul skills.
Just following the principle of gradual improvement will do.”
Jiang Chen answered.
“Let me ask you this...”
Guo Shan continued asking dozens of questions.
All of his questions were things that had troubled him for many years without him being able to get any answers to them.
These questions were the main reason why his growth in alchemy had become so slow.
However, today, Jiang Chen had answered all of his questions.
Guo Shan could feel the shadows cast over his mind completely disappear, and his pill concocting skill increasing at the same time.
“Hahaha, good, perfect!
Brother Jiang, you really are a peerless genius!
You have helped me solve all the problems that have troubled me for so many years!
Accept mine, Guo Shan’s gratitude!”
Guo Shan was laughing loudly, then he bowed deeply towards Jiang Chen.
Jiang Chen smiled and accepted the bow.
It was Guo Shan’s honor to be able to receive guidance from Jiang Chen.
Besides, Jiang Chen knew that Guo Shan had devoted all his energy into alchemy, his persistency was not something that ordinary people could understand.
The answers given to him, none of them could be purchased with money.
Guo Shan’s bow signified his gratitude.
“Don’t mention it, Elder Guo.
I just happened to pass by.”
Jiang Chen smiled.
“Don’t address me as Elder, just big brother will do.
Although my cultivation level is at a higher level than yours, when it comes to alchemy, you are my senior.
I’m older than you, so in the future, just addressing me as big brother will do.”
Guo Shan patted Jiang Chen’s shoulder forcefully.
“Big brother Guo.”
Jiang Chen did it like Guo Shan had told him.
He could tell that Guo Shan was a man with a true nature, and he would never limit himself to an old pattern.
Jiang Chen liked this kind of personality.
Besides, being able to become brother of the Black Sect’s best alchemist wouldn’t bring Jiang Chen any harm either.
In the Black Sect, only Jiang Chen could become brother to Guo Shan.
“Brother Jiang, luckily you happened to pass by, if not, I don’t know when my questions would be answered.
However, what’s puzzling me is how you can be so knowledgeable.
Alchemy isn’t like anything else, we need to explore along the way in order to accumulate our knowledge.
Judging by what you know, I think you’d at least need to spend more than a hundred years to reach this level of knowledge.
But, you’re only 15-16 years old, this is impossible.”
Guo Shan was really amazed; he couldn’t imagine how a 15-16 year old young man could be so knowledgeable in alchemy.
If he hadn’t experienced all of this by himself, he wouldn’t believe that someone like this truly existed.
“Didn’t I tell you?
I’m a genius.”
Jiang Chen shrugged again.
“Damn it, a genius really can’t be judged by normal standards.
Brother Jiang, I suppose you are an alchemist too.
With your knowledge, if you focus all you effort onto alchemy, I’m sure you will become the greatest alchemist of the generation, with your name heard by many people from all over the world.
Guo Shan said.
“Big brother Guo, alchemy is just my hobby, I am not really too much into it.
Compared to the excitement from fighting in battles, I prefer the latter.”
Jiang Chen raised his head and stared into the skies afar.
Guo Shan would never understand his vision.
“Sigh...
Too bad.
However, with your abilities and knowledge, I’m sure you’ll become a great cultivation master, as well as an expert in pill concoction.”
Breathing out a sigh, Guo Shan said again, “I heard that you have a fight with Nan Bei Chao one year from now?”
“Yes, I do.”
Jiang Chen nodded his head.
“That Nan Bei Chao is a rare genius in the Qi Province who has received blessings from lady luck herself.
His future achievements will be limitless...
One year, it’s too little for you.”
Guo Shan said.
The news about the one-year fight date between Jiang Chen and Nan Bei Chao had spread across the entire Qi Province, so of course Guo Shan had heard the news.
Putting aside the question whether or not Jiang Chen would be able to fight Nan Bei Chao in one year, with just his bravery alone, he was far superior to anyone else.
“I have my ways, don’t worry, big brother Guo.”
Jiang Chen smiled.
On the same day, Jiang Chen and Guo Shan had a great chat.
Guo Shan even treated Jiang Chen with some wine that took 18 herbs to brew.
Rumors said that so far, only Daoist Black had tasted it, and now Jiang Chen was the second one.
When the evening came, Jiang Chen bid his farewell.
“Brother Jiang, if you ever need anything in the Black Sect, just come to me, Guo Shan!”
Guo Shan said as he slammed his chest.
“Definitely, I’ll come here frequently just because of this wine alone.”
Jiang Chen said with a mischievous laughter.
Hearing this, Guo Shan’s expression changed, “I think it’s better if you don’t come here anymore...”
When Jiang Chen mentioned his wine, Guo Shan immediately felt some pain in his heart.
He took out his best wine to treat Jiang Chen, just wanting to show him his wine brewing skills.
However, he never expected that this bastard would drink the wine like plain water.
What a reckless waste.
Jiang Chen spread his blood wings and flew off from Guo Shan’s mountain, heading back towards his residence.
Becoming friends with Guo Shan was a good thing for Jiang Chen.
In the future, when he needs any pills, he won’t need to worry about the herb supply any more.
Since he has a strong body, as well as intense blood and qi, his main focus was cultivation level, and not alchemy.
The Dragon Transformation skill doesn’t require too many pills.
At Jiang Chen’s residence, there were 4 or 5 men waiting outside.
The man in front was Wang Yun, and there were a few other outer circle Mortal Core disciple as well.
When they saw Jiang Chen coming, their eyes lit up.
“Senior disciple Jiang is back!”
Someone said.
When they saw the blood wings on Jiang Chen’s back, they couldn’t help but show envious expressions.
Jiang Chen retracted his blood wings and landed right next to those men.
“Wang Yun, you guys are looking for me?”
Jiang Chen asked.
“We wish to invite senior disciple Jiang to venture together with us, we’re going to the Myriad Demon Mountain!”
Wang Yun said.
“Myriad Demon Mountain?”
Jiang Chen furrowed his brows, he had never heard of this place.
“I suppose senior disciple Jiang doesn’t know this place yet.
The Myriad Demon Mountain is a mountain range, it’s a training ground for all of the Black Sect’s disciples.
Within the mountain range, all sorts of demon beasts can be found, and there’s a lot of natural resources and treasures as well.
We’re going to have venture into the Myriad Demon Mountain, and if senior disciple Jiang could go with us; it would be our blessing!”
One of the disciples said.
“That’s right, with our strength, we can only venture into the first sector; but if senior disciple Jiang could go with us, perhaps we would be able to venture to the border of the second sector!”
Another disciple said.
“I see.”
Jiang Chen finally understood, their purpose was to look for his protection.
With Jiang Chen’s strength, they would be safe if they ventured into the mountain together.
“Wang Yun, tell me more details about the Myriad Demon Mountain.”
Jiang Chen said.
He showed great interest towards this Myriad Demon Mountain.
There was only one year left before his fight with Nan Bei Chao, and time was running short with every single day.
Therefore, he was thinking about how he could constantly increase his cultivation level.

Depending on the Black Sect alone is far from enough, he was cultivating with the Dragon Transformation Skill, and he was able to absorb innate abilities of demon beasts; so hunting demon beasts is the most straightforward way to level up.
If he was lucky, he might bump into some demon beasts with unique bloodlines, and then turn their abilities into his own.
“The Myriad Demon Mountain is a primitive mountain range.
The distance between here and the Myriad Demon Mountain is about a thousand miles.

The Myriad Demon Mountain is divided into three sectors, and in the first sector there are mostly only Qi Hai and Mortal Core demon beasts, and sometimes, there are even some Heavenly Core demon beasts, but they rarely appear in the first sector.
As for the second sector, most demon beasts are Heavenly Core demon beasts, and it’s a dangerous place for us.
All this time, only those Heavenly Core disciples from the inner circle has dared train in there.
Although senior disciple Jiang is just at the Mortal Core realm, but since you’ve killed Li Wu Ling who was a Heavenly Core warrior, I’m sure you can go to the border of the second sector safely.
As for sector three, I’ve heard that there are some mighty Divine Core demon beasts dominating that area.
It’s a terrifying place, and people rarely venture there.”
Wang Yun said.

chapters.title: Chapter 116 - Stepped on a Demon Lord
paragraphs: After listening to Wang Yun’s words, Jiang Chen finally understood. The Myriad Demon Mountain is a training ground for the Black Sect’s disciples. It was a dangerous place, however, its danger couldn’t compare to Inferno Hell where Guan Yi Yun was about to go.
“Senior disciple Jiang, please go with us together!”
Someone said. With desperate looks, all of them stared at Jiang Chen.

“Wang Yun, the few of you are strong enough to be a group. As long as you don’t get close to the second sector, there shouldn’t be any danger. I had some insight during these last two days, so I am going to enter secluded cultivation, and I can’t go with you this time.”

Jiang Chen said with a smile on his face. Actually, he had decided to take a look at this Myriad Demon Mountain, but he didn’t want to go with Wang Yun. To him, Wang Yun and the others were burdens, and the first sector didn’t seem enough of a challenge to him. If he were to go, he would go to the second sector straight away, and if these men followed him there, it would be difficult and troublesome for him to handle the situation, as he still needed to take care of their safety.

Besides, the most ideal partner for Jiang Chen for this trip would be Big Yellow, who has a unique innate ability to sense treasure. The treasures Big Yellow are able to find are always some priceless treasure, and this was the main reason why Jiang Chen didn’t want to go with Wang Yun and the rest.

Wang Yun and the rest felt disappointed after hearing what Jiang Chen said, but they couldn’t say anything to Jiang Chen’s reaction. With Jiang Chen’s status and position in the sect, they should be feeling grateful that he still talked to them so politely. If it was some other genius disciple, they would have become proud and arrogant after becoming so famous, and never even bother taking a second look at them.
“It’s good news that senior disciple Jiang managed to comprehend something! We shouldn’t get in the way of his secluded cultivation!”
Wang Yun spoke again, “Senior disciple Jiang, since that is the case, we’ll leave for the Myriad Demon Mountain now.”
“Alright, have a safe journey.”
Jiang Chen nodded his head.
The group cupped their fists and bid goodbye to Jiang Chen. After that, they walked towards the exit of the Black Sect
“Myriad Demon Mountain.”

Jiang Chen murmured, it seemed like he had to pay a visit to this Myriad Demon Mountain. He had now formed 40 Dragon Marks, and the energy needed for another 20 Dragon Marks was huge. It simply couldn’t be gained by just staying in the Black Sect and cultivating alone.

“Since I have decided to cultivate the Dragon Transformation skill, it is destined that I will walk a tough cultivation path. It will just get tougher and tougher to level up in the future; the energy needed is simply massive. I have to use whatever methods I can to level up so that I can fight Nan Bei Chao a year from now.”

Jiang Chen’s face turned serious, he only had one year. He was cultivating the Dragon Transformation skill, and it was tougher for him to break through to higher realms compared to others. Therefore, he had decided, once Big Yellow woke up, he would immediately bring him with him to the Myriad Demon Mountain.

Jiang Chen went back to his courtyard. He scanned all rooms with his Divine Sense and found that in one room, Yan Chen Yu was still in her secluded cultivation, trying to absorb the Freezing Crystal. In the other room, when Jiang Chen saw what Big Yellow was doing, he became speechless. He found Big Yellow sleeping on a soft bed with all four legs in the air, drooling all over the bed.

But what really made Jiang Chen speechless wasn’t the way Big Yellow was sleeping, but his current situation. Big Yellow was covered in a bright, golden light. This golden light became thicker and thicker, and it slowly formed into a huge cocoon, with Big Yellow inside. Then, a Divine aura belonging only to Divine Beasts slowly flowed out from his body. A dog with a Divine Aura, the heavens truly likes to have fun sometimes.
“The heir of a Dragon Horse can never be judged using ordinary standards. Breaking through while sleeping... I’m afraid that in this world, only this dog has this special ability.”
Jiang Chen shook his head with a bitter smile. If there was a competition of leveling up, Big Yellow would definitely be the champion.

“Xiao Yu has completely immersed herself in the absorption of the Freezing Crystal with her Nine Yin Meridians. This is a rare opportunity for her, and she won’t be waking up anytime soon. However, once she wakes up, I believe she will be at the Late Mortal Core realm.”

Jiang Chen looked at Yan Chen Yu and thought to himself. She possessed the Nine Yin Meridians, and that gave her a unique talent and lots of potential. It was also not something that ordinary people couldd compare with.

But in fact, the most abnormal person here was actually Jiang Chen. He was a Saint before he reincarnated, and although he looked only 15-16 years old, he was a genuine old monster who had the cultivation experience of a Saint. This made it so that no one in the world could compare with him. Also, the Dragon Transformation skill was a terrifying skill. It allowed him to absorb any bloodline in the world, and it was not hard to imagine that following the growth of the Dragon Transformation skill, Jiang Chen would keep absorbing different bloodlines and form his own unique bloodline, surpassing all other Divine Body characteristics in the whole universe.

Big Yellow had slept for two days, and during this period, Jiang Chen never disturbed him. He waited in the courtyard and spent some time cultivating his Six Solar Fingers and Clap of Thunder combat skill.

“This dog really does sleep for a long period of time. Two days, Wang Yun and the rest have already arrived at the Myriad Demon Mountain, and perhaps they will return in another two days... This damned dog, he is still sleeping!”
Jiang Chen was speechless and helpless, he was once the greatest Saint in the universe, and now he had to sit here all alone and wait for a dog to wake up.
Buzz...

Suddenly, a buzzing sound sounded out from within Big Yellow’s room. Jiang Chen scanned with his Divine Sense and found that the golden cocoon that covered Big Yellow’s body had reached its maximum size, and the buzzing sound came right from it.
The next second, the golden cocoon retracted into Big Yellow’s body like it was water. A powerful energy emerged from Big Yellow’s body, but it immediately disappeared. Big Yellow had hidden it well.
“Damn this dog.”
Jiang Chen was speechless; Big Yellow had let him witness how easy it was for him to level up.
Swoosh!
The door to Big Yellow’s room opened up, then he flew out like a golden bolt of lightning, landing right beside Jiang Chen.
“Hey, how long has your father been sleeping?”
Big Yellow asked.
“You’ve slept for three days. Damn it, you sure can sleep, huh.”
Jiang Chen gazed at Big Yellow.
“It’s only been three days... Let me sleep a few more days then.”
After saying that, Big Yellow turned around and walked back towards his room. Some black lines appeared on Jiang Chen’s forehead, he immediately grabbed Big Yellow’s tail.”
“Ruff woof! Kid, let go!”

“Fuck, you have slept for three days, and you still want to sleep more?! Damn it, I, your father am going to the Myriad Demon Mountain to hunt some demon beasts, are you coming or not? If not, then just stay here and continue your slumber!”
Jiang Chen said.
“Myriad Demon Mountain? Hunting demon beasts?”
Big Yellow stood up with glowing eyes.
“When are we going? Your father is about to die from boredom!”

Going out and having some fun is Big Yellow’s hobby. When he first arrived at the Black Sect, he wanted to find something fun to do, but was rejected. Now, hearing that Jiang Chen is going to the Myriad Demon Mountain, of course he would be interested in going.
“We’ll go right now, we should be able to arrive at the Myriad Demon Mountain before dark.”
Jiang Chen said.
“The Myriad Demon Mountain isn’t far from here, it’s only about a thousand miles. With our speed, we can arrive there very quickly.”
Big Yellow said. The time now was late afternoon, a distance of a thousand miles wasn’t really that big for Jiang Chen and Big Yellow who could fly.
“You know about the Myriad Demon Mountain?”
Jiang Chen felt surprised.

“There’s nothing I don’t know about in this Qi Province. The Myriad Demon Mountain is the training ground for the disciples of the Black Sect. Lots of wild demon beasts hide inside, and it’s filled with danger and adventure.”
Big Yellow was enraptured.
“Then let’s not delay any longer, let’s go now.”
After saying that, Jiang Chen spread his blood wings and flew up into the sky. Big Yellow followed behind and spread his wings of light, dancing and gesticulating for joy.

The Black Sect was located in the northern region of the Qi Province, and the Myriad Demon Mountain was located north of the Black Sect. The mountain was at the border of the Qi Province, right next to the neighboring province.
The sky was getting darker, and the night fell down. The demon beasts in the Myriad Demon Mountain started roaring as a welcome for the night, scaring all those who were close by.
Two figures quietly appeared above the Myriad Demon Mountain, they were Jiang Chen and Big Yellow.
“Wang Yun told me that the first sector is mostly filled with Qi Hai and Mortal Core demon beasts. For me, it’s not challenging enough. Let’s go to the second sector straight away.”
Jiang Chen flapped his wings, then he flew towards the second sector straight away. Big Yellow followed behind while happily waggling his tail.
With Jiang Chen’s current strength, no one in the Mortal Core realm could resist a single attack from him, therefore, he didn’t find sector one to be enough of a challenge.
Big Yellow had broken through to the Late Mortal Core realm, and with his mighty strength and strong body as the heir of the Dragon Horse, he could even defeat ordinary Heavenly Core warriors.

The two of them teaming up together, they were one super insane duo. If anyone thought they were just some ordinary Mortal Core warriors and tried messing with them, the consequences would be miserable.

When the sky turned dark completely, Jiang Chen and Big Yellow Dog had ventured a thousand miles into the Mountain of Thousand Goblins. The area where they were now, was just tens of miles away from sector two.
“We are going to enter sector two, the demon beasts here should be powerful enough.”
Jiang Chen retracted his blood wings and descended onto the ground.
The place where Jiang Chen landed was a black colored hump. It looked like some dirt clump that no one would pay any attention to, even Jiang Chen and Big Yellow didn’t notice anything unusual.
Crack~

When Jiang Chen’s feet touched the dirt clump, it made a cracking sound. It didn’t take long for Jiang Chen to notice that something was wrong, he felt the dirt clump was soft, like some living thing.
At this moment, a huge force exploded from underneath his feet, sending Jiang Chen far away.
“The fuck!”

Jiang Chen was shocked, he immediately leaped away and positioned himself dozens of feet away. Big Yellow also landed beside him. Both of them stares at the dirt clump in awe, then they saw that the hump suddenly jumped up from the ground.
Roar~
An angry roar chased away the silence of the dark forest. The dirt clump stood up and transformed into a huge, black massive being.
“Who is the bastard who dares disturb my sleep?!”
The dirt clump roared in extreme anger. A demon beast who can talk, with the exception of Big Yellow, who is a rare species, must be a Heavenly Core demon lord.

Finally, Jiang Chen and Big Yellow saw what this demon lord looked like. It was actually a huge black serpent with a body longer than 30 meters. By just raising its head, it had stood up high from the ground, looking down angrily at the man and dog below.

Some black lines appeared on Jiang Chen’s forehead, he immediately grabbed Big Yellow’s tail.”
“Ruff woof!
Kid, let go!”
“Fuck, you have slept for three days, and you still want to sleep more?!
Damn it, I, your father am going to the Myriad Demon Mountain to hunt some demon beasts, are you coming or not?
If not, then just stay here and continue your slumber!”
Jiang Chen said.
“Myriad Demon Mountain?
Hunting demon beasts?”
Big Yellow stood up with glowing eyes.
“When are we going?
Your father is about to die from boredom!”
Going out and having some fun is Big Yellow’s hobby.
When he first arrived at the Black Sect, he wanted to find something fun to do, but was rejected.
Now, hearing that Jiang Chen is going to the Myriad Demon Mountain, of course he would be interested in going.
“We’ll go right now, we should be able to arrive at the Myriad Demon Mountain before dark.”
Jiang Chen said.
“The Myriad Demon Mountain isn’t far from here, it’s only about a thousand miles.
With our speed, we can arrive there very quickly.”
Big Yellow said.
The time now was late afternoon, a distance of a thousand miles wasn’t really that big for Jiang Chen and Big Yellow who could fly.
“You know about the Myriad Demon Mountain?”
Jiang Chen felt surprised.
“There’s nothing I don’t know about in this Qi Province.
The Myriad Demon Mountain is the training ground for the disciples of the Black Sect.
Lots of wild demon beasts hide inside, and it’s filled with danger and adventure.”
Big Yellow was enraptured.
“Then let’s not delay any longer, let’s go now.”
After saying that, Jiang Chen spread his blood wings and flew up into the sky.
Big Yellow followed behind and spread his wings of light, dancing and gesticulating for joy.
The Black Sect was located in the northern region of the Qi Province, and the Myriad Demon Mountain was located north of the Black Sect.
The mountain was at the border of the Qi Province, right next to the neighboring province.
The sky was getting darker, and the night fell down.
The demon beasts in the Myriad Demon Mountain started roaring as a welcome for the night, scaring all those who were close by.
Two figures quietly appeared above the Myriad Demon Mountain, they were Jiang Chen and Big Yellow.
“Wang Yun told me that the first sector is mostly filled with Qi Hai and Mortal Core demon beasts.
For me, it’s not challenging enough.
Let’s go to the second sector straight away.”
Jiang Chen flapped his wings, then he flew towards the second sector straight away.
Big Yellow followed behind while happily waggling his tail.
With Jiang Chen’s current strength, no one in the Mortal Core realm could resist a single attack from him, therefore, he didn’t find sector one to be enough of a challenge.
Big Yellow had broken through to the Late Mortal Core realm, and with his mighty strength and strong body as the heir of the Dragon Horse, he could even defeat ordinary Heavenly Core warriors.
The two of them teaming up together, they were one super insane duo.
If anyone thought they were just some ordinary Mortal Core warriors and tried messing with them, the consequences would be miserable.
When the sky turned dark completely, Jiang Chen and Big Yellow Dog had ventured a thousand miles into the Mountain of Thousand Goblins.
The area where they were now, was just tens of miles away from sector two.
“We are going to enter sector two, the demon beasts here should be powerful enough.”
Jiang Chen retracted his blood wings and descended onto the ground.
The place where Jiang Chen landed was a black colored hump.
It looked like some dirt clump that no one would pay any attention to, even Jiang Chen and Big Yellow didn’t notice anything unusual.
Crack~
When Jiang Chen’s feet touched the dirt clump, it made a cracking sound.
It didn’t take long for Jiang Chen to notice that something was wrong, he felt the dirt clump was soft, like some living thing.
At this moment, a huge force exploded from underneath his feet, sending Jiang Chen far away.
“The fuck!”
Jiang Chen was shocked, he immediately leaped away and positioned himself dozens of feet away.
Big Yellow also landed beside him.
Both of them stares at the dirt clump in awe, then they saw that the hump suddenly jumped up from the ground.
Roar~
An angry roar chased away the silence of the dark forest.
The dirt clump stood up and transformed into a huge, black massive being.
“Who is the bastard who dares disturb my sleep?!”
The dirt clump roared in extreme anger.
A demon beast who can talk, with the exception of Big Yellow, who is a rare species, must be a Heavenly Core demon lord.
Finally, Jiang Chen and Big Yellow saw what this demon lord looked like.
It was actually a huge black serpent with a body longer than 30 meters.
By just raising its head, it had stood up high from the ground, looking down angrily at the man and dog below.

chapters.title: Chapter 117 - Five Dragon Marks
paragraphs: “Brat, did you step on some dog shit when leaving the Black Sect? Why are you so unlucky?”

Big Yellow rolled his eyes and felt speechless. Jiang Chen was so unlucky. He had randomly picked a spot to land on, and that spot was a demon lord. However, it could also be considered luck that the person who stepped on this demon lord was Jiang Chen, if it had been any other Mortal Core warrior, he would probably have been devoured by this demon lord and died in a miserable way.
“Didn’t expect to meet a Heavenly Core demon lord in sector one. Luckily, this serpent is only at the Early Heavenly Core realm, we can still handle it.”

Jiang Chen sighed. He was planning to hunt for some peak Late Mortal Core demon beasts at the border between sector one and sector two, then he would absorb their demon souls and at least condense a few more Dragon Marks, increasing his strength. With that, he would have more confidence in his adventure into sector two. However, destiny always acts in a reverse manner, and he had met a Heavenly Core demon lord immediately upon landing.

“Tiny human, how dare you step on me?! You’ve sought your own demise, you’ve committed suicide! You two, tiny human and dog, stand there. Let me devour you as punishment for stepping on me and disturbing my sleep!”
The black serpent spoke with a loud voice; it spat out a pungent breath that made them feel awful.
“Fuck, this big guy really thinks he’s something mighty! Asking us to stand still and let him eat us, is he an idiot?”
Big Yellow laughed out angrily; this giant serpent sure did know how to joke. It was committing suicide by speaking to Big Yellow like that.

“This is a ‘Black Swamp Serpent’. It lays in slumber most of the time, and that’s the reason why it chose to sleep at the border of sector one and two; basically, it won’t be disturbed here. Nevertheless, a Black Swamp Serpent can be very strong, we can’t be careless in handling it.”

Jiang Chen said. Although this Black Swamp Serpent was just at the Early Heavenly Core realm, it wasn’t some trash like Li Wu Ling. Jiang Chen was able to kill Li Wu Ling with ease, but it would be impossible to kill this serpent in the same way.

Demon beasts were well known for their tough skin and powerful muscles, as well as their intense blood and qi, which was their advantage over normal human warriors. Under normal circumstances, when a human warrior fought a demon beast at the same level, it was rare for the human to win. This Black Swamp Serpent in front of them, if Yin Zhong Cheng were to fight it, he would probably lose.
“You two tiny little things, hurry up and walk into my mouth, and save me the effort of doing it myself.”

The Black Swamp Serpent spoke once again. Judging from what it said, Jiang Chen could imagine how lazy it was. It was so lazy that it even asked Jiang Chen and Big Yellow to walk into its mouth. Jiang Chen had finally found someone who could sleep more than Big Yellow.
“Fuck! Let’s kill it!”
Big Yellow couldn’t stand it any longer. He turned into a golden light and stabbed himself towards the Black Swamp Serpent.
“How dare a dog attack me?! You’re courting death! Now, let me eat you.”
The Black Swamp Serpent never took Big Yellow seriously. It opened its mouth wide, waiting for Big Yellow to enter its stomach by himself.
“Want to eat me? You didn’t even check how tough your teeth are!”

Big Yellow was laughing out loud. Powerful waves of energy suddenly burst out from his body. The Black Swamp Serpent’s expression finally changed upon sensing the massive unrivaled energy. It hurriedly closed its big mouth as it shot out a black energy beam towards Big Yellow from its head.
Bang!

Two vigorous beings clashed into each other and produced a sound resembling metal colliding. Fire sparks burst out from the center of the collision, and then, the Black Swamp Serpent cried out in pain. It felt a terrible dizziness, and stars filled its vision. Suddenly, the huge body of this serpent shrunk and transformed into a man wearing a black robe.
The man had a muscular and ripped body, he was nearly 8 feet tall, and he looked like someone in his forties. He had a pair of gloomy eyes that were shining with an insidious look.
The man’s body was swaying. He kept shaking his head that was still filled with dizziness.
“Damn it! How come this dog’s head is so hard, I can’t even knock him down...”
The Black Swamp Serpent cursed. He was startled by Big Yellow, and he had started to look at him seriously.

Jiang Chen who was standing not too far away had been startled by what he had seen as well. After Big Yellow had broken through to the Late Mortal Core realm, he had become amazingly strong, and his combat strength had probably surpassed Jiang Chen’s. Judging from the current situation, Big Yellow would be able to kill this Black Swamp Serpent alone without the help of Jiang Chen.
“You can’t defeat me with that hard dog head alone, I’ll eat both of you no matter what!”

The Black Swamp Serpent raged. He waved his hand and unleashed a black colored airwave towards Big Yellow and Jiang Chen. The attack was not only powerful, it also brought an awful smell, making anyone who smelled it feel like wanting to vomit.
“This fucking stinks! Brat, this Black Swamp Serpent is strong, let’s do this together and kill him quickly!”

Big Yellow cursed. With a foot-thick golden light hovering above his body, he sped towards the serpent with great speed. Jiang Chen waved his hand and took out the Axe of Thunder, then he struck out with the Clap of Thunder. A shiny golden axe chopped towards the Black Swamp Serpent.
Bang!

Big Yellow’s energy attack, as well as Jiang Chen’s Axe of Thunder, both attacks combined and struck onto the Black Swamp Serpent. No matter how strong the Black Swamp Serpent was, it would never be able to defend itself from the attacks of these two vigorous beings.
From the center of the collision, black colored airwaves swept across and destroyed all the trees with a one mile circumference. The intense battle had caused all the nearby demon beasts to flee.
Bang!
The Big Swamp Serpent was knocked away by the impact. It broke three gigantic trees along the way and fell down onto the ground while continuously spitting out blood.
“Damn it, where did these two abnormal beings come from, and why are they so strong?!”
The Black Swamp Serpent cursed out again. The insidious and wild look in its eyes had been replaced with fear.
“Kaka! Let’s go kill him!”
Big Yellow dashed forwards with extreme speed, and like a golden bolt of lightning, he arrived in front of the Black Swamp Serpent in the blink of an eye.
Bang!
The Black Swamp Serpent didn’t have any time to react before it was knocked a few miles away.
Roar~
The Black Swamp Serpent kept roaring. It flew up and transformed back into a serpent, then it swung its thick tail towards Jiang Chen and Big Yellow, causing friction in the air along the way.
“An arrow at the end of its flight.”
With a sneer on his face, Jiang Chen swung his axe once again. On the other side, Big Yellow was stabbing himself towards the Black Swamp Serpent with his head up front.
Bang bang bang...

Big Yellow was incredibly vigorous and fast, he kept shifting his position as he flew towards the Black Swamp Serpent. His powerful head finally collided with the Black Swamp Serpent’s body, stunning it and making it spit out more blood.
Swoosh!
At this point of time, Jiang Chen’s battle axe had fallen down from the sky. It was extremely fast, and it hit right onto the Black Swamp Serpent’s head.
Crack!
The Axe of Thunder was a powerful high-ranked combat weapon. It cut the Black Swamp Serpent’s in two. Then, a glowing demon soul flew out from its skull into Jiang Chen’s hand.
Big Yellow was even more ferocious. He bit down at a part below the Black Swamp Serpent’s neck, then he pulled out a huge snake gall. And then, he swallowed is straight away.
“Kaka, this snake gall is some nourishing stuff, it belongs to your father!”
Big Yellow was very excited.

Jiang Chen patted Big Yellow with a satisfied expression. He was happy with Big Yellow’s performance today. If it wasn’t for him, although Jiang Chen could still kill the Black Swamp Serpent, it would take him some time and effort. Because of Big Yellow, it had all become so easy.

“Kid, treat your father better in the future! Your father is an ultimate fighter, and besides, if you dare to neglect your father, you won’t get a share of the treasures your father will find in the future!”
Big Yellow showed his teeth and threatened Jiang Chen.
“The fuck? You get angry when I say you are plump, but when I praise you, you get arrogant?!”
Jiang Chen kicked Big Yellow’s head. He now finally understood, he couldn’t be nice to this dog, because if he did that, he would simply forget who he is.
“A Heavenly Core demon lord’s demon soul, it will be very useful to me. If I absorb it now, I can at least form another five Dragon Marks.”

A happy expression emerged on Jiang Chen’s face. He had unique advantages when cultivating the Dragon Transformation skill. Just from the ability to absorb demon souls alone, no one could compare with him.
Without any hesitation, Jiang Chen swallowed the demon soul and started circulating the Dragon Transformation skill. Ten minutes later, the demon soul had been completely absorbed.
Buzzing...

The Qi Sea within his Dantian started producing a buzzing sound. As Jiang Chen had expected, the Black Swamp Serpent’s demon soul had allowed him to form another 5 Dragon Marks. The newly born Dragon Marks were vibrating excitedly in his Qi Sea, and they soon merged into his Mortal Core.

“Every time I form a new Dragon Mark, my combat strength increases. Now I have managed to form 45 Dragon Marks, and I just need another 15 Dragon Marks before I’m able to break through to the Late Mortal Core realm.”

Jiang Chen’s eyes were glowing. He was confident that this trip to the Myriad Demon Mountain would let him break through to the Late Mortal Core realm. And when he does break through to the Late Mortal Core realm, he would be able to easily kill an Early Heavenly Core warrior. And even if he was forced to fight a Mid Heavenly Core warrior, he would have the ability to defend himself.
“But, too bad, if the Dragon Transformation skill could evolve some more, then my cultivation speed would be faster...”
Jiang Chen felt pity, then he started staring at Big Yellow with a smile on his face.
“The fuck? Kid, what’s on your mind? Your eyes tell me you’re up to something evil...”
Big Yellow was trembling, Jiang Chen’s eyes had scared him.
“Hehe, Big Yellow, let me ask you, are we brothers?”
Jiang Chen asked with an evil smile.
“Brothers your ass, I am not your brother!”
Big Yellow immediately denied and drew a line between himself and Jiang Chen.
“Big Yellow, let me ask you, can you give me another bowl of your blood?”
Jiang Chen asked while maintaining his friendly smile.
What? He wants blood again? A bowl?
“Fuck you!”
Big Yellow turned around and started walking towards sector two.
“So stingy, it’s just a bowl of blood...”
Jiang Chen murmured to himself. With an unsatisfied face, he followed behind Big Yellow and started walking towards the second sector.

chapters.title: Chapter 118 - Nine Phantom Wolves
paragraphs: Bang!
Aowuuuu!

Followed by a mournful scream, a huge body was slammed onto the ground, creating a huge crater. Then, a 30-foot-tall rhino struggled for a bit before dying. A deep hole could be seen on the rhino’s head, and next to the rhino, a white clothed young man stood while holding a blinking demon soul.
The demon soul kept shrinking in the hand of this young man, and soon, it disappeared completely. It had been absorbed by the young man.

“A Late Mortal Core demon beast is just too weak, it can’t provide me much benefits. I’ve absorbed three demon souls of Late Mortal Core demon beasts, and I’ve only managed to form one more Dragon Mark... Looks like I’ll need to start looking for those Heavenly Core demon lords.”

Jiang Chen said. He was currently in sector two together with Big Yellow, but they hadn’t ventured far enough, so they hadn’t met any Heavenly Core demon lords. So far, they had only killed a few Late Mortal Core demon beasts.
“You’re an abnormal monster! What kind of skill are you actually cultivating with? Why does it allow you to absorb demon souls without any limit? You’re really an abnormal monster!”

Big Yellow couldn’t help but ask, he had always been curious about what skill Jiang Chen was cultivating with. From Red City until now, Jiang Chen had absorbed many demon souls, and if he did so without the support of a truly advanced skill, as a human warrior, there would be no way for him to do it.
“Are you sure you want to know?”
“Yes!”
“Give me a bowl of your blood, then I’ll tell you.”
“I’ll give you a bowl of my urine.”
“Fuck off.”
Bang...

Fluctuations of an intense fight had shaken the mountain, and many demon beasts had long ago fled. In front of Jiang Chen and Big Yellow, an Early Heavenly Core demon lord had died and had its demon soul dug out by Jiang Chen.

With the help of the Dragon Transformation skill, Jiang Chen absorbed the demon soul. However, this time, the demon soul was only able to help Jiang Chen form another four Dragon Marks. Including the one gained previously, Jiang Chen now had a total of 50 Dragon Marks in his Qi Sea.

“It gets tougher and tougher to cultivate the Dragon Transformation skill, the energy required to break through becomes bigger and bigger. I’m afraid the remaining 10 Dragon Marks will be very difficult to condense.”

Jiang Chen sighed. The Dragon Transformation skill was truly an ancient mystical skill, a mighty cultivation skill. Aside from being incredibly powerful, the difficulty to cultivate the skill was far beyond any other skill. It was hard to imagine how much energy would be required for Jiang Chen to completely condense 100,000 Dragon Marks. If he could calculate it with some figures, it would be amounting astronomical figures.

“There are a lot of demon beasts in the Myriad Demon Mountain, and as long you have the ability, there won’t be any problems for you to continue training here. But, by absorbing demon souls repeatedly, trying to force yourself to break through in such hurried ways, won’t it affect your foundation?”

Big Yellow asked worriedly. The extreme way Jiang Chen was cultivating almost resembled the ways of those who cultivated some demonic skills. Although he could obtain a huge amount of energy and increase his cultivation level quickly, it could seriously affect his foundation. Once his foundation becomes unstable, he would have a hard time in his future cultivation.

“I know what I am doing. With my foundation right now, it is way more than enough for me to absorb immense amounts of energy to reach the Heavenly Core realm, and it won’t affect my potential in the future. But, when I break through to the Late Mortal Core realm, I’ll stop all this and concoct a kind of pill that can strengthen my foundation.”

Jiang Chen said. When talking about cultivation experience, he was a master amongst masters. Of course, he wouldn’t allow himself to risk his foundation becoming unstable. Although it was his first time cultivating the Dragon Transformation skill, he had a clear plan, and he knew every detail regarding his next steps.

“Anyhow, in this sector two, I’ve sensed something dangerous. There’s something sinister here, I’m sure there are some powerful demon lords here. The two of us can’t sense their existence, therefore, we need to be more careful in here; don’t venture too deep.”
Big Yellow showed a rarely seen serious expression.

Jiang Chen nodded his head. The Myriad Demon Mountain couldn’t be compared with Origin Mountain. Although both he and Big Yellow were very strong, they were still only at the Mortal Core realm. They might have killed some Early Heavenly Core demon lords with ease, but if they encountered a Mid Heavenly Core demon lord, then their only option would be to run for their lives.

There was a saying that each stage was like a brand new world, therefore, even if it was just a difference of one stage, the difference was huge, and this went especially for those at the Heavenly Core realm. Jiang Chen would need to breakthrough to the Late Mortal Core realm, and only then would he have the strength to defeat a Mid Heavenly Core warrior or demon lord.
“Oh right, Big Yellow, have you sensed any treasures nearby?”
Jiang Chen asked with anticipation.
“So far, nothing. But, an ancient mountain like this, there has to be some good stuff. Although danger always comes together with precious treasures, so you better not expect too much.”
Big Yellow said.

Half an hour later, Jiang Chen and Big Yellow had ventured a hundred miles deeper into sector two. Right in front of them was a wolf with a body glowing in golden light. Its wild and ferocious eyes stared at Jiang Chen and Big Yellow.
“The Bloody Combat Wolf, the king of all wolves... Be careful, this wolf is much stronger than the Black Swamp Serpent.”

Jiang Chen said in a dignified tone. At the same time, he felt some excitement. Jiang Chen knew about this Bloody Combat Wolf, it was the king amongst all wolves, and it possessed the authentic bloodline of the Wolf King.
“No matter how strong it is, it’s still just an Early Heavenly Core demon lord, we can kill it together without any problems.”

Big Yellow spat out his tongue and licked his lips. An intense fighting spirit burst out from his body. Indeed, the Bloody Combat Wolf was tougher to deal with than the Black Swamp Serpent, but Big Yellow was the heir of a Divine Beast, he wouldn’t have any problems with fighting someone at a higher level than himself. Besides, Jiang Chen had become stronger compared to when they fought the Black Swamp Serpent. With 50 Dragon Marks, they were confident that they could kill this Bloody Combat Wolf.
“Let’s go!”

After saying that, Jiang Chen immediately attacked with his Six Solar Fingers. Three huge golden fingers lit up the dark skies as it pierced towards the Bloody Combat Wolf in front of them. At the same time, Big Yellow spat out a huge golden energy orb. Jiang Chen didn’t know the name of this attack, but the energy ball that Big Yellow spat out was capable of dealing lots of damage.
Roar~
The Bloody Combat Wolf roared out an angry cry. It retaliated with a bright golden light beam coming from its body. The beam was crashing towards the solar finger and the energy orb.

It was as if three volcanoes had erupted at the same time. The massive amounts of energy collided and caused a massive earthquake in the area. Fire appeared everywhere due to the intense friction between the energy and air, turning the entire place into a sea of flames that filled the entire surrounding area with terrifying energy ripples.
Plop plop plop!
The Bloody Combat Wolf couldn’t defend himself from the attack of his two enemies, and its strong body was forced back few steps before it could regain control.
“Both of you are just at the Mortal Core realm, and you have forced me, the Wolf King to step back... This is ridiculous! But now you have really pissed me off, I’ll let you die in miserable ways!”
The Bloody Combat Wolf spoke and threatened them. When the pride of a Wolf King gets threatened, the consequences would be really serious.
Swoosh...
In the blink of an eye, eight more Bloody Combat Wolves appeared. Nine identical Bloody Combat Wolves stood in a circle, surrounding Jiang Chen and Big Yellow.
“Damn it, what kind of combat skill is this?”
Big Yellow’s expression changed. Turning from one into nine, with his eyesight, he couldn’t tell which the real Bloody Combat Wolf was and which was just a mimic figure.

“This is an innate ability of the Bloody Combat Wolf; it is called the Nine Phantom Wolves. This ability doesn’t cause any damage, but it’s still terrifying. It produces eight identical phantoms that can cause confusion to the enemy.”

Jiang Chen explained with a golden aura shining in his eyes. This innate ability was really terrifying, it could catch anyone off guard. All the phantoms would move together with their origin, and make the same attack movement. Once the enemy became unable to tell which one was real, the consequences would be nasty.
Swoosh!
Big Yellow transformed into a golden light and smashed into a Bloody Combat Wolf with his head, but the Bloody Combat Wolf turned into bubbles and burst apart. It was actually just a phantom.
“Fuck!!”
Big Yellow cursed. The feeling of missing an attack almost made him go crazy.
“Big Yellow, unleash your wings of light, you’ll defend against his attacks. Let me find out which one is the real Bloody Combat Wolf.”
Jiang Chen said.
“Fine.”

Big Yellow spread his wings of light, getting himself ready for battle. Then, Jiang Chen sent out his Divine Sense and scanned all the Bloody Combat Wolves. However, he couldn’t tell which ones were phantoms, and which one was the real one.
“Haha, trying to figure out which one is the real me? Stop wasting your time!”

The Bloody Combat Wolf laughed out loud. All the phantoms were laughing at the same time. The phantom that had been destroyed by Big Yellow appeared once again, and then, all nine Bloody Combat Wolves attacked at the same time; they all dashed towards Big Yellow and Jiang Chen.
“Hmph!”
Big Yellow let out a cold snort. His wings of lights flapped, and he turned into a golden light. He flew around Jiang Chen, not giving the Bloody Combat Wolf any chance to hurt Jiang Chen.

Jiang Chen sneered, the Nine Phantom Wolves was a terrifying innate ability. If it was any other ordinary man, he would already be dead by now. Even if a Mid Heavenly Core warrior was here, he would have been tortured by the Bloody Combat Wolf and gotten himself killed.

Unfortunately, the Bloody Combat Wolf had met Jiang Chen. This encounter removed its destiny to do as it wished. Perhaps no one could figure out which the real Combat Wolf was, but not Jiang Chen. He started circulating the Great Soul Derivation skill, and threads of soul energy began flowing out from his body.

The Great Soul Derivation skill was a mighty skill, the ultimate soul cultivation skill. It allowed Jiang Chen to see through any sources, and with the help of the Great Soul Derivation skill, Jiang Chen immediately spotted the real Bloody Combat Wolf.
Bang!
“FUCK YOU!!!”

Big Yellow cursed in a frenzy of rage. Although he was incredibly fast, he was still disturbed by all the phantoms. While the attacks of the phantoms couldn’t deal any damage to Big Yellow, they still gave the real Bloody Combat Wolf the opportunity to attack Big Yellow. The strong and powerful body of Big Yellow was knocked far away. If he were to be replaced by someone else, that person would have been dead by now.

After knocking Big Yellow away, the Bloody Combat Wolf turned around and prepared to attack Jiang Chen. Suddenly, Jiang Chen turned around, and with a pair of glowing eyes, he locked his gaze upon one of the Bloody Combat Wolves.

The Bloody Combat Wolf trembled. It had a bad feeling about this. Jiang Chen took out a golden battle axe; then he ignored every single attack from the other Combat Wolves as he chopped his axe towards the Bloody Combat Wolf that his vision was locked onto.
“Big Yellow, this is the real Bloody Combat Wolf, attack it!”
Jiang Chen shouted out loud.

chapters.title: Chapter 119 - Hunting Down
paragraphs: The Great Soul Derivation skill was simply astonishing. The exquisite sensation of soul energy had pierced right through the source of the Bloody Combat Wolf, and identified its true self. Even Big Yellow had to praise Jiang Chen in his mind.
Roar!

Big Yellow let out a ferocious roar, then he adjusted his direction in midair. With his head shining brightly, he flew towards the Bloody Combat Wolf like a high-speed arrow. With this attack, he could instantly shatter a mountain.
Bang!

On the other side, Jiang Chen raised his battle axe up high. In the blink of an eye, he had gotten closer to the Bloody Combat Wolf’s head. Big Yellow and Jiang Chen had locked down the real Bloody Combat Wolf, and ignored all attacks from the phantoms.

The Bloody Combat Wolf’s expression changed dramatically, it had never expected something like this to happen. Jiang Chen found out his true self with just one look, and this had really startled him. The Bloody Combat Wolf was shocked by this, and its mind had gone completely blank for a split second.

In the middle of a battle, zoning out for even a fraction of time would be devastating. The Bloody Combat Wolf had the strength to continue fighting, but because it was too startled by the fact that his Nine Phantom Wolves had been seen through by someone, he had become zoned out for a split second, and this brought an end to his life.
Bang! Clang!

Big Yellow’s head and Jiang Chen’s Axe of Thunder, both landed on the Bloody Combat Wolf’s body. Then, it screamed out in extreme pain as it was chopped into two pieces by the battle axe. Its blood was splashing all over the place. At the same time, Big Yellow’s head had caused havoc inside of its body which had shattered all of its internal organs.

The Bloody Combat Wolf hadn’t died yet, but it was badly wounded, and not far away from being completely dead. Jiang Chen then sent him to hell with another swing of his battle axe. When the Bloody Combat Wolf died, all the 8 phantoms disappeared at the same time.
“Haha, you’re really amazing, you can really find out which the real Bloody Combat Wolf is! I, your father, really admires you now!”
Big Yellow was laughing out excitedly.
“A big reason for why we were able to kill this Bloody Combat Wolf so easily is that lady luck was smiling at us.”

Jiang Chen smiled. The Bloody Combat Wolf was the king amongst all other wolves, it would never be this easy to kill. Even if Jiang Chen was able to see through his Nine Phantom Wolves, without an intense fight, it would still have been impossible for them to kill it.

Jiang Chen’s luck depended on the mentality of the Bloody Combat Wolf, if it hadn’t been zoned out during the battle, losing its opportunity to dodge, it would still be alive now. Even if it couldn’t defeat Jiang Chen and Big Yellow by the end of it all, it would still have the chance to run away.

In fact, the Bloody Combat Wolf zoning out wasn’t all because of its bad mentality, it was also because it was just too confident in its own Nine Phantom Wolves. No one had ever figured out which his true self was amongst all nine phantoms, but this young Mortal Core warrior could tell which one was the real one with just a single glance, cracking its Nine Phantom Wolves. This was why it had become so startled and had lost its life before recovering from the shock.
“I don’t care about lady luck, what I want to know is, after absorbing the Bloody Combat Wolf’s demon soul, can you inherit its Nine Phantom Wolves innate ability?”

Big Yellow looked at Jiang Chen with anticipation, he could still remember that last time, when Jiang Chen absorbed the Blood Winged Hawk’s demon soul, not only did he inherit a pair of blood wings, he also learned its innate ability, the Sonic Hawk Cry. Now, if Jiang Chen could inherit the Nine Phantom Wolves ability from the Bloody Combat Wolf, he would become even more powerful. The Nine Phantom Wolves was much better than the Sonic Hawk Cry.
“Of course I can. If you were to give me your demon soul, I could completely inherit your entire bloodline. You can try if you don’t believe me.
Jiang Chen looked at Big Yellow.
“Get the fuck out of here!”
Big Yellow opened his mouth widely and bit onto Jiang Chen’s butt.
“Ouch! The fuck, damned dog, your father was just joking! Let go of me!”
Jiang Chen slapped Big Yellow away, then he rubbed his aching butt. This damned dog was too wild, and he hadn’t even shown any signs of wanting to bite him.

Jiang Chen extended his arm and grabbed the demon soul out from the Bloody Combat Wolf’s skull. When he felt the massive amount of pure energy contained within the demon soul, Jiang Chen couldn’t hold his excitement any longer, and his eyes lit up. The demon soul of those demon beasts with special bloodlines were far stronger than those of ordinary bloodlines. The Bloody Combat Wolf’s demon soul not only contained a massive amount of energy, it also had the powerful energy of bloodlines and innate abilities. For Jiang Chen, who was cultivating the Dragon Transformation skill, this was a precious treasure. If he could absorb this demon soul that was rich in both energy and bloodline, Jiang Chen was confident he would be able to break through to the Late Mortal Core realm straight away.
Just as Jiang Chen was about to start absorbing the demon soul, a bright sword beam suddenly broke the dark night as it came towards Jiang Chen’s head like a lightning bolt.
Sneak attack!

This was a sword beam unleashed from a human’s combat weapon. Judging from its power, the man who attacked was at least a Mid Heavenly Core warrior, and as a Heavenly Core warrior, this man had actually tried to sneak attack Jiang Chen.
Jiang Chen’s expression darkened. With a bad feeling and super fast reaction, he hurriedly stored the demon soul and jumped backwards, evading the attack with lightning like speed.
Slash!
Even with such great speed, Jiang Chen’s shoulder still got cut by the sword beam. It left a deep wound, and blood kept flowing out from it.
“Who’s there?!”

Jiang Chen shouted out loudly. The sneak attack would have killed an Early Heavenly Core warrior instantly, but Jiang Chen had luckily been able to react quickly. If he hadn’t, he would have been dead by now.
Whoosh~

After the sound of the wind breaking, a ghostly black figure appeared in front of Jiang Chen. The man was wearing black clothes, and his face was covered with a black veil. Only his cruel eyes were showing.
The man in black looked at Jiang Chen who had been wounded with amazement. With a thick voice, he said, “Amazing, you actually evaded my attack.”
It was obvious that the man made his voice thick on purpose, the man simply didn’t want Jiang Chen to recognize his real identity.
“You’re from Black Sect, why are you trying to kill me?”

Jiang Chen furrowed his brows. This was the Myriad Demon Mountain, the training ground for the Black Sect disciples. The disciples of the other three big sects would never come here. Besides, the man in black was obviously well prepared, it had only been a few hours since Jiang Chen left the Black Sect and came to this mountain. Only those from the Black Sect could have information regarding his location.

And, because of this, Jiang Chen was puzzled. He arrived in the Qi Province not long ago, the matters between him and Yin Zhong Cheng had been settled. What was left was the matters between himself, the Heavenly Sword Sect and the Burning Sky Pavilion. He really couldn’t think of anyone in the Black Sect who would want to kill him. Besides, he was a disciple of the Black Sect, and he had even represented the Black Sect to take first place in the Qi Province competition, he had brought them glory.

What was more important was that Jiang Chen had never contacted any Heavenly Core warriors in the Black Sect, let alone offend any of them. But now, there was a man from the Black Sect trying to kill him. This was ridiculous.

“You won’t have to opportunity to know why. My purpose for killing you today is to teach you a lesson. In your next life, stay low, and try not to be so arrogant; there is always someone whom you cannot afford to offend.”
The man in black said slowly.

After saying those words, the man raised the sword in his hand and swung it towards Jiang Chen once again. The bright sword beam had locked down Jiang Chen completely, making it impossible for Jiang Chen to run away. A Mid Heavenly Core warrior using a mid-ranked combat weapon to kill a Mortal Core warrior, this told Jiang Chen how determined this man was in his goal to kill Jiang Chen.
“Fuck!”

Jiang Chen cursed. He didn’t have the time to guess whoever was the one that wanted to kill him. Right at this moment, the most important thing for him to do was run for his life. He held the Axe of Thunder in his hand, and he destroyed the sword beam’s lock down, then he swung the axe once again at the man in black. At the same time, Big Yellow spat out a golden energy orb towards the enemy.
Bang!

The devastating energy began destroying everything across the area. The Mid Heavenly Core warrior in front of them was obviously one of the Black Sect’s inner circle disciple, a genius from the younger generation. His combat strength couldn’t be compared with that of those ordinary Mid Heavenly Core warriors.

Even if Jiang Chen and Big Yellow worked together, there would be no way for them to defeat this man in black. This impact had made Jiang Chen and Big Yellow’s blood and qi start boiling, this feeling made them feel unwell.
“Run!”
Jiang Chen shouted again, by utilizing the force of impact, he spread his bloody wing, turned into two bright lights together with Big Yellow Dog, flying toward the deeper area of sector two.
“This guy is really strong, and the dog isn’t bad either. However, in front of me, you guys won’t even have the chance to escape!”
The man in black sneered, then he turned into black smoke and chased after them.

“Jiang Chen was using a high-ranked combat weapon, how can a tiny little Mortal Core warrior use such a good weapon? It’s so wasteful! If I could have that high-ranked combat weapon, my combat strength would increase to another level!”
A greedy look appeared in the eyes of this man. The attraction of a high-ranked combat weapon, to any Heavenly Core warrior, was very huge.
Bang~
Another loud explosion. The bright sword beam was chasing up to them from their backs once again, forcing Jiang Chen and Big Yellow to retaliate.
“Damn it, we can’t go on like this! A Mid Heavenly Core warrior, we have no chance at defeating him at all!”
Big Yellow said helplessly.
“Let’s head towards the center of sector two, he won’t dare to follow us there!”

A cruel expression emerged on Jiang Chen’s face. With his blood wings and Dimensional Shift skill, even if he was wounded, his speed would still increase by a lot. As for Big Yellow, after he had broken through to the Late Mortal Core realm, his speed had become faster than lightning.
However, the man in black wasn’t slow either, and he kept chasing.
“What?! Enter the center of sector two?! Are you nuts?! That’s like suicide to me!”
Big Yellow glared at Jiang Chen.

“Then do you have any better solutions? This is our only chance, as long as I can absorb the Bloody Combat Wolf’s demon soul and break through to the Late Mortal Core realm, we won’t have to run anymore!”

Jiang Chen said. The man in black had come at the right time, if he was here half an hour late, when Jiang Chen had already absorbed the Bloody Combat Wolf’s soul completely, this man in black wouldn’t have been a threat to Jiang Chen. But, too bad, time wasn’t on Jiang Chen’s side.
“Jiang Chen, surrender now, if you go any further, you’ll be entering the center of sector two, it’s certain death for you in that area!”

The man in black threatened them. But, when he saw Jiang Chen still continuing going forwards, doubts started appearing on his face. Just like Jiang Chen had thought, the second sector center of the Myriad Demon Mountain was extremely dangerous, even the man in black wouldn’t dare enter.
“Catch me if you can, bitch!”
While running with great speed, Jiang Chen never forgot to say some taunting words. Trying to kill Jiang Chen was not a simple task.
