The Bloody Combat Wolf hadn’t died yet, but it was badly wounded, and not far away from being completely dead.
Jiang Chen then sent him to hell with another swing of his battle axe.
When the Bloody Combat Wolf died, all the 8 phantoms disappeared at the same time.
“Haha, you’re really amazing, you can really find out which the real Bloody Combat Wolf is!
I, your father, really admires you now!”
Big Yellow was laughing out excitedly.
“A big reason for why we were able to kill this Bloody Combat Wolf so easily is that lady luck was smiling at us.”
Jiang Chen smiled.
The Bloody Combat Wolf was the king amongst all other wolves, it would never be this easy to kill.
Even if Jiang Chen was able to see through his Nine Phantom Wolves, without an intense fight, it would still have been impossible for them to kill it.
Jiang Chen’s luck depended on the mentality of the Bloody Combat Wolf, if it hadn’t been zoned out during the battle, losing its opportunity to dodge, it would still be alive now.
Even if it couldn’t defeat Jiang Chen and Big Yellow by the end of it all, it would still have the chance to run away.
In fact, the Bloody Combat Wolf zoning out wasn’t all because of its bad mentality, it was also because it was just too confident in its own Nine Phantom Wolves.

No one had ever figured out which his true self was amongst all nine phantoms, but this young Mortal Core warrior could tell which one was the real one with just a single glance, cracking its Nine Phantom Wolves.
This was why it had become so startled and had lost its life before recovering from the shock.
“I don’t care about lady luck, what I want to know is, after absorbing the Bloody Combat Wolf’s demon soul, can you inherit its Nine Phantom Wolves innate ability?”

Big Yellow looked at Jiang Chen with anticipation, he could still remember that last time, when Jiang Chen absorbed the Blood Winged Hawk’s demon soul, not only did he inherit a pair of blood wings, he also learned its innate ability, the Sonic Hawk Cry.
Now, if Jiang Chen could inherit the Nine Phantom Wolves ability from the Bloody Combat Wolf, he would become even more powerful.
The Nine Phantom Wolves was much better than the Sonic Hawk Cry.
“Of course I can.
If you were to give me your demon soul, I could completely inherit your entire bloodline.
You can try if you don’t believe me.
Jiang Chen looked at Big Yellow.
“Get the fuck out of here!”
Big Yellow opened his mouth widely and bit onto Jiang Chen’s butt.
“Ouch!
The fuck, damned dog, your father was just joking!
Let go of me!”
Jiang Chen slapped Big Yellow away, then he rubbed his aching butt.
This damned dog was too wild, and he hadn’t even shown any signs of wanting to bite him.
Jiang Chen extended his arm and grabbed the demon soul out from the Bloody Combat Wolf’s skull.
When he felt the massive amount of pure energy contained within the demon soul, Jiang Chen couldn’t hold his excitement any longer, and his eyes lit up.
The demon soul of those demon beasts with special bloodlines were far stronger than those of ordinary bloodlines.
The Bloody Combat Wolf’s demon soul not only contained a massive amount of energy, it also had the powerful energy of bloodlines and innate abilities.
For Jiang Chen, who was cultivating the Dragon Transformation skill, this was a precious treasure.
If he could absorb this demon soul that was rich in both energy and bloodline, Jiang Chen was confident he would be able to break through to the Late Mortal Core realm straight away.
Just as Jiang Chen was about to start absorbing the demon soul, a bright sword beam suddenly broke the dark night as it came towards Jiang Chen’s head like a lightning bolt.
Sneak attack!
This was a sword beam unleashed from a human’s combat weapon.
Judging from its power, the man who attacked was at least a Mid Heavenly Core warrior, and as a Heavenly Core warrior, this man had actually tried to sneak attack Jiang Chen.
Jiang Chen’s expression darkened.
With a bad feeling and super fast reaction, he hurriedly stored the demon soul and jumped backwards, evading the attack with lightning like speed.
Slash!
Even with such great speed, Jiang Chen’s shoulder still got cut by the sword beam.
It left a deep wound, and blood kept flowing out from it.
“Who’s there?!”
Jiang Chen shouted out loudly.
The sneak attack would have killed an Early Heavenly Core warrior instantly, but Jiang Chen had luckily been able to react quickly.
If he hadn’t, he would have been dead by now.
Whoosh~
After the sound of the wind breaking, a ghostly black figure appeared in front of Jiang Chen.
The man was wearing black clothes, and his face was covered with a black veil.
Only his cruel eyes were showing.
The man in black looked at Jiang Chen who had been wounded with amazement.
With a thick voice, he said, “Amazing, you actually evaded my attack.”
It was obvious that the man made his voice thick on purpose, the man simply didn’t want Jiang Chen to recognize his real identity.
“You’re from Black Sect, why are you trying to kill me?”
Jiang Chen furrowed his brows.
This was the Myriad Demon Mountain, the training ground for the Black Sect disciples.
The disciples of the other three big sects would never come here.
Besides, the man in black was obviously well prepared, it had only been a few hours since Jiang Chen left the Black Sect and came to this mountain.
Only those from the Black Sect could have information regarding his location.
And, because of this, Jiang Chen was puzzled.
He arrived in the Qi Province not long ago, the matters between him and Yin Zhong Cheng had been settled.
What was left was the matters between himself, the Heavenly Sword Sect and the Burning Sky Pavilion.
He really couldn’t think of anyone in the Black Sect who would want to kill him.
Besides, he was a disciple of the Black Sect, and he had even represented the Black Sect to take first place in the Qi Province competition, he had brought them glory.
What was more important was that Jiang Chen had never contacted any Heavenly Core warriors in the Black Sect, let alone offend any of them.
But now, there was a man from the Black Sect trying to kill him.
This was ridiculous.
“You won’t have to opportunity to know why.
My purpose for killing you today is to teach you a lesson.
In your next life, stay low, and try not to be so arrogant; there is always someone whom you cannot afford to offend.”
The man in black said slowly.
After saying those words, the man raised the sword in his hand and swung it towards Jiang Chen once again.
The bright sword beam had locked down Jiang Chen completely, making it impossible for Jiang Chen to run away.
A Mid Heavenly Core warrior using a mid-ranked combat weapon to kill a Mortal Core warrior, this told Jiang Chen how determined this man was in his goal to kill Jiang Chen.
“Fuck!”
Jiang Chen cursed.
He didn’t have the time to guess whoever was the one that wanted to kill him.
Right at this moment, the most important thing for him to do was run for his life.
He held the Axe of Thunder in his hand, and he destroyed the sword beam’s lock down, then he swung the axe once again at the man in black.
At the same time, Big Yellow spat out a golden energy orb towards the enemy.
Bang!
The devastating energy began destroying everything across the area.
The Mid Heavenly Core warrior in front of them was obviously one of the Black Sect’s inner circle disciple, a genius from the younger generation.
His combat strength couldn’t be compared with that of those ordinary Mid Heavenly Core warriors.
Even if Jiang Chen and Big Yellow worked together, there would be no way for them to defeat this man in black.
This impact had made Jiang Chen and Big Yellow’s blood and qi start boiling, this feeling made them feel unwell.
“Run!”
Jiang Chen shouted again, by utilizing the force of impact, he spread his bloody wing, turned into two bright lights together with Big Yellow Dog, flying toward the deeper area of sector two.
“This guy is really strong, and the dog isn’t bad either.
However, in front of me, you guys won’t even have the chance to escape!”
The man in black sneered, then he turned into black smoke and chased after them.
“Jiang Chen was using a high-ranked combat weapon, how can a tiny little Mortal Core warrior use such a good weapon?
It’s so wasteful!
If I could have that high-ranked combat weapon, my combat strength would increase to another level!”
A greedy look appeared in the eyes of this man.
The attraction of a high-ranked combat weapon, to any Heavenly Core warrior, was very huge.
Bang~
Another loud explosion.
The bright sword beam was chasing up to them from their backs once again, forcing Jiang Chen and Big Yellow to retaliate.
“Damn it, we can’t go on like this!
A Mid Heavenly Core warrior, we have no chance at defeating him at all!”
Big Yellow said helplessly.
“Let’s head towards the center of sector two, he won’t dare to follow us there!”
A cruel expression emerged on Jiang Chen’s face.
With his blood wings and Dimensional Shift skill, even if he was wounded, his speed would still increase by a lot.
As for Big Yellow, after he had broken through to the Late Mortal Core realm, his speed had become faster than lightning.
However, the man in black wasn’t slow either, and he kept chasing.
“What?!
Enter the center of sector two?!
Are you nuts?!
That’s like suicide to me!”
Big Yellow glared at Jiang Chen.
“Then do you have any better solutions?
This is our only chance, as long as I can absorb the Bloody Combat Wolf’s demon soul and break through to the Late Mortal Core realm, we won’t have to run anymore!”
Jiang Chen said.

The man in black had come at the right time, if he was here half an hour late, when Jiang Chen had already absorbed the Bloody Combat Wolf’s soul completely, this man in black wouldn’t have been a threat to Jiang Chen.
But, too bad, time wasn’t on Jiang Chen’s side.
“Jiang Chen, surrender now, if you go any further, you’ll be entering the center of sector two, it’s certain death for you in that area!”
The man in black threatened them.
But, when he saw Jiang Chen still continuing going forwards, doubts started appearing on his face.
Just like Jiang Chen had thought, the second sector center of the Myriad Demon Mountain was extremely dangerous, even the man in black wouldn’t dare enter.
“Catch me if you can, bitch!”
While running with great speed, Jiang Chen never forgot to say some taunting words.
Trying to kill Jiang Chen was not a simple task.

chapters.title: Chapter 120 - The Silent Poisonous Needle
paragraphs: “Damn it, you’re a really crazy fellow! But your father likes exciting adventures, kaka.”

Big Yellow was flying crazily while laughing out loud. After he began following Jiang Chen, he had never run out of excitement and adventures. Just like their current situation, they were only at the Mortal Core realm, and they were running amok in the second sector. Perhaps only Jiang Chen would have this kind of courage.
Bang!
The man in black was chasing closely behind, and he kept attacking them from behind. However, Jiang Chen and Big Yellow were too fast, so all of his attacks had missed their target.

“Damn it, how can this man and dog run so fast? I can’t let this continue, even I will be in great danger if I venture too deeply into sector two. Senior disciple Fan has given me a clear order that I must kill Jiang Chen this time... Looks like I’ll need to use the Silent Poisonous Needle given to me by senior disciple Fan.”

The man in black murmured. Jiang Chen and Big Yellow were simply too fast, and he had never seen any man or demon beast at the Mortal Core realm who could move with such great speed, even he couldn’t catch up to them.
Initially, he had thought that the mission of killing Jiang Chen would be a simple task, but he had never expected it to become so complicated.

However, the man in black didn’t panic. He kept his distance with Jiang Chen and Big Yellow, then he slowly took out a needle. The narrow needle was glowing in a black light, and with just a single glance, anyone could tell that this was a poisonous needle. The needle had the length of a human palm, and it was obviously extremely poisonous. The man in black carefully covered the needle with his Yuan energy, he didn’t dare touch it with his hand.

“This Silent Poisonous Needle has the poison of the Hell Flower, Black Orchid, and dozen of other poisons. There’s no remedy for it, and once anyone below the Divine Core realm is impaled by it, he would become dead meat. Its poison can even corrode Yuan energy. Jiang Chen, getting killed by this poisonous needle is an honorable death for you. If you want to blame someone, just blame yourself for offending someone you shouldn’t have offended.”
An insidious look appeared in the eyes of the man. The poisonous needle in his hand slowly started floating, then he pushed it with massive force and sent it towards Jiang Chen’s direction, silently.

This poisonous needle was made from a very special material, and it wouldn’t make any sound when moving. Therefore, once it was used to attack someone, it could approach the enemy without them knowing.

However, Jiang Chen could actually sense something. However, he was too busy escaping together with Big Yellow using all their strength to mind it. Besides, all this time, the man in black had been attacking using his combat weapon, Jiang Chen didn’t expect him to suddenly attack with a poisonous needle.

When the poisonous needle got closer, only then did Jiang Chen sense that something was wrong. He hurriedly twisted his body, but it was too late. The poisonous needle pierce into Jiang Chen’s shoulder, and the poison immediately spread across his body, making Jiang Chen start wobbling.
“Big Yellow, I was poisoned, carry me.”
Jiang Chen said hastily.
“The fuck, don’t you know how to defend yourself from poison? How could you be poisoned?”
Big Yellow said in a helpless manner. But because of the critical moment, he still immediately carried Jiang Chen on his back.
“The poison used on the needle from that man in black is far more lethal than the Green Hellish Python’s poison. However, it’s far from enough to kill me.”

Jiang Chen sneered, then he started circulating energy to his shoulder to eject the poisonous needle. He didn't really care about the poison in his body. He circulated the Dragon Transformation skill, then the Green Hellish Python’s poison burst out and covered all poison in his body.

Because he had absorbed the Green Hellish Python’s bloodline, Jiang Chen’s body could turn into a poisonous body whenever he wanted to. Although the needle’s poison was very powerful, it was illogical to destroy a poisonous body with another poison. With help from the Dragon Transformation skill and the Green Hellish Python’s poison, the poison from the needle would turn into a nourishing ingredient and be absorbed by Jiang Chen, helping him increase the strength of poison in his body.
Plop!
But Jiang Chen still pretended to fall down onto Big Yellow’s back. He tried using this method to ditch the man in black chasing behind.
Indeed, when the man in black saw Jiang Chen falling down onto Big Yellow’s back, he immediately stopped the chase.

“Haha, the Silent Poisonous Needle from senior disciple Fan is really powerful, Jiang Chen was only at the Mortal Core realm, so of course, he would be killed by it! I have accomplished my mission perfectly, I’m sure senior disciple Fan will reward me handsomely once I return!”

The man in black was laughing out loudly. He had witnessed the poison needle impaling Jiang Chen’s body, and he had seen with his own eyes how Jiang Chen fell motionlessly onto Big Yellow’s back. Underneath such circumstances, Jiang Chen would die for sure.
As for Big Yellow, he didn’t really care about him, since his only target was Jiang Chen.

“Carry on, once you reach the deeper area of sector two, the dangers will be greater! Even that big yellow dog will probably die in there, and if that really happens, then their bodies will get buried in there. Jiang Chen will disappear without anyone knowing what happened.”
Feeling proud of himself, the man in black turned around and left the Myriad Demon Mountain, soon disappearing from their sights.
Roar~

Big Yellow carried Jiang Chen on his back and continued running. Suddenly, a ground shaking roar came from in front. Big Yellow’s expression turned awful, “It’s a Mid Heavenly Core demon lord! Damn it, we’re so unlucky...”

Big Yellow turned in another direction and continued running. They were at a place very close to the center area of sector two, and it was perfectly normal to bump into some Late Heavenly Core demon lords there. Let alone those Mid Heavenly Core demon lords, if Jiang Chen and Big Yellow really bumped into a Late Heavenly Core demon lord, then today would be their doomsday.
But luckily, Big Yellow’s speed was really fast. If it wasn’t, then there would be no way for them to escape from the second sector.

A short moment after Big Yellow left the place, a strong golden lion appeared at the place where Big Yellow was previously at. It kept examining its surroundings, but it couldn’t find anything special, then it just went back to where it came from.
It’s worth mentioning that Big Yellow had great talent when it came to escaping. Very quickly, he had found a remote valley, and there was a desolate and hidden cave within.
Plop~
Big Yellow threw Jiang Chen forcefully from his back.
“Damn it, damned dog, can’t you be any gentler?! Tell me earlier if you want to put me down!”
Jiang Chen cursed.

Big Yellow stared at Jiang Chen in awe. He had an oily face, and he looked decent, he didn’t look like had been poisoned at all. Big Yellow immediately realized he had been cheated by Jiang Chen, and had carried him all the way for nothing.
He could tolerate many things, but not doing free labor. Big Yellow screamed and leaped towards Jiang Chen.
“The fuck, damned dog, I really was poisoned just now, and it’s just that I managed to absorb the poison! Ouch! Bastard, you bit my ass again!”
Jiang Chen became furious as well. This damned dog had bitten the same side of his butt every single time, and it had become swollen.
Therefore, a man and a dog started fighting in the small cave. The scene looked so familiar, and it was like the first time they had met each other.
A few minutes later, the man and dog stopped their fight. However, they were staring at each other fiercely.
“Damn it, you’ve torn my clothes! Do you want I, your father, to run out from here naked?!”
When Jiang Chen saw a huge hole on his pants near his butt, he had a feeling of wanting to head-butt Big Yellow.
“Fuck you, then what am I, your father, going to do with my panda eyes? Damn it, you were too fierce! Now your father’s handsome image is all gone!”
Big Yellow’s left eye now resembled the eye of a panda.
“Fuck off, guard the perimeter for your father, I’m going to break through to the Late Mortal Core realm now.”
Jiang Chen gazed at Big Yellow, then he found a big rock and sat down on it. He started adjusting his energy.
Big Yellow was mumbling to himself, but he knew that this was an important moment for Jiang Chen. Therefore, he went out to guard the entrance to the cave.
“Every time I have to guard.”
Big Yellow was unhappy about it.

Jiang Chen didn’t bother with Big Yellow as he was busy adjusting his energy. After his fight with the Bloody Combat Wolf and the man in black, he had been wounded twice, and his energy was now a bit of a mess. Before he attempted to break through to the next stage, he needed to adjust himself to his best form.

Right now, within Jiang Chen’s Qi Sea, the poison of the Green Hellish Python had changed color. Some black strips had mixed with the once greenish poison. Those black strips were the poison from the Silent Poisonous Needle.

This was the incredible benefit of the Dragon Transformation skill. With the poison of the Green Hellish Python as the foundation, Jiang Chen could absorb any types of poison and turn it into his own. After absorbing the poison from the needle, Jiang Chen’s poison became even stronger. If any ordinary Heavenly Core warrior was hit by this poison, he would basically die in an instant.
Jiang Chen took out the Bloody Combat Wolf’s demon soul. It kept emitting a bright, golden light, and a strong energy was flowing out from it.
“I’ll depend on you.”
Jiang Chen opened his mouth and swallowed the demon soul.
Bang!

The massive energy contained within the demon soul exploded in Jiang Chen’s body and swept across every single limb and bone in his body. Jiang Chen didn’t dare neglect its energy, and he immediately started circulating the Dragon Transformation skill in order to absorb all the energy.
As time passed by, new Dragon Marks kept forming in Jiang Chen’s Qi Sea.

Dawn, at the entrance of the Black Sect, a black figure suddenly appeared. It was the man in black who had gone to the Myriad Demon Mountain to kill Jiang Chen. The man removed all clothes and the veil covering his face. He was in his late twenties, and he had an ordinary face. He was one of those men whose faces couldn’t be remembered. However, his cultivation realm wasn’t weak, he was a Mid Heavenly Core warrior.
The man took out a Black Sect uniform, and after changing into it, he flew into the Black Sect.

Inside the Myriad Demon Mountain, when the bright sunlight chased away the darkness, the demon beasts within the mountain roared angrily and continuously. They unleashed their demonic auras, covering the mountain from the sunlight.

Sector two, within a remote valley. Big Yellow laid on the ground outside a cave with a bored expression. Inside the cave, Yuan energy was boiling around Jiang Chen, literally making it seem like he was in middle of a storm which might explode at any moment.

Right now, Jiang Chen needed to absorb the Bloody Combat Wolf’s demon soul bit by bit. This kind of demon soul, which contained a special bloodline, was the most difficult to absorb. Not only did Jiang Chen want to absorb the energy within, he also wanted to inherit the Bloody Combat Wolf’s Wolf King bloodline, and he wanted to form new Dragon Marks to increase his combat strength. The effectiveness of absorbing a special bloodline was always better than absorbing the energy alone.

It took much time to inherit the bloodline. After spending a night, Jiang Chen had only been able to form 5 new Dragon Marks. But he was very close to having a total of 60 Dragon Marks, which was so close to reaching the Late Mortal Core realm.

He was in his late twenties, and he had an ordinary face.
He was one of those men whose faces couldn’t be remembered.
However, his cultivation realm wasn’t weak, he was a Mid Heavenly Core warrior.
The man took out a Black Sect uniform, and after changing into it, he flew into the Black Sect.
Inside the Myriad Demon Mountain, when the bright sunlight chased away the darkness, the demon beasts within the mountain roared angrily and continuously.
They unleashed their demonic auras, covering the mountain from the sunlight.
Sector two, within a remote valley.
Big Yellow laid on the ground outside a cave with a bored expression.
Inside the cave, Yuan energy was boiling around Jiang Chen, literally making it seem like he was in middle of a storm which might explode at any moment.
Right now, Jiang Chen needed to absorb the Bloody Combat Wolf’s demon soul bit by bit.
This kind of demon soul, which contained a special bloodline, was the most difficult to absorb.

Not only did Jiang Chen want to absorb the energy within, he also wanted to inherit the Bloody Combat Wolf’s Wolf King bloodline, and he wanted to form new Dragon Marks to increase his combat strength.
The effectiveness of absorbing a special bloodline was always better than absorbing the energy alone.
It took much time to inherit the bloodline.
After spending a night, Jiang Chen had only been able to form 5 new Dragon Marks.
But he was very close to having a total of 60 Dragon Marks, which was so close to reaching the Late Mortal Core realm.

Chapter 121 - Late Mortal Core realm, 65 Dragon Marks

Inside a delicate courtyard within the inner circle area of the Black Sect, a young man dressed in white clothes stood solemnly. This courtyard occupied an entire mountain peak, and it was one of the best locations within the inner circle. Aside from Guan Yi Yun, only a few other disciples could have a place similar to this one.
This young man seemed to be in his late twenties. With a sharp facial figure and a handsome look, he could easily stand out amongst the crowds.
Swoosh!
A man suddenly appeared in the courtyard and walked up to this young man. The man who had suddenly appeared cupped his fist and greeted the young man, “Senior disciple Fan.”
The man who came was the same man who had hunted Jiang Chen in the Myriad Demon Mountain.
“Jiang Wei, how is everything?”
The young man asked. His name was Fan Kun, one of the strongest inner circle disciples. With a cultivation base at the peak of the Heavenly Core realm, he’s second only to Guan Yi Yun.
“Rest assured senior disciple Fan, mission accomplished.”
A sneer appeared on Jiang Wei’s face.
“Are you sure?”
A happy expression emerged on Fan Kun’s face.

“I’m sure! Jiang Chen was very cunning and powerful, and he almost slipped away. However, thanks to senior disciple Fan giving me the Silent Poisonous Needle, I was able to shoot the needle into his body and watch him die with my own eyes.”
Jiang Wei described the scene to Fan Kun.
“Very good, Jiang Wei, you’ve done a good job! I’ll reward you with something later.”
Fan Kun patted Jiang Wei’s shoulders. With a flattered feeling, Jiang Wei said, “It’s my honor to help senior disciple Fan!”

“We are all working for big brother Nan Bei. This Jiang Chen was courting death when he offended big brother Nan Bei. Not only this, he even challenged big brother Nan Bei to a fight in one year! Big brother Nan Bei couldn’t kill him because of his status, but I won’t let him get away with it!”
Fan Kun sneered.
“Senior disciple Fan, you should let big brother Nan Bei know that you’ve helped him kill Jiang Chen, that way, big brother Nan Bei will know that you were the one to help him out with this!”
Jiang Wei said.

“No need, big brother Nan Bei will look down on me if I seek credit for such a minor matter. He is now focusing on his cultivation, as his goal is to conquer this world. The Qi Province is just the beginning. Let’s perform our best and help big brother Nan Bei, I’m sure lots of benefits will await!”

Fan Kun said with a smile on his face. If the conversation between the two of them was heard by someone else, it would be enough to drop a bomb and frighten anyone. It was an unbelievable matter, Nan Bei Chao had set foot in the Black Sect, and it wasn’t difficult to imagine that he had men in the Heavenly Sword Sect and Valley of Happiness as well.
Nan Bei Chao was only 17-18 years old, but even Fan Kun addressed him as big brother. This went to show how much respect they had for Nan Bei Chao.

“Senior disciple Fan, right now, Guan Yi Yun has left the Black Sect and entered Inferno Hell. There’s no one else in the Black Sect who can suppress you! From now on, the inner and outer circle will all be in your hands, senior disciple Fan!”
Jiang Wei was kissing Fan Kun’s ass.
“Hmph! That idiot Guan Yi Yun, he is courting death by going to Inferno Hell!”
Fan Kun let out a cold snort, he was full of disdain towards Guan Yi Yun.
“Since Jiang Chen is now dead, I heard that the girl who followed Jiang Chen is a very pretty girl, a rare hot flower... Is senior disciple Fan interested in her?”
Jiang Wei squinted his eyes. His face carried an insidious smile.
“Is that so?”
An evil look appeared in Fan Kun’s eyes.
Myriad Demon Mountain!

It has been a few hours since Jiang Chen started absorbing the Bloody Combat Wolf’s demon soul. He had absorbed all the energy contained within, and the Bloody Combat Wolf’s bloodline had completely merged with his as well.
Buzz...

Around noon. An intense buzzing sound sounded out from within Jiang Chen’s body, strong energy ripples hovered around his body, and the natural Yuan energies within the valley had turned into whirlpools, making all energy crazily flow into Jiang Chen’s body.
Near the entrance, Big Yellow, who was bored, suddenly stood up. He stared at Jiang Chen who was covered in golden light.
“This abnormal monster is going to break through!”
Big Yellow felt surprised. The method and approach Jiang Chen used to break through was something he had never seen before.
Big Yellow moved out from the cave. He could guess that it was going to become a place of great havoc once Jiang Chen broke through to the Late Mortal Core realm, so he decided to keep some distance.

Jiang Chen’s energy was getting stronger and stronger, the natural energies within a few miles radius had been completely depleted, amazing blood colored Dragon Marks were flying and hovering around him, as if they were real.

Right at this moment, there were sixty Dragon Marks in Jiang Chen’s Qi Sea, and he was approaching the borderline of the Late Mortal Core realm. Jiang Chen grabbed a huge amount of Mortal Restoration Pills from his storage ring, and without checking how many there were, he swallowed everything.

Finally, after his energy reached its absolute peak, Jiang Chen’s cultivation realm stabled down at the Late Mortal Core realm. The impact and aid from the Bloody Combat Wolf’s bloodline was much stronger than the energy itself, and it had given Jiang Chen benefits beyond comparison.

Now, Jiang Chen had completely condensed a total of 60 Dragon Marks. However, after he broke through to the Late Mortal Core realm, the progress had yet to stop. With help from the bloodline, Jiang Chen managed to form another five Dragon Marks, making him possess a total of 65 Dragon Marks.
Crack...
Jiang Chen clenched his fist so tightly that it made a cracking sound. His eyes were glowing, he had a feeling that his strength was limitless.
“65 Dragon Marks, it feels so good to be this powerful! If I were to meet Li Wu Ling again in this form, I could kill him with just a single slap.”

Jiang Chen was very confident now. The strength of these 65 Dragon Marks had given him the ability to fight with a Mid Heavenly Core warrior. The genius type of Mid Heavenly Core warriors, that is. The ordinary Mid Heavenly Core warriors weren’t Jiang Chen’s match any longer.

If one were to take all of Jiang Chen’s abilities into consideration, it doesn’t matter whether it was a genius Mid Heavenly Core warrior or an ordinary one, none of them would have any advantages over Jiang Chen. Just the poison and Nine Phantom Wolves alone were enough to cause them headaches.
Swoosh swoosh...
Jiang Chen’s body wobbled, and 8 illusions of his own image appeared. Each illusion looked completely identical to his real self. 9 Jiang Chen’s moved and surrounded Big Yellow.
“Hehe, Big Yellow, can you find out which is the real me?”
All nine Jiang Chen’s asked at the same time. Doesn’t matter if it was their expressions, movements or tones, they were all completely identical. Big Yellow felt confused.
“Damn you, you’re amazing! You really obtained the Bloody Combat Wolf’s innate ability! Crazy, abnormally crazy! You’re really a super abnormal monster!”

Big Yellow fell down onto the ground. He felt excited and speechless at the same time. He had witnessed another miracle today, all while feeling speechless because of Jiang Chen’s insane ability. This method of breaking through was just crazy.

Jiang Chen would be able to absorb any innate abilities from any demon beasts, and turn it into his own ability. This abnormally terrifying ability, if anyone knew about it, they would probably die from fright.

With a thought, all 8 illusions retracted back into Jiang Chen’s body. With a bright smile on his face, Jiang Chen said, “Hehe, with the Nine Phantom Wolves, my overall combat strength have increased to another level; this illusion can surprise my opponent in a fight.”
“Abnormal monster!”
Big Yellow begun having more interest towards the skill Jiang Chen was cultivating, but he forced himself to restrain it due to not wanting to give a bowl of his own blood.
“Oh right, who was the one who wanted to kill you last night?”
Big Yellow asked.
Hearing this, Jiang Chen’s face darkened, “I’m sure he was someone from the Black Sect. If my guess is correct, he was from the inner circle.”
“I don’t think you have offended any inner circle disciples from the Black Sect? It seems like you haven’t even met any inner circle disciple since you came to the Black Sect.”
Big Yellow was puzzled.

“Yesterday, the man in black said something about me offending someone I shouldn’t have. I’ve never offended anyone from the Black Sect... Looks like the one who wanted to kill me didn’t want to kill me because of offending someone from the Black Sect... Do you think there’s any possibility it was related to Nan Bei Chao or Liang Xiao?”
Jiang Chen guessed.

“I don’t think so. The Heavenly Sword Sect and the Burning Sky Pavilion are enemies with the Black Sect, and no matter how powerful Nan Bei Chao and Liang Xiao are, it is impossible for them to ask someone in the Black Sect to kill you. Besides, that Nan Bei Chao is so proud of himself, he had agreed to the one-year fight date with you, someone like him wouldn’t use such a despicable approach to kill you. If this is wrong, then he would have killed you back in the Whirling Sun Square.”
Big Yellow said.
“Hmph! I don’t care who it was, but I won’t forget it! Those who tries to kill me will never have a good ending! Let’s go back to the Black Sect, I want to find the one who tried to kill me.”

Jiang Chen let out a cold snort. After breaking through to the Late Mortal Core realm, he had achieved the goal he had when coming to the Myriad Demon Mountain. Now, he needed to go back and concoct a pill that could strengthen his foundation, and start preparing to break through to the Heavenly Core realm.

Whenever he broke through, Jiang Chen could precisely feel how many Dragon Marks he needed for him to break through to the next stage or realm. Thus, in order for him to break through to the Heavenly Core realm, he would need a total of 100 Dragon Marks. Now, Jiang Chen had 65 Dragon Marks in his Qi Sea, so he needed another 35 Dragon Marks in order to break through to the Heavenly Core realm.

35 Dragon Marks wasn’t a small number. Besides, the Dragon Transformation skill consumed massive amounts of energy when breaking through, and whenever he broke through to a higher realm, it would become more difficult to progress further, therefore, it was a tough goal to break through to the Heavenly Core realm. However, on the other hand, Jiang Chen only needed a huge amount of energy to break through to the next realms and stages. For the once greatest saint in the world, there was no bottleneck when breaking through. He was only doing what he had basically done before, and whenever he reached a new realm, he would have perfect control over the natural Yuan energy, as he had already learned to control it once before.
Crack!
Just as Jiang Chen and Big Yellow were about to leave the valley, they heard a cracking sound coming from the cave. Although the sound was weak, Jiang Chen and Big Yellow could still clearly hear it.
“There’s something in the cave.”

Both of their eyes were glowing, and they walked into the cave together. They had examined the cave when they came here previously. It was just a 10 meter wide, old and ruined cave. Aside from the stone wall at the back of the cave, there were only some loose rocks on the floor.
Crack~
That was the sound of something cracking. Jiang Chen and Big Yellow both looked at the stone wall at the back of the cave, and then, they saw a crack appear on it. The sound was coming from the wall.

paragraphs: Okay, quick announcement here, as I can’t really post anywhere else. Starting today, I will be doing a total of 2 chapters every day, for a total of 14 regular chapters per week, as well as up to 7 sponsored chapters, meaning a possible total of 21 chapters a week. I will be doing this for the entirety of July, meaning, a total of 4 weeks/28 days.
If things go well, I will continue following this schedule in following months!
Anyways, enjoy the chapter!
Chapter 122 - Crisis in the Outer Circle
More and more cracks appeared on the stone wall. The entire stone wall was filled with cracks that kept on extending, resembling a gigantic spider web.

“I never expected that there would be something else in this cave. Behind this stone wall, there is an empty space, it looked perfectly normal. Without detailed examination, there’s no way we could have found anything special about it. I also didn’t find anything special when we were here previously... It must be the energy waves that appeared during your breakthrough that caused the destruction of this stone wall’s structure.”
Big Yellow said.
“What good luck, perhaps there is some treasure hiding inside!”
Jiang Chen’s eyes lit up. He loved treasures, and it was obvious that there was something special about this stone wall. Perhaps there was truly some treasure hidden within.

Big Yellow was even more straightforward, he spat out a golden beam towards the stone wall. With a loud bang, the stone wall which was filled with cracks shattered, and a dark passage appeared behind the stone wall, leading to an unknown place.
“There is really something hiding inside, come, let’s go check it out.”
Without any hesitation, Jiang Chen walked into the dark passage. A skillful warrior was never afraid of a challenge, and Jiang Chen was the perfect representation of that.
“Wait for me!”
Big Yellow followed and entered the passage behind Jiang Chen.
It was a narrow and dried passage. After Jiang Chen and Big Yellow walked for about 2-3 miles, they finally saw some light at the end of the passage.

They saw a cave at the end of the passage. Above the cave, there was a hole where the sunlight shone through. There was also water dripping down from the hole that fell into a big pool in the cave. A path made from dark green rocks was located in the middle of the cave.
“This is a natural water curtain cave, I never expected there would be such a beautiful place within the Myriad Demon Mountain!”
Jiang Chen said. This water curtain was incredibly beautiful, and it would be an ideal place to enter secluded cultivation.
“I sense some intense energies here, I’m sure there are some hidden treasures!”

Big Yellow sniffed around, he kept looking around and examining while his eyes were glowing brightly. After searching for some time, he stared at the center of the cave. There was a small pond made from some green crystal stones, and it was emitting a faded smoke.
“There really is treasure!”

Big Yellow immediately dashed out and came to the middle of the water curtain cave. He placed both of his paws on the side of the pool. At the same time, Jiang Chen came over and looked into the pool.
Both man’s and dog’s expressions changed, and they felt some difficulty when breathing.
“Energy Spring Water!”
Big Yellow and Jiang Chen shouted in surprise at the same time. They saw a meter wide pool fully filled with milky white Energy Spring Water.
“Damn! So much Energy Spring Water, it would be such of a waste to leave it here... Let your father drink a mouthful first!”
Without saying anything else, Big Yellow put his mouth into the pool and started drinking the Energy Spring Water.
“Fuck you, don’t drink it all!”

Jiang Chen had seen how Big Yellow ate at the Silver Moon restaurant, so he didn’t dare slow down for even a little bit. Although there was a lot of Energy Spring Water here, if he didn’t act fast, Big Yellow would devour it all.
This was Energy Spring Water, the true essence of this world. A drop of this would cost a fortune outside of this cave, and yet, there was pool filled with it right here.

If an ordinary man drank this Energy Spring Water, it would help strengthen his health and prolong his life. The Energy Spring Water provided even greater help for cultivators, it contained the purest energy. A cultivator would feel elevated, their bodies and muscles would strengthen, and all impurities within their bodies would disappear. It was a rare and precious treasure.

Jiang Chen didn’t care about his image anymore. Half his face was inside the pool, and he started drinking the Energy Spring Water. If the way this man and dog drank the Energy Spring Water. If this was known by anyone else, they would surely start screaming and start desiring to kill them. This was some fucking Energy Spring Water, not some plain water.

After drinking for some time, Jiang Chen and Big Yellow immediately stopped drinking. Big Yellow laid down on the side and fell asleep. Sleeping was his best method of digesting energy that he had just absorbed. Jiang Chen circulated the Dragon Transformation skill and begun digesting the energy. The reason why they stopped drinking was because they had drank too much of the energy, and if they didn’t digest it in time, they wouldn’t be able to sustain all the energy, even with their strong bodies.
Buzz buzz...

The Energy Spring Water was like a clear and refreshing stream that flowed around within Jiang Chen’s body. With help from the Dragon Transformation skill, all the energy was digested and used to condense new Dragon Marks.
An hour later, Jiang Chen and Big Yellow opened their eyes up at the same time. Both of them moved the same way, they jumped back to the pool and started drinking again.
The Energy Spring Water was definitely a rare treasure, and these two abnormal prodigals had just created the most wasteful method of drinking it; drinking it like it was plain water.

The man and dog stopped drinking after filling themselves up, then they started digesting the energy. Then, they repeated the entire process again and again. It took two days for them to completely stop.

Now, both of them were filled with energy. Big Yellow was glowing in a golden light, and he looked mighty. Jiang Chen was even more terrifying, with the help of the Energy Spring Water, in just two days he had formed another 15 new Dragon Marks. Now, he had a total of 80 Dragon Marks in his Qi Sea. He really had a great harvest for the trip.
With Jiang Chen’s current combat strength, he could kill any Mid Heavenly Core warrior. And, Late Heavenly Core warriors would have a hard time if they were to try and kill him.
“Damn it, enough, I don’t want to drink anymore, my stomach is going to explode.”

Big Yellow waggled his tail with a satisfied expression on his face. The Energy Spring Water had provided Big Yellow with huge benefits, and it had taken him one step closer to the Heavenly Core realm.
“Continuing drinking the Energy Spring Water won’t provide us any help... But there’s still half a pool of Energy Spring Water... Let’s take it and turn it into wine in the future!”

Jiang Chen said. Using the Energy Spring Water to make wine, if anyone heard this then they would immediately cough out some blood, and that person would definitely slam Jiang Chen’s face with his shoes.

He flipped his hand and took out a palm-size bottle from his storage ring. The bottle was also a storage item, and while it couldn’t hold too much liquid, it was still more than enough to hold all of the remaining Energy Spring Water.

After storing every last drop of the remaining Energy Spring Water into the bottle, Jiang Chen and Big Yellow left the Water Curtain Cave with satisfied expressions, then they left the Myriad Demon Mountain.

It had been three days since Jiang Chen left the Black Sect, and he had met a great harvest during this period. Chapter 122 - Crisis in the Outer Circle
More and more cracks appeared on the stone wall.
The entire stone wall was filled with cracks that kept on extending, resembling a gigantic spider web.
“I never expected that there would be something else in this cave.
Behind this stone wall, there is an empty space, it looked perfectly normal.
Without detailed examination, there’s no way we could have found anything special about it.
I also didn’t find anything special when we were here previously...
It must be the energy waves that appeared during your breakthrough that caused the destruction of this stone wall’s structure.”
Big Yellow said.
“What good luck, perhaps there is some treasure hiding inside!”
Jiang Chen’s eyes lit up.
He loved treasures, and it was obvious that there was something special about this stone wall.
Perhaps there was truly some treasure hidden within.
Big Yellow was even more straightforward, he spat out a golden beam towards the stone wall.
With a loud bang, the stone wall which was filled with cracks shattered, and a dark passage appeared behind the stone wall, leading to an unknown place.
“There is really something hiding inside, come, let’s go check it out.”
Without any hesitation, Jiang Chen walked into the dark passage.
A skillful warrior was never afraid of a challenge, and Jiang Chen was the perfect representation of that.
“Wait for me!”
Big Yellow followed and entered the passage behind Jiang Chen.
It was a narrow and dried passage.
After Jiang Chen and Big Yellow walked for about 2-3 miles, they finally saw some light at the end of the passage.
They saw a cave at the end of the passage.
Above the cave, there was a hole where the sunlight shone through.
There was also water dripping down from the hole that fell into a big pool in the cave.
A path made from dark green rocks was located in the middle of the cave.
“This is a natural water curtain cave, I never expected there would be such a beautiful place within the Myriad Demon Mountain!”
Jiang Chen said.
This water curtain was incredibly beautiful, and it would be an ideal place to enter secluded cultivation.
“I sense some intense energies here, I’m sure there are some hidden treasures!”
Big Yellow sniffed around, he kept looking around and examining while his eyes were glowing brightly.
After searching for some time, he stared at the center of the cave.
There was a small pond made from some green crystal stones, and it was emitting a faded smoke.
“There really is treasure!”
Big Yellow immediately dashed out and came to the middle of the water curtain cave.
He placed both of his paws on the side of the pool.
At the same time, Jiang Chen came over and looked into the pool.
Both man’s and dog’s expressions changed, and they felt some difficulty when breathing.
“Energy Spring Water!”
Big Yellow and Jiang Chen shouted in surprise at the same time.
They saw a meter wide pool fully filled with milky white Energy Spring Water.
“Damn!
So much Energy Spring Water, it would be such of a waste to leave it here...
Let your father drink a mouthful first!”
Without saying anything else, Big Yellow put his mouth into the pool and started drinking the Energy Spring Water.
“Fuck you, don’t drink it all!”
Jiang Chen had seen how Big Yellow ate at the Silver Moon restaurant, so he didn’t dare slow down for even a little bit.
Although there was a lot of Energy Spring Water here, if he didn’t act fast, Big Yellow would devour it all.
This was Energy Spring Water, the true essence of this world.
A drop of this would cost a fortune outside of this cave, and yet, there was pool filled with it right here.
If an ordinary man drank this Energy Spring Water, it would help strengthen his health and prolong his life.
The Energy Spring Water provided even greater help for cultivators, it contained the purest energy.
A cultivator would feel elevated, their bodies and muscles would strengthen, and all impurities within their bodies would disappear.
It was a rare and precious treasure.
Jiang Chen didn’t care about his image anymore.
Half his face was inside the pool, and he started drinking the Energy Spring Water.
If the way this man and dog drank the Energy Spring Water.
If this was known by anyone else, they would surely start screaming and start desiring to kill them.
This was some fucking Energy Spring Water, not some plain water.
After drinking for some time, Jiang Chen and Big Yellow immediately stopped drinking.
Big Yellow laid down on the side and fell asleep.
Sleeping was his best method of digesting energy that he had just absorbed.
Jiang Chen circulated the Dragon Transformation skill and begun digesting the energy.

The reason why they stopped drinking was because they had drank too much of the energy, and if they didn’t digest it in time, they wouldn’t be able to sustain all the energy, even with their strong bodies.
Buzz buzz...
The Energy Spring Water was like a clear and refreshing stream that flowed around within Jiang Chen’s body.
With help from the Dragon Transformation skill, all the energy was digested and used to condense new Dragon Marks.
An hour later, Jiang Chen and Big Yellow opened their eyes up at the same time.
Both of them moved the same way, they jumped back to the pool and started drinking again.
The Energy Spring Water was definitely a rare treasure, and these two abnormal prodigals had just created the most wasteful method of drinking it; drinking it like it was plain water.
The man and dog stopped drinking after filling themselves up, then they started digesting the energy.
Then, they repeated the entire process again and again.
It took two days for them to completely stop.
Now, both of them were filled with energy.
Big Yellow was glowing in a golden light, and he looked mighty.
Jiang Chen was even more terrifying, with the help of the Energy Spring Water, in just two days he had formed another 15 new Dragon Marks.
Now, he had a total of 80 Dragon Marks in his Qi Sea.
He really had a great harvest for the trip.
With Jiang Chen’s current combat strength, he could kill any Mid Heavenly Core warrior.
And, Late Heavenly Core warriors would have a hard time if they were to try and kill him.
“Damn it, enough, I don’t want to drink anymore, my stomach is going to explode.”
Big Yellow waggled his tail with a satisfied expression on his face.
The Energy Spring Water had provided Big Yellow with huge benefits, and it had taken him one step closer to the Heavenly Core realm.

But there’s still half a pool of Energy Spring Water...
Let’s take it and turn it into wine in the future!”

chapters.title: Chapter 123 - Burning the Courtyards to the Ground
paragraphs: He couldn’t let go of the matter like that, Jiang Chen had to know who was the one behind it all.
“Where is Wang Yun and Huang Zheng now?”
Jiang Chen asked.
“Senior disciple Wang and Huang Zheng are both healing their wounds at their courtyard. They were seriously wounded, and they can’t get off their beds.”
One of the disciples said.
“Let’s go, bring me to them.”

With a serious expression, Jiang Chen strode towards the residency area. This time, it didn’t matter if it was Wang Yun, Huang Zheng, or those disciples who were forced to hand out Mortal Restoration Pills, they had encountered this problem all because of Jiang Chen. Therefore, Jiang Chen had to step in and bring them their justice. If he didn’t, who would want to follow him in the future? Most importantly, he wanted to find out who was behind everything, and who was the man in black that tried to assassinate him in the Myriad Demon Mountain. And, Guo Lei was the first clue in finding the answers to these questions.

The residency for the outer circle disciples were rows of courtyards, and six disciples lived in each courtyard. Right now, Wang Yun and Huang Zheng were resting in the same room, and the courtyard was packed with people. Every one of them was angry.

“Damn it, this is ridiculous, we’ve been outer circle disciples for such a long time, and something like this has never happened before! Why is Guo Lei demanding us to give him our Mortal Restoration Pills?”

“Rumors said that senior disciple Jiang was killed in the Myriad Demon Mountain. It is obvious that Guo Lei purposely chose to pick on us, those who weren’t close to senior disciple Jiang aren’t targeted by him.”
“I don’t believe senior disciple Jiang has died, let’s wait for him to come back! I’m sure he will fight for our justice!”

Everyone was filled with righteous indignation, and when they looked at Wang Yun and Huang Zheng who were resting on the beds, they became even angrier. However, it was too bad that their strength wasn’t enough, and that was why they were being bullied.
“Look! It’s senior disciple Jiang! Senior disciple Jiang is back!”

Someone suddenly shouted with excitement. Then, everyone looked towards the entrance and saw a few men coming in. The young man who walked in front was wearing white clothes, and he bore an imposing aura. It was none other than Jiang Chen.
When all these disciples saw Jiang Chen, their bitter expressions immediately turned into surprised ones.
“Senior disciple Jiang is back! It really is senior disciple Jiang! Hahaha, I told you, he wouldn’t die so easily!”
“Senior disciple Jiang! It is so good to have you back! You must help us this time!”

All these disciples gathered around Jiang Chen and started complaining and telling him about their ignominy and rage. Guo Lei was protected by some inner circle disciples, and they couldn’t offend him at all; they could only count on Jiang Chen to help them. Right now, in the Black Sect, only Jiang Chen could help them.

As for the Sect Elders, they never really cared about fights amongst disciples. There had always been fights amongst disciples in all sects. This was the world of cultivation; only fights could push things forwards.
“Everyone, enough, senior disciple Jiang is here to help us.”
A disciple who stood next to Jiang Chen said.
“How are Wang Yun and Huang Zhang now?”
Jiang Chen asked.
When mentioning Wang Yun and Huang Zheng, everyone stopped talking, then they made way for Jiang Chen to go through.

Jiang Chen walked into the bedroom, and he could see two beds inside the room where two men were lying on top. They were motionless, and they had extremely weak energies. Jiang Chen walked closer to the beds, then he saw Wang Yun and Huang Zheng who were covered in bruises; their faces could barely be recognized, and their breaths were weak.

Looking at them, an uncontrollable anger immediately exploded within Jiang Chen’s body. From their wounds, he could easily tell what their opponents had done to them. It required some really cruel and brutal methods to make a Late Mortal Core warrior lose his ability to move.
Sensing someone there, Huang Zhen opened his eyes. When he saw it was Jiang Chen who was standing in front of him, an extremely happy look emerged in his eyes.
Huang Zheng struggled and tried to speak, but he couldn’t even move his lips.
“Don’t say anything, I know what’s going on.”

Jiang Chen placed his hand on Huang Zheng and stopped him from trying to speak. Since Huang Zheng had awakened, that meant he would soon recover. Wang Yun’s wounds were much more serious than Huang Zhen’s, and he was still in a coma right now.
“Senior disciple Wang Yun and Huang Zhen were defeated by Guo Lei. He even went as far as breaking senior’s legs and arms, that’s why he is still in a coma now.”
One of the disciples said.

Jiang Chen grabbed Wang Yun’s arms and checked his meridians. He found that although Wang Yun was seriously injured, his legs and arms still weren’t completely disable, they were only fractured. The chances of a full recovery was still there.
Jiang Chen put down Wang Yun’s arm, turned around and asked the disciple who was waiting at his residency, “What’s your name?”
“Senior disciple Jiang, my name is Wang Da Niu.”
The disciple looked straight and upright, no wonder his name was Wang Da Niu.
“Da Niu, help me go find Sect Elder Guo Shan, ask him to give you two Revival Pills. Just tell him Jiang Chen asked for it.”
Jiang Chen said.
“What? Sect Elder Guo Shan? Revival pill?”

Wang Da Niu was startled, the rest of the disciples almost had identical reactions. Everyone knew about Sect Elder Guo Shan, he was a highly respectable man in the Black Sect, and for these disciples from the outer circle, Guo Shan was someone from the top whom they could rarely meet. As for the Revival Pill, it was a rare healing pill that would cost a fortune. Although Wang Yun and Huang Zheng had such serious wounds, if they could get a Revival Pill, they would be fully recovered within 7 days.
However, Jiang Chen was asking him to go look for Sect Elder Guo Shan and ask for two Revival Pills. Was this a joke, or was Jiang Chen really an important person in Guo Shan’s mind?
“What are you waiting for?”
Jiang Chen furrowed his brows.
“I’ll go right now.”
Without further delay, Wang Da Niu immediately left the courtyard and started walking towards Guo Shan’s mountain peak, his mind full of doubt and fear.
“Where is Guo Lei right now?”
Jiang Chen asked.
“We don’t know, but surely within Black Sect.”
Someone said.
“Fine, bring me to where he stays.”

With an indifferent expression on his face, Jiang Chen’s voice was so cold that it could send shivers down anyone’s spines. No one here was an idiot, therefore, all of them could tell that Jiang Chen was really furious right now, and the consequences would be devastating.

As for how devastating the consequences would be, these disciples didn’t know. However, Big Yellow knew very clearly, today, the outer circle would be in complete mess. Big Yellow was incredibly excited, and he simply walked in front of everyone. Together with all disciples, they marched towards the place where Guo Lei lived.
Lead by Jiang Chen, the group with more than dozens of people walked across the residency areas, attracting the attention of all outer circle disciples who saw them.
“Look! Isn’t that Jiang Chen?! Heavens, I thought he was dead? How is he still alive?”
“Look at them, I’m sure they’re going to find Guo Lei and settle the score! Jiang Chen is a fierce man, Guo Lei is doomed this time!”
“No way, Guo Lei knows someone from the inner circle, Jiang Chen won’t dare touch him!”
“Save your breath! Who is Jiang Chen? He’s someone who dares offend Nan Bei Chao! Guo Lei is nothing in his eyes!”

Everyone’s tongues were waggling, they couldn’t wait to see what was going to happen. Jiang Chen was famous for his brutal and fierce approaches, and the conflict between Guo Lei and Wang Yun was known by everyone here. Now, Jiang Chen had come back, completely alive. It looked like he was ready to wreak havoc in the outer circle.

Guo Lei’s courtyard was located in the center of the residency area. It was a very elegant courtyard, and just from the outside, it looked much better than all the other courtyards. Besides, Guo Lei had the privilege of staying alone within this courtyard, and this went to show that he had a certain status within the outer circle.
Right now, the door to Guo Lei’s courtyard was shut. It looked like he wasn’t inside the house. But, it was around noon, therefore, it was perfectly normal that he wasn’t there.
“Open the door!”
Right after Jiang Chen’s words left his mouth, Big Yellow dashed forwards, and with a loud bang, he shattered the door to the courtyard.
There’s no one in the courtyard, and the door to the house was closed.
“Senior disciple Jiang, Guo Lei is not here.”
A disciple said.
“Burn this courtyard.”
Jiang Chen said with an indifferent tone.

What? Burn the courtyard? This wasn’t a joke, ever since the Black Sect had been established, although there had always been conflicts between disciples, no one had ever tried to burn a courtyard. After all, the courtyard was the property of the Black Sect; it had nothing to do with anyone.

However, Big Yellow never cared about stuff like that. He loved activities like these, killing someone and burning down houses. When he was at the Heavenly Sword Sect, he had burnt down all the female residencies.

Big Yellow spat out a fireball which landed on the roof of one of the rooms. In just a few breaths time, all buildings within the courtyard were caught in the fire. The fire Big Yellow had spat out was incredibly powerful, and even Jiang Chen was surprised by it. Big Yellow had been with him for quite some time, but this was the first time he had seen that he was able to spit fire. This dog was a really competent fellow.
“Heavens, fire! Jiang Chen really set Guo Lei’s courtyard on fire! This is brutal!”
Someone shouted out loudly. It looked like the outer circle was going to be in a mess today.
“Aside from Guo Lei, who else bullied you all?”
Jiang Chen asked with an indifferent tone.
The disciples who had been bullied mentioned a few more names, they were so excited. Jiang Chen was a really domineering person, he had simply just burnt down the entire courtyard.
“Big Yellow, help me burn down the courtyards of those guys.”
Jiang Chen’s expression didn’t change. Burning down some courtyards was the same as burning some wood to him.
Swoosh swoosh...

Big Yellow kept spitting fireballs out from his mouth, setting another courtyard on fire. Big Yellow controlled his fire precisely, and although the fire was raging, it never sparked a single fire to another courtyard.
Soon, the flame was raging in the resident area, such a big turmoil had shaken the outer circle.
In the training grounds within the outer circle, many disciples saw the fires and were shocked. Amongst them, four disciples’ expressions changed dramatically.
“Senior disciple Guo, it looks like our courtyards are on fire!”
One of the disciples said with a shocked expression.
“Damn it, who has the guts to burn my courtyard?! Come, let’s go check it out!”

The young man scolded. He brought the three other disciples towards the residency areas. This young man was in his mid twenties. With a muscular body and a red scar on his forehead, he looked ferocious.

This guy was none other than Guo Lei. With his cultivation at the peak of the Mortal Core realm, after Han Yan had entered secluded meditation, and Jiang Chen had disappeared, no one in the outer circle dared offend him.
