Jiang Chen placed his hand on Huang Zheng and stopped him from trying to speak.
Since Huang Zheng had awakened, that meant he would soon recover.
Wang Yun’s wounds were much more serious than Huang Zhen’s, and he was still in a coma right now.
“Senior disciple Wang Yun and Huang Zhen were defeated by Guo Lei.
He even went as far as breaking senior’s legs and arms, that’s why he is still in a coma now.”
One of the disciples said.
Jiang Chen grabbed Wang Yun’s arms and checked his meridians.
He found that although Wang Yun was seriously injured, his legs and arms still weren’t completely disable, they were only fractured.
The chances of a full recovery was still there.
Jiang Chen put down Wang Yun’s arm, turned around and asked the disciple who was waiting at his residency, “What’s your name?”
“Senior disciple Jiang, my name is Wang Da Niu.”
The disciple looked straight and upright, no wonder his name was Wang Da Niu.
“Da Niu, help me go find Sect Elder Guo Shan, ask him to give you two Revival Pills.
Just tell him Jiang Chen asked for it.”
Jiang Chen said.
“What?
Sect Elder Guo Shan?
Revival pill?”
Wang Da Niu was startled, the rest of the disciples almost had identical reactions.

Everyone knew about Sect Elder Guo Shan, he was a highly respectable man in the Black Sect, and for these disciples from the outer circle, Guo Shan was someone from the top whom they could rarely meet.
As for the Revival Pill, it was a rare healing pill that would cost a fortune.
Although Wang Yun and Huang Zheng had such serious wounds, if they could get a Revival Pill, they would be fully recovered within 7 days.
However, Jiang Chen was asking him to go look for Sect Elder Guo Shan and ask for two Revival Pills.
Was this a joke, or was Jiang Chen really an important person in Guo Shan’s mind?
“What are you waiting for?”
Jiang Chen furrowed his brows.
“I’ll go right now.”
Without further delay, Wang Da Niu immediately left the courtyard and started walking towards Guo Shan’s mountain peak, his mind full of doubt and fear.
“Where is Guo Lei right now?”
Jiang Chen asked.
“We don’t know, but surely within Black Sect.”
Someone said.
“Fine, bring me to where he stays.”
With an indifferent expression on his face, Jiang Chen’s voice was so cold that it could send shivers down anyone’s spines.
No one here was an idiot, therefore, all of them could tell that Jiang Chen was really furious right now, and the consequences would be devastating.
As for how devastating the consequences would be, these disciples didn’t know.
However, Big Yellow knew very clearly, today, the outer circle would be in complete mess.
Big Yellow was incredibly excited, and he simply walked in front of everyone.
Together with all disciples, they marched towards the place where Guo Lei lived.
Lead by Jiang Chen, the group with more than dozens of people walked across the residency areas, attracting the attention of all outer circle disciples who saw them.
“Look!
Isn’t that Jiang Chen?!
Heavens, I thought he was dead?
How is he still alive?”
“Look at them, I’m sure they’re going to find Guo Lei and settle the score!
Jiang Chen is a fierce man, Guo Lei is doomed this time!”
“No way, Guo Lei knows someone from the inner circle, Jiang Chen won’t dare touch him!”
“Save your breath!
Who is Jiang Chen?
He’s someone who dares offend Nan Bei Chao!
Guo Lei is nothing in his eyes!”
Everyone’s tongues were waggling, they couldn’t wait to see what was going to happen.
Jiang Chen was famous for his brutal and fierce approaches, and the conflict between Guo Lei and Wang Yun was known by everyone here.
Now, Jiang Chen had come back, completely alive.
It looked like he was ready to wreak havoc in the outer circle.
Guo Lei’s courtyard was located in the center of the residency area.
It was a very elegant courtyard, and just from the outside, it looked much better than all the other courtyards.
Besides, Guo Lei had the privilege of staying alone within this courtyard, and this went to show that he had a certain status within the outer circle.
Right now, the door to Guo Lei’s courtyard was shut.
It looked like he wasn’t inside the house.
But, it was around noon, therefore, it was perfectly normal that he wasn’t there.
“Open the door!”
Right after Jiang Chen’s words left his mouth, Big Yellow dashed forwards, and with a loud bang, he shattered the door to the courtyard.
There’s no one in the courtyard, and the door to the house was closed.
“Senior disciple Jiang, Guo Lei is not here.”
A disciple said.
“Burn this courtyard.”
Jiang Chen said with an indifferent tone.
What?
Burn the courtyard?
This wasn’t a joke, ever since the Black Sect had been established, although there had always been conflicts between disciples, no one had ever tried to burn a courtyard.
After all, the courtyard was the property of the Black Sect; it had nothing to do with anyone.
However, Big Yellow never cared about stuff like that.
He loved activities like these, killing someone and burning down houses.
When he was at the Heavenly Sword Sect, he had burnt down all the female residencies.
Big Yellow spat out a fireball which landed on the roof of one of the rooms.
In just a few breaths time, all buildings within the courtyard were caught in the fire.
The fire Big Yellow had spat out was incredibly powerful, and even Jiang Chen was surprised by it.
Big Yellow had been with him for quite some time, but this was the first time he had seen that he was able to spit fire.
This dog was a really competent fellow.
“Heavens, fire!
Jiang Chen really set Guo Lei’s courtyard on fire!
This is brutal!”
Someone shouted out loudly.
It looked like the outer circle was going to be in a mess today.
“Aside from Guo Lei, who else bullied you all?”
Jiang Chen asked with an indifferent tone.
The disciples who had been bullied mentioned a few more names, they were so excited.
Jiang Chen was a really domineering person, he had simply just burnt down the entire courtyard.
“Big Yellow, help me burn down the courtyards of those guys.”
Jiang Chen’s expression didn’t change.
Burning down some courtyards was the same as burning some wood to him.
Swoosh swoosh...
Big Yellow kept spitting fireballs out from his mouth, setting another courtyard on fire.
Big Yellow controlled his fire precisely, and although the fire was raging, it never sparked a single fire to another courtyard.
Soon, the flame was raging in the resident area, such a big turmoil had shaken the outer circle.
In the training grounds within the outer circle, many disciples saw the fires and were shocked.
Amongst them, four disciples’ expressions changed dramatically.
“Senior disciple Guo, it looks like our courtyards are on fire!”
One of the disciples said with a shocked expression.
“Damn it, who has the guts to burn my courtyard?!
Come, let’s go check it out!”
The young man scolded.
He brought the three other disciples towards the residency areas.
This young man was in his mid twenties.
With a muscular body and a red scar on his forehead, he looked ferocious.
This guy was none other than Guo Lei.
With his cultivation at the peak of the Mortal Core realm, after Han Yan had entered secluded meditation, and Jiang Chen had disappeared, no one in the outer circle dared offend him.

chapters.title: Chapter 124 - Let’s settle the score
paragraphs: In Guo Lei’s mind, Jiang Chen was dead. The disciple from the inner circle wouldn’t fool him on this matter. Thus, since Jiang Chen wasn’t here anymore, and Han Yan was in secluded cultivation, he, Guo Lei, would be the king in the outer circle, and no one could step on him. Now, someone had the guts to burn his courtyard in broad daylight, this was just ridiculous.

Guo Lei alone with the other three moved towards the courtyards with extremely fast speed and anger. After a while, they arrived at their destination. The flames had attracted other disciples in the outer circle as well, and they were all crowding towards the scene.

When Guo Lei brought his men and arrived at the courtyard, he found that a lot of disciples had gathered. When some of them saw Guo Lei, they tried telling him about Jiang Chen’s presence, but when they saw the arrogant expression on his face, they gave up the idea of telling him.

Guo Lei was a bully, therefore, not many disciples liked him. It was just that they didn’t dare voice their opinions on this. Besides, Jiang Chen had come back today, and since they didn’t dare offend Guo Lei, then they would definitely not dare to offend Jiang Chen. What happened today was pretty clear, Jiang Chen had burnt the courtyards to signal that he was looking for Guo Lei, and so, the rest of the disciples just sat back and kept their hands away from the conflict.
“Fuck, which bastard set fire on father’s courtyard?! Is he trying to court death?!”
The furious Guo Lei kept cursing. He looked like he was about to chop the culprit into a thousand pieces upon finding out who he was.
There was a mini square right in the middle of the residency area. When Guo Lei and his men angrily entered the square, they bumped into Jiang Chen who was coming from the opposite direction.
When the angry and arrogant Guo Lei and his men saw Jiang Chen, they almost tripped and fell down with faces filled with shock. It was as if they had seen a ghost.

Guo Lei’s reaction was slightly better than that of the three other men. All of them knew about Jiang Chen’s approaches very well, they too had witnessed how Jiang Chen had killed Li Wu Ling. Offending this demon was not a fun thing.
“Fuck! Wasn’t he supposed to be dead?! Why is he still here, alive and kicking?!”

Guo Lei couldn’t control his emotions and cursed. Although he was a pretty brave man, and didn’t seem to care much when mentioning Jiang Chen, now that he was really standing face to face with Jiang Chen, the feeling was completely different. He was scared.
“What should we do, senior disciple Guo? Looks like the one who burnt down our courtyards was Jiang Chen! He isn’t dead, and he is here to find us...”

One of the disciples had a helpless expression on his face. When he thought about what they had done during the last two days, and how they had harmed Wang Yun and Huang Zheng, with their understanding towards Jiang Chen, he surely wouldn’t let them go this time.
“Damn, there’s no way we can run, don’t tell me he is going to kill us...”
“Jiang Chen isn’t dead... From now on, there’s no place for us to stay within the outer circle anymore...”
The other two disciples were so scared they felt like they were about to die. When facing the ferocious Jiang Chen, there was no way for them to stay calm.

“Useless fools, why are you all so scared? No matter how strong Jiang Chen is, he is still an outer circle disciple, and we were ordered by a senior disciple from the inner circle to deal with Wang Yun and the rest! This is the Black Sect, not a place where Jiang Chen can decide everything! Besides, he is only an outer circle disciple, don’t tell me he is going to act against the rules?”
Guo Lei said with a grin. He wasn’t really scared like the other disciples, because he had the support of an inner circle disciple.
“Who is Guo Lei?”
With a sharp vision, Jiang Chen stared at the four men in front of him.
“I’m Guo Lei! Jiang Chen, how dare you burn down our sect’s courtyard? Are you really that undisciplined and out of control?”

Guo Lei took a step forwards. Right now, there was no way for him to get away, and he could only face this head on. However, when he really stood face to face with Jiang Chen, he found himself lacking self-confidence.
“So, you’re Guo Lei? Perfect! Looks like you’re a clever man, so I suppose you already know why I was looking for you. Let’s settle our score today.”
Jiang Chen said with a sneer.
“Senior disciple Jiang, these three men were the ones who beat up Huang Zheng!”
Someone jumped out and pointed at the men behind Guo Lei. The three of them had a change in expression, and they felt unnatural.
“The four of you, kneel down.”
Jiang Chen said coolly.
“What?!”

Guo Lei shouted out. With his eyes almost popping out, he stared at Jiang Chen and said, “Jiang Chen, who do you think you are? Why do you tell us to kneel down? Let me tell you this; they might be afraid of you, but I, your father am not! You’re just a newcomer, who gave you the audacity to instruct me?”
“Big Yellow.”

Jiang Chen still carried a sneer. Big Yellow leapt forwards and pushed Guo Lei onto the ground. Guo Lei was at the peak of the Mortal Core realm, but when facing Big Yellow’s attack, he didn’t even have the chance to react and defend himself. Big Yellow was just like a mountain that sat on top of him; no matter how much he struggled, he just couldn’t get him off.
Guo Lei’s face had a terrified expression. However, Big Yellow didn’t care about that, he just opened his mouth and forcefully bit down on Guo Lei’s shoulder.
Crack!
Big Yellow was extremely ferocious. With his sharp teeth, he ripped out a huge chunk of muscles from Guo Lei’s shoulder, making him start bleeding unstoppably from the wound.
Ahhhh...
The scream coming from the extreme pain spread across the entire residency area, and it sent a shiver down the spines of all who heard this terrifying scream.
Gasp~

Those who witnessed what happened immediately gasped. This dog was too fierce, without saying anything, he immediately seriously wounded Guo Lei. They all knew that Guo Lei was doomed when Jiang Chen said he wanted to settle the score between them. Guo Lei was already dead meat.
“This dog is so horrifying, Guo Lei is at a peak Mortal Core warrior, but in front of that big yellow dog, he simply has no way to resist!”
“This is brutal! Jiang Chen is really someone he shouldn’t have offended!”
People were sighing. When they looked at the miserable Guo Lei, those who followed Jiang Chen had satisfied expressions on their faces.

Big Yellow had only ripped of a chunk of muscle from Guo Lei, he hadn’t killed him. For a peak Mortal Core warrior, a wound like this was not worth mentioning compared to what Wang Yun and Huang Zheng had suffered. However, it was enough to terrify everyone.
Big Yellow got off of Guo Lei, then he stared at the other three disciples who were trembling with a fierce look. The trio were so scared that they immediately kneeled down.
“Please spare us, senior disciple Jiang!”
The trio was incredibly frightened. Before standing face to face with Jiang Chen, they simply had no idea how fierce and terrifying Jiang Chen could be.
“Spare you?”

Jiang Chen let out a cold snort, “Now, let me settle the score with you three. Guo Lei, tell me honestly, how much many Mortal Restoration Pills have you collected during the previous two days? If you dare be off by just one, I’ll cripple one of your arms.”

Jiang Chen’s gaze was fierce, and anyone who stared into his eyes felt a chill down their spine. Guo Lei’s arrogance and pride had disappeared. He pushed down on the shoulder wound with his hand and kneeled down like the other three disciples. He knew that Jiang Chen wasn’t joking or trying to scare him, if he didn’t give him the real number, he would meet a miserable end today.
“There’s a total of 8,000 Mortal Restoration Pills.”
Guo Lei said.
“Eight thousand. Good. Now, I want you to pay ten times that amount, give me 80,000 Mortal Restoration Pills now as a token of your apology. I won’t accept even one less.”

Hearing that Jiang Chen asked him to pay 80,000 Mortal Restoration Pills, Guo Lei and the other three disciples felt like they had been struck by thunder and almost fainted. Eighty thousand Mortal Restoration Pills was a huge amount of wealth, and none of the outer circle disciples would have such a massive amount of Mortal Restoration Pills.
“Senior disciple Jiang, these eighty... eighty thousand Mortal Restoration Pills... We really don’t have so many... We were wrong senior disciple Jiang, please forgive us!”
Guo Lei said in a begging manner.

“That’s right, senior disciple Jiang, 80,000 Mortal Restoration Pills, we really don’t have so many... Besides, we don’t even have all 8,000 Mortal Restoration Pills with us, most of them were given to the inner circle disciples...”
Another disciple said. He tried mentioning the inner circle disciples, hoping that Jiang Chen wouldn’t be rigid.
“So now you try to act pitifully in front of me.”

Jiang Chen said with a sneer. He had seen with his own eyes how Wang Yun and Huang Zheng had been wounded. If this place wasn’t the Black Sect, these four men in front of him would have already been killed by now.
“I want 80,000 Mortal Restoration Pills, the full amount! If you can’t choke them out, then you can pay with your own lives. Big Yellow, kill them.”

Jiang Chen’s words sent chills down their spines. Then, they saw Big Yellow walking towards them, his teeth showing. After recalling how brutal Big Yellow was, the faces of these four men immediately turned pale, and they were scared to the absolute limit.
“No, don’t kill us! I’ll find a way! I know what to do!”
Guo Lei was incredibly frightened. His shoulder was still bleeding, and the fear he felt towards Big Yellow couldn’t be compared with anyone else’s fear.

“Jiang... senior disciple Jiang, most of the Mortal Restoration Pills we collected were given to the disciples from the inner circle! If senior disciple Jiang really wants them back, I can go find senior disciple Cai in the inner circle!”

Guo Lei said. He had been planning in his mind, in his current situation, there would be no way for him to run away from Jiang Chen. Therefore, he could only get help from a inner circle disciple to deal with Jiang Chen.
“Who is this senior disciple Cai?”
Jiang Chen asked.
“Senior disciple Cai Dong is from the inner circle, we were ordered by him to do all of this! The news about you dying in the Myriad Demon Mountain also came from his mouth!”
Guo Lei didn’t dare hide anything, Cai Dong was the man backing him from the inner circle. Right at this moment, only Cai Dong could save him.

Jiang Chen’s eyes turned cold, he didn’t know if this Cai Dong was related to the man in black who tried assassinating him in the mountain, or if they were the same person. Jiang Chen turned around and told one of the disciples, “Go to the inner circle and find that Cai Dong, ask him to come here right now. I want him to settle the debt of 80,000 Mortal Restoration Pills.”
“Understood, senior disciple Jiang!”

The disciple’s face was filled with excitement. Senior disciple Jiang was really dignified. It looked like he was about to play something big this time, and he even wanted to pick a fight with an inner circle disciple.

Guo Lei was startled, as he had never expected Jiang Chen to react this way. He thought that Jiang Chen would calm down after hearing that this was related to an inner circle disciple. However, out of his expectations, Jiang Chen had really dared to challenge an inner circle disciple.

But, Guo Lei felt relief at the same time. Since Jiang Chen thought so greatly of himself, this would be Guo Lei’s chance. When Cai Dong comes here, he would be saved and protected. However, things weren’t as simple as he thought, Jiang Chen had yet to finish with him. What happened next would just make him feel regret.
“So now, even Cai Dong from the inner circle is going to be dragged into this mess.”
“Jiang Chen is going to settle the score with an inner circle disciple, this is so amazing!”
“Don’t jump to conclusions, this matter is far from finished! I heard Wang Yun and Huang Zhen were seriously wounded!”

He thought that Jiang Chen would calm down after hearing that this was related to an inner circle disciple.
However, out of his expectations, Jiang Chen had really dared to challenge an inner circle disciple.
But, Guo Lei felt relief at the same time.
Since Jiang Chen thought so greatly of himself, this would be Guo Lei’s chance.
When Cai Dong comes here, he would be saved and protected.
However, things weren’t as simple as he thought, Jiang Chen had yet to finish with him.
What happened next would just make him feel regret.
“So now, even Cai Dong from the inner circle is going to be dragged into this mess.”
“Jiang Chen is going to settle the score with an inner circle disciple, this is so amazing!”
“Don’t jump to conclusions, this matter is far from finished!
I heard Wang Yun and Huang Zhen were seriously wounded!”

chapters.title: Chapter 125 - Hanged up and beaten
paragraphs: The conflict had actually dragged in an inner circle disciple, this surprised many people. However, what was even more surprising was Jiang Chen’s reaction. Because, after hearing about Cai Dong, not only did he not show any signs of wanting the conflict to end, he actually wanted to settle the score with Cai Dong.
A Mortal Core outer circle disciple dared to act against a Heavenly Core inner circle disciple, this was the first time. And, amongst all the outer circle disciples, only Jiang Chen dared to do this.
“Senior disciple Jiang, we were told to do this, and we know we have made a big mistake! Please forgive us!”
Guo Lei tried asking for forgiveness. In his mind, he wished that Jiang Chen could be killed now. However, he was being held for ransom right now, therefore, he could only beg for forgiveness.

“A big mistake? With this, you are asking for forgiveness? What about Wang Yun and Huang Zhen who were badly wounded by you and are now laying on beds? I will ask Cai Dong to pay back the Mortal Restoration Pills, and as for you lot, I’ll let you pay back for what you’ve done to Wang Yun and Huang Zheng now.”
Jiang Chen said in a stiff manner, “But, before we do this, hand over every single Mortal Restoration Pill you have now, they will serve as compensation.”

Hearing what Jiang Chen said, Guo Lei and the other three men who had just seen some hope immediately had their faces darken. It looked like Jiang Chen was not going to let this matter end easily. The four of them felt chills ran down their spines when they recalled how Wang Yun and Huang Zheng were wounded.
“Hurry, senior disciple Jiang is asking you to take out all your Mortal Restoration Pills, are you guys deaf?!”
A disciple shouted at them.
“That’s right, take out everything you got! Those Mortal Restoration Pills belong to us, take out everything you took from us!”
Those disciples who were bullied by Guo Lei had now found their backup, it was time for their revenge. They would not miss any opportunity to hit them back.
“Fine, we’ll take them out now, we’ll take them out now!”

These three disciples were completely scared, their lives were at risk now. Mortal Restoration Pills were not going to keep them safe. They reached for their storage bags and hurriedly took out all Mortal Restoration Pills.
“And you, Guo Lei, hand me everything you got. If you dare keep even a single pill with you, I’ll ask Big Yellow to give you some nice treatment!”
Jiang Chen said with a sneer. His words caused Guo Lei to tremble. Without any hesitation, he hurriedly took out all of his belongings.
“Senior disciple Jiang, here are 9,000 Mortal Restoration Pills.”
A disciple counted all the Mortal Restoration Pills and told Jiang Chen.
“Damn it, 9,000 Mortal Restoration Pills, this Guo Lei is filthy rich!”

Some of the outer circle disciple who were standing aside couldn’t help but curse. Mortal Restoration Pills were their life, they all consumed a lot of them during cultivation, and therefore, most of them did not have a huge stockpile. However, these four guys had a total of 9,000 Mortal Restoration Pills, and Guo Lei himself contributed 5,000. It looked like all their wealth came from bullying other outer circle disciples.
“Share it with all our brothers.”
Jiang Chen said calmly, this amount of Mortal Restoration Pills meant nothing to him.
“Senior disciple Jiang, we have given all our Mortal Restoration Pills to you, please let us go!”
A disciple begged.
“Let you go? We’re just about to settle the score for Wang Yun and Huang Zheng. All four of you did beat them up, right?”
An insidious smile appeared on Jiang Chen’s face.
All four of them kept silent, they couldn’t deny that since there were so many disciple on the spot. That day, it was Guo Lei who had beaten Wang Yun, while the other three had assaulted Huang Zheng.
“So, I assume you admit to that. Today, let me teach you a lesson! I, and your father’s men, are not someone you can touch! Those who dares do so will have to pay back double!”
After speaking, Jiang Chen struck out forcefully with his leg.
Crack!

The leg landed right onto Guo Lei’s face. Jiang Chen barely held back, so the powerful kick sent Guo Lei flying more than ten meters. With a face full of blood and a broken nose, he screamed out in pain.
Swoosh!

Jiang Chen moved again and came in front of Guo Lei. He bent down and grabbed Guo Lei’s shoulder, then he pulled him up like a chicken. The way Wang Yun and Huang Zheng had been wounded had pissed him off, he wanted to personally bring them justice.
“No, don’t!”
Guo Lei was extremely scared. He was waiting for Cai Dong to come here and rescue him, he hadn’t expected Jiang Chen to not even give him that chance, and started beating him up immediately.
Crack! Ahh...
Guo Lei screamed even louder as Jiang Chen twisted one of his arms with a huge amount of force, breaking it and making it hang behind his back.
Ignoring all fearful eyes around, Jiang Chen grabbed another one of Guo Lei’s arms and broke it. In just the blink of an eye, Jiang Chen had crippled the man. A ferocious and cruel approach.
“Heavens, this is brutal! This approach, it sends chills down my spine!”
“Compared to senior disciple Han, I think he is more deserving of the Little Devil King name! Guo Lei has offended someone he absolutely shouldn’t have!”
“He is gone this time.”
Everyone were immersed in deep shock, and their faces were filled with fear. Guo Lei with both arms broken and with blood dripping all over his face was absolutely terrifying to look at.
“Guys!”
Jiang Chen shouted toward the crowds.
“Yes!”
Three outer circle disciples respectfully stepped forward.
“Go get me a wooden pole, hang them up and beat them.”

Jiang Chen kicked Guo Lei once again, making him fall down onto the ground, then he stepped on his face in an extremely tyrannical manner. Jiang Chen never showed any mercy when dealing with his enemies, some mistakes required you to pay back seriously. Guo Lei had been acting together with those guys from the inner circle who wanted to kill him, and in Jiang Chen’s mind, he had already sentenced Guo Lei to death. If it wasn’t for the fact that they were currently in the Black Sect, Guo Lei would have been dead long ago.
“Understood.”
The three disciples turned around and left. Jiang Chen’s wish was their order.
Swoosh!
Jiang Chen turned his vision onto the other three guys. These three fellows immediately gasped and started kowtowing. They were scared to death, as they had never met anyone so ferocious and brutal.
“Senior disciple Jiang, please spare our lives, spare us!”
The trio kept asking for forgiveness, all of their arrogance was completely gone.
“Senior disciple Jiang, don’t let them go, they are just three bastards! Not only did they bully us, they even seriously beat up senior disciple Huang!”
Someone shouted out in anger. Everyone wished to tear apart this trio when recalling their arrogant faces two days ago.
“Everyone, beat them until they die, I’ll bear the responsibility!”

Jiang Chen was a fierce man. There was nothing in this world he was scared of, there was no one he didn’t dare to kill. These few disciples were just like ants to him, and when they offended him, there was no way he would forgive them.
“Beat them!”
“Let’s get revenge for Huang Zheng, beat them until they die!”
After receiving orders from Jiang Chen, dozens of disciples poured in and started beating the trio.
Bam bam bam...
Ahh ahhh ahhhh...
“Fuck, kill them!”
“Damn it, trying to be bossy and bully us, let’s kill them!”
“Senior disciple Jiang said he will bear the responsibility if they die!”
The courtyard was burning on one side, and here was a messy one-sided fight. For Guo Lei and the other three disciples, today was the darkest day of their lives.
Miserable, this was really miserable.

Those outer circle disciples who were watching from the sidelines were all frightened. Finally, they had witnessed Jiang Chen’s aggressiveness. Although they were scared, no one really felt sorry for these guys, some of them even felt satisfaction in their minds.

Not long after, the trio had been seriously beaten. Their faces were already swollen and wounded, and they were bleeding all over. They kept struggling and crying on the floor, but these injuries were nothing for a Mortal Core warrior.

Right at this moment, the three disciples who had left earlier came back. One of them carried a 7 meter tall wooden pole, another one carried a pike in his hand, and the last disciple carried some ropes in his hand. Then, they placed the wooden pole so that it stood straight up from the ground.
“Senior disciple Jiang, the wooden pole is here.”
The disciple said with a satisfied expression.
“Hang them up and beat them, don’t stop until they are dead.”

Jiang Chen shouted out loudly. The ‘don’t stop until they are dead’ part had completely scared Guo Lei and the others. Now, they felt extreme regret over what they had done. They knew that Jiang Chen was not a guy they could easily mess with, but they had never expected he would be so brutal. It looked like he really wanted to beat them until death took them away.

The other disciples didn’t care so much. They had now become totally submissive to Jiang Chen. Whatever Jiang Chen asked, they would do. They tied up the four guys together and hung them high up on the wooden pole, as if they were some dead pigs. All four of them were bleeding all over, and they looked miserable.
“Give me that.”
Jiang Chen grabbed the long pike, then he started beating them like they were dead meat. It was a horrifying scene to watch.
“Beat them, and don’t stop until they are dead.”
A few disciples took out some long pikes and started beating Guo Lei and the other three. As long as Jiang Chen was there, they would never fear things going out of control.
“Stop there!”

Right at this moment, an angry shout came from afar, and then, everyone saw an old man in his fifties flying over and landing in the square. When the old man saw the four men hanging from the wooden pole, and the burnt down courtyards, he immediately became extremely furious.
“It is Sect Elder Lee! Damn, this really went out of control; even Sect Elder Lee came.”
“Sect Elder Lee is an outer circle Sect Elder, but those elders rarely care about the conflicts amongst disciples, so why is he here today?”
Many disciples recognized the old man, as one of the Sect Elders in charge of the outer circle, he was known by everyone.
“Bastards, what are you all doing? Hurting and killing your own fellow disciples? Who set fire to the courtyard? Stand out right now!”

Sect Elder Lee scolded with a loud voice. When Guo Lei and the other three disciples saw him, they couldn’t help but cry tears of joy. Finally, their savior was here, now they could escape from this hell. No matter how aggressive Jiang Chen was, he would not offend a Sect Elder.
“Senior disciple Jiang, his name is Li Hui, Sect Elder of the outer circle. He is a person of high status, we can’t afford to offend him.”
A disciple walked up to Jiang Chen and whispered to him.
“So, an outer circle Sect Elder.”
Jiang Chen went blank for a second, then he said, “Don’t stop, keep beating them.”

Jiang Chen’s words almost made the people start fainting. How far could this guy really go? This was the Sect Elder, and he still asked them to keep beating, even underneath the presence of a Sect Elder. He simply wouldn’t give a damn about anyone, he was so brutal.
“You, so you are that Jiang Chen. Now, Sect Elder ordered you to immediately stop, explain what’s going on here to me.”
Li Hui was boiling in anger. He had never seen such an arrogant disciple in the outer circle, not until today.

chapters.title: Chapter 126 - Hanging up the Sect Elder
paragraphs: Everyone kept quiet as they saw how furious Li Hui was. Those disciples who followed Jiang Chen had stopped the beating as well. They all stared blankly at Jiang Chen and Li Hui. They had no idea what to do right now, after all, Li Hui was a Sect Elder, and he was also a Heavenly Core warrior, none of them could be his match. Besides, as a Sect Elder, he had a high position in the sect, these disciples couldn’t offend him.

Many disciples who were just bystanders kept quiet and held their breaths. The conflict had now become even worse, even the Sect Elder was here. They were guessing that Jiang Chen would just calm down the conflict.
But, too bad, they simply didn’t understand how far Jiang Chan could go.
“Keep beating.”
Jiang Chen gazed at the furious Li Hui, then he spoke with an indifferent tone. He showed no respect towards Li Hui.
“Nonsense! Who dares to start beating again?!”

Li Hui was boiling in anger. He took a step forwards, and was now standing directly in front of Jiang Chen. With his beard fluttering in the wind, he said, “Jiang Chen, how dare you, don’t forget who you are! You are just an outer circle disciple! By disobeying the Sect Elder alone, I can cripple you right now!”
“Cripple me, hit me with your best shot!”
Jiang Chen sneered, there was no way he would stop what he was doing right now, even if that meant he had to turn the Black Sect upside down. He still wanted to find out who was behind all of this.
“You really think I won’t dare do it?”

Li Hui became even angrier, and Yuan energy could be seen hovering around his body, “Let me tell you this, Jiang Chen, you bullied and assaulted fellow disciples, burnt down a courtyard, and you offended an outer circle Sect Elder! Any of these offenses are more than enough to cripple you, I can even kill you right now!”
“Senior disciple Jiang, I think we should just stop here, after all, we have had our revenge.”
A disciple next to Jiang Chen whispered to him.
Jiang Chen gazed at this disciple, with just a single look, a chill ran down this disciple’s spine. The disciple shrugged and shut his mouth.
Jiang Chen raised his head and stared back into Li Hui’s eyes. It made him even angrier when Li Hui said that he had bullied fellow disciples.

“Sect Elder Li, since you mentioned me bullying fellow disciples, let me explain this to you. These four men forced each of their fellow disciples to pay them 100 Mortal Restoration Pills, is this considered bullying fellow disciples? And, these four men beat up and inflicted serious injuries to Wang Yun and Huang Zheng because they refused to hand over their Mortal Restoration Pills, and both of them are still laying in their beds. Can you give me an explanation to that?”

With an imposing manner, Jiang Chen unleashed the domineering aura of the once greatest Saint in the world. He pressed towards Li Hui and said, “Li Hui, where were you when Guo Lei and his gang bullied their fellow disciples? You, as the outer circle Sect Elder, why were you not stopping them from doing that? I, Jiang Chen, am a reasonable man, an eye for an eye is my motto. Guo Lei and his gang asked for all of this, I was just doing to them what they have done to my fellow disciples. However, you, Sect Elder Li, jumped out at this time to stop me. Who gave you the right to do this? Or, is it perhaps because you’ve accepted Mortal Restoration Pills from Guo Lei as a bribe?”
Jiang Chen’s words were like sharp knives, they tore away everything, leaving Li Hui dumbstruck and unable to reply.
“You! Nonsense! As the Sect Elder, I always treat everyone fairly, how could I accept bribes from anyone?!”
Li Hui seemed extremely furious, but at the same time, he looked a bit guilty. Anyone could tell that he might have really accepted some sort of bribe. If not, he wouldn’t have behaved like this.

In fact, since Li Hui was here, Jiang Chen had guessed that he must be part of this. Guo Lei might not be the one who bribed him, but someone from the inner circle could easily bribe an outer circle Sect Elder.

“Looks like you really accepted something from them. Someone like you will never be fit to be a Sect Elder, and you don’t have the right to stop us. I’ll settle my own score with them. Li Hui, get the hell out of here before I get mad.”
Jiang Chen shouted in a cold manner, then he turned around and told the men behind him, “Keep beating them.”

With that command, everyone’s expressions changed. No one expected Jiang Chen would go so far. After all, Li Hui was an outer circle Sect Elder. But, not only did Jiang Chen failed to show any respect towards him, he even asked him to get the hell out of here. This was so overbearing, in the few hundred years of history in the Black Sect, there hadn’t been a single outer circle disciple who was so domineering.
“Understood!”

Those disciples who held long pikes in their hands didn’t care too much anymore, they just did what Jiang Chen asked. They raised the long pikes high into the air and started beating those four men once again. If anything bad really happened, then they had Jiang Chen standing in front of them.
Ahhh...

The four of them started screaming again. Guo Lei and his gang were completely stunned, the pain from their injuries had completely broken their spirits. They thought that when Sect Elder Li arrived, they would be safe, but they had never expected that they would still go through this terrifying torture.

“Good, good, this is good! Outrageous, Jiang Chen, don’t think that you can do whatever you want since you got first place in the Qi Province competition! You’re so unruly, and you never showed any respect towards me, the Sect Elder, and you have also violated the rules of the Black Sect! Let me, the outer circle Sect Elder, cripple you today!”

Li Hui was completely pissed off. With his Yuan energy floating around him, he clenched his fist and grabbed towards Jiang Chen with lightning like speed. Everyone knew how powerful an attack from a Heavenly Core warrior could be. Those bystanders felt nervous; no one had thought things would escalate like this.
“Hmph! Try to cripple me? Let me show you the difference between you and me!”
Jiang Chen let out a cold snort, then he extended his hand like lightning and grabbed Li Hui’s arm. With this grip, Li Hui’s Yuan energy was immediately dispersed.
It was a shocking scene. Everyone’s eyes widened, and their faces were filled with disbelief.

All they saw was Li Hui’s arm being tightly gripped by Jiang Chen. No matter how Li Hui tried to shake him off, or how much energy he unleashed, there was nothing he could do to make Jiang Chen let go.
“What?”

Li Hui suddenly felt scared. He was an Early Heavenly Core warrior, but with just one strike, Jiang Chen had completely locked him down, making it so that he couldn’t even strike back. This was too frightening. Although he knew that Jiang Chen had previously killed Li Wu Ling; Li Wu Ling had just entered the Heavenly Core realm, and his foundation was unstable, so there was no way the two of them could be compared. Besides, it wasn’t easy for Jiang Chen to kill Li Wu Ling, so the only explanation was that Jiang Chen had become stronger than before.
“Old fool, you shouldn’t have provoked me. All of those who provoke me have miserable endings.”
With a huge amount of force, Jiang Chen broke Li Hui’s arm. When Li Hui felt the severe pain coming from his arm, he couldn’t hold still anymore, and he screamed out in extreme pain.
“Jiang Chen, how dare you, I am the outer circle sect...”

Li Hui spoke sternly, but before he could finish his words, Jiang Chen had kicked him, making him fall down onto the ground. A Heavenly Core warrior couldn’t even defend against a single attack from Jiang Chen.

Jiang Chen stepped on Li Hui’s face, and while towering above him, he said, “Outer circle Sect Elder means nothing to me. If you want to interfere, then make it fair. If not, then just get the hell out of here. When you provoked me, your luck became bad.”
At this moment, everyone’s expressions changed. They all stared at Jiang Chen, their eyes filled with fear.
“Heavens, he is really going to revolt, he just beat a Sect Elder!”

“He has become stronger, Sect Elder Li who is a Heavenly Core warrior couldn’t even withstand a single attack from him! The Qi Province competition ended not long ago... With his speed of leveling up; can he still be considered a human?”
“After assaulting the outer circle Sect Elder, the conflict had gone completely out of control. I don’t think this will end easily.”

Everyone were shocked, the fierceness Jiang Chen displayed had left a shadow in their minds once again. They all reminded themselves; even if they couldn’t become friends with him, they would never become his enemy. This was too frightening.

“Jiang Chen, how dare you step on my face?! I’ll report this to the higher management! To go against your superiors and scold the Sect Elder, this is the greatest sin that can’t be forgiven! You will just have to wait to receive punishment from the sect management!”

Li Hui kept struggling underneath Jiang Chen’s feet. At the same time, he kept threatening him about the serious consequences he would face. However, no matter how hard he struggled, he just couldn’t get away from Jiang Chen’s feet.
“Someone!”
Jiang Chen shouted out loudly.
“Senior disciple Jiang.”
A disciple walked up to Jiang Chen.
“You, help me get one more wooden pole here. Hang this Li Hui up and beat him.”
An upward curve appeared on Jiang Chen’s lip, a sneer.
What? Hang up the Sect Elder and beat him? Are you sure?

Many people were struck by Jiang Chen’s words, and their mouth were widely opened. Even the disciple who stood next to Jiang Chen had the same expression, he was completely stunned. Hang a Sect Elder and beat him? This had gone too far.
“Jiang Chen, how dare...”

Li Hui roared, and his face darkened. As an outer circle Sect Elder, and a Heavenly Core warrior, if he was hung up and beaten in front of so many people, there would be no way for him to continue staying in the Black Sect anymore.
“What are you waiting for?”
Jiang Chen shouted loudly.
“Understood!”

The disciple didn’t dare show any neglect, he hurriedly turned around and left. After some time, the disciple came back with a big wooden pole and stuck it into the ground. There was even some rope in his hand, and it looked like he was well prepared.
“Jiang Chen, you can’t tie me up, I’m the outer circle Sect Elder!”

LI Hui shouted and tried to stop them, but it was to no avail. Jiang Chen grabbed his shirt and dragged him up front the ground, then he pointed his finger at Li Hui’s body and made a few restrictions, temporarily sealing Li Hui’s Qi Sea. As the previously greatest Saint, pill concoction, sealing, defense mechanisms, laying formations... There was nothing he hadn’t mastered. With his current cultivation base and abilities, temporarily sealing the Qi Sea of a Heavenly Core warrior was incredibly easy.

Li Hui was after all a Heavenly Core warrior, and his injuries weren’t serious. If his Qi Sea wasn’t sealed, then the rope wouldn’t be able to hold him at all. Jiang Chen wanted to hang Li Hui no matter what, and he wanted to make this matter become more complicated. The more serious, the better. He wanted to get the man behind everything to come out. As for the consequences, Jiang Chen didn’t bother thinking about those. The more he showed off, the more attention he would get from the sect management.
No disciple dared to tie an outer circle Sect Elder up, and not all these disciples had Jiang Chen’s courage.
Therefore, Jiang Chen didn’t ask them to do it, he personally tied up Li Hui with the rope like a dumpling, then hung him up on the wooden pole
“Ahh... Jiang Chen, you bastard, how dare you tie me up?! You have gone against your superior, the sect management for sure won’t let you get away with this!”
Li Hui kept shouting and struggling, but his Qi Sea was sealed shut by Jiang Chen, so all his struggles were just a waste of effort.

I, Jiang Chen, am a reasonable man, an eye for an eye is my motto.
Guo Lei and his gang asked for all of this, I was just doing to them what they have done to my fellow disciples.
However, you, Sect Elder Li, jumped out at this time to stop me.
Who gave you the right to do this?
Or, is it perhaps because you’ve accepted Mortal Restoration Pills from Guo Lei as a bribe?”
Jiang Chen’s words were like sharp knives, they tore away everything, leaving Li Hui dumbstruck and unable to reply.
“You!
Nonsense!
As the Sect Elder, I always treat everyone fairly, how could I accept bribes from anyone?!”
Li Hui seemed extremely furious, but at the same time, he looked a bit guilty.
Anyone could tell that he might have really accepted some sort of bribe.
If not, he wouldn’t have behaved like this.
In fact, since Li Hui was here, Jiang Chen had guessed that he must be part of this.
Guo Lei might not be the one who bribed him, but someone from the inner circle could easily bribe an outer circle Sect Elder.
“Looks like you really accepted something from them.
Someone like you will never be fit to be a Sect Elder, and you don’t have the right to stop us.
I’ll settle my own score with them.
Li Hui, get the hell out of here before I get mad.”
Jiang Chen shouted in a cold manner, then he turned around and told the men behind him, “Keep beating them.”

After all, Li Hui was an outer circle Sect Elder.

Those disciples who held long pikes in their hands didn’t care too much anymore, they just did what Jiang Chen asked.

chapters.title: Chapter 127 - Tied up One after Another, Hang Them All!
paragraphs: Outer circle Sect Elder Li Hui was hung up, and this had never happened before in the history of the Black Sect. Everyone’s eyes were opened wide as they looked at the screaming Li Hui.
Who was the most daring person in the world? Jiang Chen was the first one who came to their minds.
“Jiang Chen, let go of me, you’re courting death...”
Li Hui kept roaring angrily.
Bam!

However, before he could finish his words, Jiang Chen had smashed the pike in his hand into his face. The pike directly hit Li Hui’s mouth, and with its powerful force, it knocked three teeth out. Li Hui’s mouth was filled with blood, and he was unable to talk anymore.
“What a bullshit Sect Elder, how dare you show off in front of your father, and order your father?!”

Jiang Chen was not someone who could be easily messed with, and he was also a man like a dog with a bone. Jiang Chen kept hitting Li Hui with the pike, making it so that he could only mumble in pain. In just a short period of time, Li Hui had become swollen like a fat man.
“What are you looking at? Keep beating them, beat them to death!”

Jiang Chen shouted at those disciples who were carrying long pikes in their hands. Then, these men immediately felt a rise in their spirits. They raised the pikes in their hands high up into the air, then they began beating Guo Lei and his gang. To them, this was the first time they had ever participated in such an exciting incident.
Bam bam bam...
Ahh ahhh ahhhh...

The square was filled with the sound of beating and screaming. The bystanders were all frightened, but at the same time, they felt their blood boiling. Guo Lei and his gang were indeed unlucky, but Li Hui had it even worse. What happened today would surely be recorded in the Black Sect’s history.
This was defiance of everything. In the future, Jiang Chen’s name would be synonymous to demonic.
A fierce, brutal man. Never in their lives had they seen someone who could be so fierce and brutal.
“Senior disciple Jiang, if we keep beating them like this, they might die soon.”
One of the disciples said, he seemed scared. The conflict had gone too far now, too far from what they could imagine.
“Scared of what? Keep beating, beat till they are dead!”

Jiang Chen didn’t turn his head around, he just kept beating Li Hui with the pike in his hand. Li Hui and Guo Lei were strong warriors, they had strong physiques as well as protection from their Yuan energy. The way there were beaten wasn’t enough to actually kill them, it would at most cause them some internal injuries. However, Jiang Chen needed to show his power today, so that those disciples from the inner circle would appear.
“Stop it now!”

Right at this moment, a loud shout came from above. Everyone raised their heads up, then they saw two young men dressed in white coming from the direction of the inner circle. Soon after, these two men landed in the square outside of the outer circle’s residence area. Their expressions changed immediately when they saw who had been beaten, they recognized Guo Lei and Li Hui.
“Jiang Chen, what are you doing here?! How dare you assault the Sect Elder?!”
A young man with a huge body shouted out loudly. An angry expression appeared on his face.
“They are Cai Dong and Wang Heng, the inner circle disciples are finally here! I wonder how this is all going to end today.”
“I’m sure they won’t let this matter get solved easily today. I just wonder if Jiang Chen has the courage to fight the inner circle disciples.”
“I’m sure he does! He even has the guts to beat a Sect Elder! I can’t think about anything he wouldn’t dare to do.”

The arrival of these two men had caused some turmoil. Jiang Chen also stopped the beating. He turned around and looked at the both of them. When he noticed that both of these men were only Early Heavenly Core warriors, he silently let out a cold snort, “The culprit is still not here... Looks like I’ll need to continue the disturbance.”

The man Jiang Chen was looking for was definitely not one of these two men in front of him. The one he wanted to find was the man who had hunted him down in the Myriad Demon Mountain. Guo Lei was told by Cai Dong that Jiang Chen had been killed in the mountain, therefore, Cai Dong must be in touch with the man who hunted him down. This matter wasn’t that simple, there must be someone else behind everything, Jiang Chen had to continue the disturbance.
“This is an outer circle matter, we don’t need you from the inner circle. Do your father a favor and get the hell out of here.”
Jiang Chen waved his hand impatiently.
Both men’s expressions changed, they felt offended. They had met some arrogant guys before, but not to this extent.
“Bastard! Jiang Chen, who do you think you are, how dare you talk to us like that?”
Wang Heng shouted.
“Weren’t you killed in the Myriad Demon Mountain? How come you’re still alive and safe?”

Cai Doing stared at Jiang Chen with a hint of curiosity. The news about Jiang Chen’s death had been told by his senior disciple, and it shouldn’t have been wrong. But now, he could see Jiang Chen was alive and standing in front of him. The only explanation for this was that his senior disciple had failed to kill Jiang Chen.
“How did you know I was killed in the Myriad Demon Mountain?”
Jiang Chen squinted his eyes and stared at Cai Dong with his razor sharp vision.

“Hmph! I don’t need to tell you how I got the news. Now, let me ask you, what is all this about? Beating fellow disciples, the outer circle Sect Elder, and burning the courtyard... Are you trying to revolt here?”
Cai Dong let out a cold snort.
“Which one of you is Cai Dong?”
Jiang Chen asked.
“I am.”

Cai Dong replied. He and Wang Heng both portrayed an arrogant and aggressive image. They weren’t scared of Jiang Chen. They were both Heavenly Core warriors, and they were both geniuses. A genius couldn’t be compared with someone ordinary... at least, Li Hui couldn’t. Besides, as inner circle disciples, their status in the Black Sect were much higher and precious than that of these outer circle disciples. Therefore, although Jiang Chen got first place in the Qi Province competition, they didn’t really take him seriously. After all, this place was the Black Sect.

“So you are that Cai Dong, perfect! I was looking for you. Let’s settle our debt now. Eighty thousand Mortal Restoration Pills. Just now, Guo Lei and his men gave us nine thousand, so you owe us seventy-one thousand. Hand them all over now.”
Jiang Chen said in an aggressive manner.
What?

Cai Dong and Wang Heng were completely startled. Some outer circle disciples had gone to them not long ago and told them about Guo Lei being beaten by Jiang Chen, and how he was looking for Cai Dong. However, they never mentioned anything about Mortal Restoration Pills, much less this huge amount.
Seventy thousand Mortal Restoration Pills, even for an inner circle disciple, this was considered a huge amount of wealth. An ordinary disciple wouldn’t even have that much at all.

And what really made Cai Dong and Wang Heng speechless was that Jiang Chen had really dared to ask them for Mortal Restoration Pills, and he even asked them for such a huge amount. This guy must be crazy about money.
“Jiang Chen, you are courting death by speaking those words! Before I become mad, hurry up and let Sect Elder Li and Guo Lei go!”
Cai Dong was starting to act aggressively.
Just as he finished his words, he received a slap. The slap contained so much force that it made Cai Dong trip on his feet and almost fall down.
“Damn you, try letting your father see you become mad!”
Jiang Chen slapped again. Although the way he slapped looked simple, it was an extremely fast slap. Even Cai Dong didn’t have the time to react.
“Jiang Chen, how dare you slap me?!”

Cai Dong became really angry. He was an inner circle disciple, and that brought an honorable status, a status that should be respected by all outer circle disciples. In any normal day, these outer circle disciples would immediately show their respect when they saw him, but this Jiang Chen had just slapped his face in front of so many people. This was ridiculous!
“Hurry up, give me those Mortal Restoration Pills.”
Jiang Chen kept pushing him.
“Let’s do it, kill him!”

Cai Dong was extremely furious, and Wang Heng finally reacted. Both of them shouted out loudly at the same time and unleashed their Yuan energies. The Yuan energy, together with the aura of two Heavenly Core warriors formed layers upon layers of energy waves that frightened everyone at the scene.
Bam! Bam!
However, before either of them could attack, Jiang Chen had moved. Nobody saw how Jiang Chen did it, and all they could see was Cai Dong and Wang Heng laying on the ground.
What?! This scene shocked everyone once again. This was amazing, the spectators couldn’t believe this was real.
“Heavens, Cai Dong and Wang Heng were defeated by Jiang Chen with just a single strike! I couldn’t even see how Jiang Chen did it, how could he be so fast?!”

“This is so frightening! I’m sure Jiang Chen has broken through to the Late Mortal Core realm, but even if he did reach that level, how is it possible for him to be so strong? These Heavenly Core warriors are simply not his match!”
“Abnormal! This is a monster! Jiang Chen’s potential is not any weaker than Nan Bei Chao’s, no wonder he had the courage to challenge Nan Bei Chao to a fight one year from now!”

Everyone was shocked by what they had just witnessed. This was rare, an outer circle disciple beating a Sect Elder and some inner circle disciples. Let alone the Black Sect, even in the entire history of the Qi Province, this was the first time it had happened.

Now, not only had Jiang Chen broken through to the Late Mortal Core realm, he had even formed 80 Dragon Marks in his Qi Sea. Combined, both of them gave him an incredible combat strength. Early Heavenly Core warriors was nothing much in front of him, he could kill them with a single strike without even wasting too much of his energy.
Hmph!
Jiang Chen let out a cold snort, then he reached his hand out towards Cai Dong and Wang Heng. He grabbed two yellow storage bags, and then he threw them to a disciple behind him.
“Open it up and count how many Mortal Restoration Pills are in there. If it still isn’t enough, we’ll take their combat weapons as compensation.”

Jiang Chen said. As inner circle disciples, these two men must be rich so they might even have some precious herbs or items, and combat weapons. Now, everything had become compensation for what they had done.
“Jiang Chen, return our storage bags!”
Cai Dong was furious, that storage bag contained all the wealth he had gathered, it would make his heart start bleeding if they just took it all.
Ignoring Cai Dong’s anger, Jiang Chen pulled him closer. With a fierce voice, he asked, “Tell me, who told you that I have been killed in the Myriad Demon Mountain?”

Jiang Chen’s eyes were like those of a demon from hell. With a single look, he had sent shivers down Cai Dong’s spine. At this moment, Cai Dong had a feeling that he was not facing a human, but a demon that came from hell. Together with the aura of someone from the top that Jiang Chen was unconsciously emitting, and the effect of the Great Soul Derivation skill, Cai Dong simply couldn’t avoid the question.
“It was... It was senior disciple Jiang Wei who told me about this! He was also the one who asked me to do something to those disciples who followed you!”

Cai Dong never hid anything, he had the same mentality as Guo Lei; pointing the blame to Jiang Wei. Jiang Wei was a Mid Heavenly Core warrior, and with his mighty strength, Jiang Chen would have to admit defeat if he was here.
“Jiang Wei? This is getting more interesting.”
Jiang Chen sneered. He had no idea if this Jiang Wei was the man who hunted him down back in the mountain, but he had a feeling that there was someone else behind this Jiang Wei.
It looked like in order to lure the real culprit out, he needed to make this conflict reach greater heights today.
“Men, go grab some more wooden pillars, hang Cai Dong and Wang Heng up and beat them until they die!”
Jiang Chen shouted out loudly.

However, Jiang Chen needed to show his power today, so that those disciples from the inner circle would appear.
“Stop it now!”
Right at this moment, a loud shout came from above.
Everyone raised their heads up, then they saw two young men dressed in white coming from the direction of the inner circle.
Soon after, these two men landed in the square outside of the outer circle’s residence area.
Their expressions changed immediately when they saw who had been beaten, they recognized Guo Lei and Li Hui.
“Jiang Chen, what are you doing here?!
How dare you assault the Sect Elder?!”
A young man with a huge body shouted out loudly.
An angry expression appeared on his face.
“They are Cai Dong and Wang Heng, the inner circle disciples are finally here!
I wonder how this is all going to end today.”
“I’m sure they won’t let this matter get solved easily today.
I just wonder if Jiang Chen has the courage to fight the inner circle disciples.”
“I’m sure he does!
He even has the guts to beat a Sect Elder!
I can’t think about anything he wouldn’t dare to do.”
The arrival of these two men had caused some turmoil.
Jiang Chen also stopped the beating.
He turned around and looked at the both of them.
When he noticed that both of these men were only Early Heavenly Core warriors, he silently let out a cold snort, “The culprit is still not here...
Looks like I’ll need to continue the disturbance.”
The man Jiang Chen was looking for was definitely not one of these two men in front of him.
The one he wanted to find was the man who had hunted him down in the Myriad Demon Mountain.
Guo Lei was told by Cai Dong that Jiang Chen had been killed in the mountain, therefore, Cai Dong must be in touch with the man who hunted him down.
This matter wasn’t that simple, there must be someone else behind everything, Jiang Chen had to continue the disturbance.
“This is an outer circle matter, we don’t need you from the inner circle.
Do your father a favor and get the hell out of here.”
Jiang Chen waved his hand impatiently.
Both men’s expressions changed, they felt offended.
They had met some arrogant guys before, but not to this extent.
“Bastard!
Jiang Chen, who do you think you are, how dare you talk to us like that?”
Wang Heng shouted.
“Weren’t you killed in the Myriad Demon Mountain?
How come you’re still alive and safe?”
Cai Doing stared at Jiang Chen with a hint of curiosity.
The news about Jiang Chen’s death had been told by his senior disciple, and it shouldn’t have been wrong.
But now, he could see Jiang Chen was alive and standing in front of him.
The only explanation for this was that his senior disciple had failed to kill Jiang Chen.
“How did you know I was killed in the Myriad Demon Mountain?”
Jiang Chen squinted his eyes and stared at Cai Dong with his razor sharp vision.
“Hmph!
I don’t need to tell you how I got the news.
Now, let me ask you, what is all this about?
Beating fellow disciples, the outer circle Sect Elder, and burning the courtyard...
Are you trying to revolt here?”
Cai Dong let out a cold snort.
“Which one of you is Cai Dong?”
Jiang Chen asked.
“I am.”
Cai Dong replied.
He and Wang Heng both portrayed an arrogant and aggressive image.
They weren’t scared of Jiang Chen.
They were both Heavenly Core warriors, and they were both geniuses.
A genius couldn’t be compared with someone ordinary... at least, Li Hui couldn’t.
Besides, as inner circle disciples, their status in the Black Sect were much higher and precious than that of these outer circle disciples.
Therefore, although Jiang Chen got first place in the Qi Province competition, they didn’t really take him seriously.
After all, this place was the Black Sect.
“So you are that Cai Dong, perfect!
I was looking for you.
Let’s settle our debt now.
Eighty thousand Mortal Restoration Pills.
Just now, Guo Lei and his men gave us nine thousand, so you owe us seventy-one thousand.
Hand them all over now.”
Jiang Chen said in an aggressive manner.
What?
Cai Dong and Wang Heng were completely startled.
Some outer circle disciples had gone to them not long ago and told them about Guo Lei being beaten by Jiang Chen, and how he was looking for Cai Dong.
However, they never mentioned anything about Mortal Restoration Pills, much less this huge amount.
Seventy thousand Mortal Restoration Pills, even for an inner circle disciple, this was considered a huge amount of wealth.
An ordinary disciple wouldn’t even have that much at all.
And what really made Cai Dong and Wang Heng speechless was that Jiang Chen had really dared to ask them for Mortal Restoration Pills, and he even asked them for such a huge amount.
This guy must be crazy about money.
“Jiang Chen, you are courting death by speaking those words!
Before I become mad, hurry up and let Sect Elder Li and Guo Lei go!”
Cai Dong was starting to act aggressively.
Just as he finished his words, he received a slap.
The slap contained so much force that it made Cai Dong trip on his feet and almost fall down.
“Damn you, try letting your father see you become mad!”
Jiang Chen slapped again.
Although the way he slapped looked simple, it was an extremely fast slap.
Even Cai Dong didn’t have the time to react.
“Jiang Chen, how dare you slap me?!”
Cai Dong became really angry.
He was an inner circle disciple, and that brought an honorable status, a status that should be respected by all outer circle disciples.
In any normal day, these outer circle disciples would immediately show their respect when they saw him, but this Jiang Chen had just slapped his face in front of so many people.
This was ridiculous!
“Hurry up, give me those Mortal Restoration Pills.”
Jiang Chen kept pushing him.
“Let’s do it, kill him!”
Cai Dong was extremely furious, and Wang Heng finally reacted.
Both of them shouted out loudly at the same time and unleashed their Yuan energies.
The Yuan energy, together with the aura of two Heavenly Core warriors formed layers upon layers of energy waves that frightened everyone at the scene.
Bam!
Bam!
However, before either of them could attack, Jiang Chen had moved.
Nobody saw how Jiang Chen did it, and all they could see was Cai Dong and Wang Heng laying on the ground.
What?!
This scene shocked everyone once again.
This was amazing, the spectators couldn’t believe this was real.
“Heavens, Cai Dong and Wang Heng were defeated by Jiang Chen with just a single strike!
I couldn’t even see how Jiang Chen did it, how could he be so fast?!”
“This is so frightening!
I’m sure Jiang Chen has broken through to the Late Mortal Core realm, but even if he did reach that level, how is it possible for him to be so strong?
These Heavenly Core warriors are simply not his match!”
“Abnormal!
This is a monster!
Jiang Chen’s potential is not any weaker than Nan Bei Chao’s, no wonder he had the courage to challenge Nan Bei Chao to a fight one year from now!”
Everyone was shocked by what they had just witnessed.
This was rare, an outer circle disciple beating a Sect Elder and some inner circle disciples.
Let alone the Black Sect, even in the entire history of the Qi Province, this was the first time it had happened.
Now, not only had Jiang Chen broken through to the Late Mortal Core realm, he had even formed 80 Dragon Marks in his Qi Sea.
Combined, both of them gave him an incredible combat strength.
Early Heavenly Core warriors was nothing much in front of him, he could kill them with a single strike without even wasting too much of his energy.
Hmph!
Jiang Chen let out a cold snort, then he reached his hand out towards Cai Dong and Wang Heng.
He grabbed two yellow storage bags, and then he threw them to a disciple behind him.
“Open it up and count how many Mortal Restoration Pills are in there.
If it still isn’t enough, we’ll take their combat weapons as compensation.”
Jiang Chen said.
As inner circle disciples, these two men must be rich so they might even have some precious herbs or items, and combat weapons.
Now, everything had become compensation for what they had done.
“Jiang Chen, return our storage bags!”
Cai Dong was furious, that storage bag contained all the wealth he had gathered, it would make his heart start bleeding if they just took it all.
Ignoring Cai Dong’s anger, Jiang Chen pulled him closer.
With a fierce voice, he asked, “Tell me, who told you that I have been killed in the Myriad Demon Mountain?”
Jiang Chen’s eyes were like those of a demon from hell.
With a single look, he had sent shivers down Cai Dong’s spine.
At this moment, Cai Dong had a feeling that he was not facing a human, but a demon that came from hell.
Together with the aura of someone from the top that Jiang Chen was unconsciously emitting, and the effect of the Great Soul Derivation skill, Cai Dong simply couldn’t avoid the question.
“It was...
It was senior disciple Jiang Wei who told me about this!
He was also the one who asked me to do something to those disciples who followed you!”
Cai Dong never hid anything, he had the same mentality as Guo Lei; pointing the blame to Jiang Wei.
Jiang Wei was a Mid Heavenly Core warrior, and with his mighty strength, Jiang Chen would have to admit defeat if he was here.
“Jiang Wei?
This is getting more interesting.”
Jiang Chen sneered.
He had no idea if this Jiang Wei was the man who hunted him down back in the mountain, but he had a feeling that there was someone else behind this Jiang Wei.
It looked like in order to lure the real culprit out, he needed to make this conflict reach greater heights today.
“Men, go grab some more wooden pillars, hang Cai Dong and Wang Heng up and beat them until they die!”
Jiang Chen shouted out loudly.
